xxjsonderuloxx/decky-optiscaler.body:
Decky OptiScaler v0.3.0 Release Notes

Major Refactoring & UI Improvements

This release represents a complete overhaul of the Decky OptiScaler plugin, focusing on maintainability, user experience, and advanced configuration options.

New Features

INI Preservation System
- Added INI preservation toggle - Prevent OptiScaler from overwriting your custom game configurations
- Smart conditional UI - Advanced settings (Frame Generation Type & OptiScaler Settings) are now hidden by default and only appear when INI preservation is disabled
- Cleaner default experience - New users see a simplified interface, power users can access advanced options

Enhanced Non-Steam Games Support  
- Dedicated Non-Steam Games section with comprehensive setup instructions
- Multiple DLL options with detailed descriptions (dxgi.dll, winmm.dll, dbghelp.dll, etc.)
- SteamOS-optimized instructions - Removed clipboard references for better handheld compatibility

Improved Status Display
- Consolidated status messages - No more redundant "Mod Not Installed" + "OptiScaler Not Installed" 
- Clear single message when not installed: "OptiScaler Mod Not Installed"
- Detailed info when installed - Shows both installation status and current version
- Conditional Update button - Only appears when OptiScaler is actually installed

Complete Code Refactoring

Modular Component Architecture
- Broke down massive 2000+ line index.tsx into manageable components:
  - FGModInstallerSection.tsx - Installation and updates
  - InstalledGamesSection.tsx - Game selection and patching  
  - NonSteamGamesSection.tsx - Non-Steam game instructions
  - PreserveIniSection.tsx - INI preservation settings
  - OptiScalerFGTypeSection.tsx - Frame generation type settings
  - OptiScalerSettingsTabs.tsx - Advanced OptiScaler configuration
  - PluginUpdateChecker.tsx - Plugin update management
  - SettingsSections.tsx - Shared settings components

Code Cleanup
- Removed unused scripts and legacy assets
- Streamlined build process and dependencies
- Improved maintainability with separated concerns
- Enhanced error handling and user feedback

Backend Improvements

Script Optimization
- Updated opti.sh patcher with better INI handling
- Improved uninstaller scripts for cleaner removal
- Enhanced download system for bleeding-edge releases
- Better path handling and error reporting

Asset Management
- Removed unnecessary remote binaries to reduce bloat
- Streamlined asset deployment process
- Updated justfile for better development workflow

User Experience Enhancements

Improved UI Flow
- Reordered sections for better logical progression:
  1. Select game first
  2. Configure preservation settings  
  3. Access advanced options (if needed)
- Contextual button visibility - Update/Uninstall only show when relevant
- Enhanced descriptions and helpful tooltips throughout

Better Documentation
- Updated README with comprehensive feature overview
- Improved in-app instructions for all use cases
- Clearer error messages and status indicators

Bug Fixes
- Fixed path issues in installer components
- Resolved UI state management problems  
- Corrected script execution paths
- Improved error handling across all components

necrosiak/bc250-toolkit-decky.name: v0.6.1 — updates that install and actually load
necrosiak/bc250-toolkit-decky.body:
## Updates were being written and never loaded

Pressing **Install** wrote the new version to disk, and the plugin reload that should follow could never happen. The update only took effect at the next boot, and nothing said so either way.

This plugin runs as root, so it looked immune to this. It was not:

- Decky's loader is a PyInstaller bundle and exports its extraction directory on `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`. Every plugin backend inherits it, so `systemctl` resolves the bundled `libcrypto` and does not even start — root or otherwise.
- Being refused by polkit is only the second gate, and the one that stops the plugins that do not run as root.

Nothing read the result of that call, so the failure was completely silent.

## What changed

The update button now asks Decky's loader to reload this plugin alone, and reports the new version when it is done. That also stops an update to one plugin from restarting all of them. If the loader is too old to offer that, the button says so instead of…

bschelst/deskflow-decky.name: v0.3.0
bschelst/deskflow-decky.body:
### What's new

- The plugin can now install, configure, and set up autostart for the stock desktop
  Deskflow app in one click, and sync your server address and screen name between it
  and the plugin in either direction. Handy if you use both Gaming Mode and Desktop
  Mode and dont want to type the server address in twice.
- Gaming Mode and Desktop Mode now actually hand off to each other properly: leaving
  Gaming Mode releases the connection instead of holding the screen name hostage, and
  coming back reconnects automatically instead of needing a manual restart every time.

### Fixes

- Found out mid-session that Gaming Mode detection has been silently broken this
  whole time: it checked an env var that plain doesnt exist on this kind of systemd
  service, so it always though it was in Desktop Mode. Replaced with checking for
  Gamescope's own process, which actually works.
- The "input enabled" toggle in the quick access panel used to just flip a flag that
  nothing read. It now actually starts and stops the helper, since there is no way to
  really pause input without dropping the connection anyway.
- tests/ had snuck into .gitignore by accident, which is a bit of a problem for a
  folder full of tests that are supposed to be committed.

### Other

- Every source file now has an author header.

bschelst/deskflow-decky.name: v0.2.0
bschelst/deskflow-decky.body:
### What's new

- Keyboard layot is now independent of the server. Pick your own keyboard language layout in the plugin
  and should remain like this regardless of what OS or layout the server side is running — needed
  a fifth patch that replays physical key positions instead of trusting the server's
  keysyms. Needs a reboot after changing.
- Settings shows a reboot button when a layout change needs Gaming Mode to restart before
  it takes effect, guarded behind a confirm dialog so it doesnt fire by accident.
- Autostart now retries while gamescope's input socket is not up yet, instead of staying
  in error on the first boot every time.

### Fixes

- Reboot now goes through Steam's own restart call instead of systemctl. The plugin
  backend has no permission to reboot directly ("interactive authentication required"),
  but Steam's own power-menu path needs nothing extra.
- Cleared out a pile of ruff lint debt so CI actually passes again.

### Other

- Rewrote the README with a logo…

brielleg116/decky-apple-music.name: DeckyAM v1.0.22
brielleg116/decky-apple-music.body:
## What's new in v1.0.22

**Library**
- Songs, Albums and Playlists now load in full: they page through your whole library (100 per request) instead of stopping at the first 50–100 items. The first page appears instantly and the rest loads in the background. (BrielleG116/decky-apple-music#2)
- **Sort** Songs, Albums and Playlists **A–Z** or **Recently added**. (#2)
- New **Play all** and **Shuffle all** buttons in Library → Songs. Songs that are no longer available are skipped, and a notification says how many. (#3)

**Explicit content**
- In regions where Apple restricts explicit songs by default (Brazil, Switzerland, Guatemala, Hungary, Indonesia, India, Italy, South Korea, Laos, Lithuania, Malaysia, Russia, Singapore, Turkey), songs failed with "Content restricted". The plugin now asks once whether to allow explicit content and remembers your choice, and there is an **Allow explicit content** toggle in Settings. (#1)

**Fixes**
- Large messages to the player (such as a whole-library queue) are no longer truncated.

**Install**
- Decky Loader → Settings → enable **Developer mode** → Developer tab → **Install Plugin from URL**:
  `https://github.com/BrielleG116/decky-apple-music/releases/latest/download/apple-music-plugin.zip`
- Already installed? Reinstall from that link; your sign-in and settings are kept. The player does not need to be reinstalled.

The Electron player is still hosted on the permanent `v1.0.0` release (do not delete it).

brielleg116/decky-apple-music.name: DeckyAM v1.0.21
brielleg116/decky-apple-music.body:
Plugin release **v1.0.21** — the tag now matches the plugin's own version (`package.json`).

This is the same plugin that was previously attached to the `v1.0.0` release (identical zip, no code changes); it is re-published under a matching tag so update checkers such as DeckyHub can compare versions correctly.

**Install (testers):**
1. Decky Loader → Settings → enable **Developer mode**.
2. Developer tab → **Install Plugin from URL** → paste:
   `https://github.com/BrielleG116/decky-apple-music/releases/latest/download/apple-music-plugin.zip`
3. Open **Apple Music** in the QAM → tap **Install Player** (one-time ~120 MB download).
4. Sign in with your Apple ID (requires an active Apple Music subscription).

**Notes**
- The Electron player is still hosted on the permanent `v1.0.0` release (the plugin's player download URL points there) — do not delete it.
- From now on a release's tag is always `v<package.json version>`.

necrosiak/skullkey.body:

necrosiak/skullkey.name: v1.21.8 — EA: older installers
necrosiak/skullkey.body:
### Fixes

- **EA: installs that only failed to register with Windows' game list now finish.** Some older EA installers (Syndicate, Battlefield 1942…) end with code 3 when Windows Game Explorer refuses to list the game, even though the game is fully installed. SkullKey now accepts that case, and only that case; any other installer error still stops the install.
- **EA: product keys for older installers.** Installers from the EA Download Manager era (such as Battlefield 2142) read the product key that the EA app stores in the registry. SkullKey now places your account's key there before the installer starts, as the EA app does. The key never appears in logs. Battlefield 2142 still needs to be confirmed (#10).
- SkullKey's background process now stops on its own if Decky Loader goes away without stopping it, instead of staying in memory.

### Thanks

Thanks to [@zavaro](https://github.com/zavaro) for the detailed logs and registry details in…

steamdeckchecker/github-decky-plugins-up.name: Version 1.9.2
steamdeckchecker/github-decky-plugins-up.body:
Version 1.9.2

Deutsch
Ist eine repos.txt in einem Downloads-Ordner vorhanden, erscheint unter „Überwachte Repositories“ ein Knopf zum manuellen Import in die interne Repository-Liste.
Der Import ergänzt nur neue gültige Links, ignoriert Kommentare und Leerzeilen, überspringt doppelte Einträge und verändert die Datei nicht. Hinzugefügte, vorhandene und ungültige Einträge werden gezählt.
Der Datei-Import kann später erneut gestartet werden; automatische Update-Prüfungen arbeiten weiterhin ausschließlich mit der gespeicherten Liste.

English
When a repos.txt exists in a Downloads folder, a manual import button appears under “Followed repositories”.
Import adds only new valid links, ignores comments and blank lines, skips duplicates, and leaves the file unchanged. Added, existing, and invalid entries are counted.
The import can be run again later; automatic update checks still use only the saved list.

Changelog – Version 1.9.1

Deutsch
- Der Updater prüft sein eigenes GitHub-Repository kurz nach dem Start und bei regulären Update-Prüfungen. Du musst es nicht zur Repository-Liste hinzufügen.

- Release-Tags wie 191 werden anhand der Version im ZIP-Namen ausgewertet. So kann auch ein unterbrochenes Selbstupdate korrekt erkannt werden.
- Startprüfungen innerhalb von fünf Minuten werden vermieden. Die Prüfung der Plugin-Identität, der Versionsvergleich und das Backup der bisherigen Installation bleiben erhalten.


English
- The updater checks its own GitHub repository shortly after startup and during regular update checks. You no longer need to add it to the followed repositories.
- A newer updater version installs automatically even in “Ask before installing” mode.…

ciphay/decky-file-manager.name: Decky File Manager 2.2.1
ciphay/decky-file-manager.body:
## New

### Storage drives
- Drives are now shown as **capsules** with an icon, name, free space and a usage bar. Volumes that are read-only (ISO sticks, for example) show "Read-only" instead of a red "0 B free".
- **Mounted and unmounted** devices are listed, following the same visibility rules as Dolphin: EFI/boot partitions, partitions without a filesystem, swap, whole disks that have partitions and other devices hidden by udisks are not shown.
- Selecting an unmounted drive **mounts it** (an administrator password modal appears only if needed).
- **Y** on a drive opens a menu with **Rename**, **Unmount** and **Cancel** (not available for the system drives, root and home).
- Unmounting now always works: if the device is busy, it falls back to a lazy unmount.
- **LUKS support:** encrypted volumes appear as "Encrypted"; selecting one asks for the passphrase, unlocks and mounts it. Unmounting locks it again.

### Steam integration
- Steam's **"Browse..."** buttons (for example the executable and "Start in" fields in a game's properties) open the plugin's file manager instead of the Linux one.
- Other "open folder in the file manager" actions in Big Picture (install folder, screenshots, local directories) also open the plugin.
- Outside Big Picture, or if anything fails, the system dialog is used as before.

## Fixes
- Archive extraction protects against path traversal.
- Errors from the backend are now returned as results instead of raising exceptions.

## eGPUBridge v0.2.alfa — Public Alpha Release

rayekkk/fsr4injector.body:
Ubisoft games from Non Steam Launchers are listed under their own names, which 1.2.0 did not do.

### 🐛 Fixed
- **Games:** A shortcut that starts Ubisoft Connect with a game's id (`uplay://launch/…`, as Non Steam
  Launchers creates them) now gets that game, found through the Windows registry of its Proton prefix. If
  FSR 4 is on for the **Ubisoft Connect** entry, turn it off, press **Rescan library** and turn it on for
  the game.

A notification during the game when FSR 4 runs, as a lighter check than AMD's watermark.

### ✨ Added
- **Status:** **Tell me when FSR4 runs** (under **All games**, off by default) shows a short notification
  during the game as soon as AMD's library runs FSR 4, with its model. Problems are still told when the
  game ends.

### 🐛 Fixed
- **Games:** A game with its own non-Steam shortcut is no longer listed under its launcher's shortcut (for
  example Ubisoft Connect, whose games sit in its folder), so FSR 4 works when you start the game's
  shortcut. A launcher shortcut that already has FSR 4 on keeps its game until you turn it off.

Non-Steam games, a Repair button and an About page. Updating from 1.0.0 keeps your games set up: **Check
for updates** downloads the new ZIP, which you install the same way as before.

### ✨ Added
**Games**
- Windows games added to Steam with "Add a Non-Steam Game" and run with Proton are found too, from the
  folder of the shortcut's `.exe`. They have their own list, **Non-Steam games**, under **Steam games**.

**Repair**
- Re-checks AMD's library and puts the plugin's files and launch option back in every game that has
  FSR 4 on, for example after a game update or Steam's file check.
- If AMD's library itself is damaged or missing, it tells you to download it again first.

**Decky Launch Options**
- With [Decky Launch Options](https://github.com/Rayekkk/DeckyLaunchOptions) installed, **Add to Decky
  Launch Options** offers the FSR4 launch option and AMD's watermark to it, to switch per game there.

**About**
- **Use Rayek's store** makes Rayek's store Decky's store channel after…

### ✨ Added

**Plugin**
- First release.

**Install**
- Install from the release ZIP: in Decky Settings turn on **Developer mode**, then choose
  **Developer → Install Plugin from ZIP** and select `FSR4Injector-1.0.0.zip`.

**AMD download**
- **Accept and download** fetches AMD's FSR 4 library from AMD's official driver package (about
  43 MB).

**Games**
- Turn FSR 4 on per game under **Games with FSR 3.1+**; in the game, choose **AMD FSR** as the upscaler.

**Status**
- After you quit the game, the panel shows "FSR4 active", or a notification says what went wrong.

artistro08/decky-youtube-music.body:
## Reliability & Quality Improvements

- **Fix memory leaks:** Clear WebSocket/auth listeners and reconnect timers on disconnect to prevent accumulation across mount/unmount cycles
- **Fix silent API failures:** `post()` now returns `false` on network error; `del()`/`patch()` handle 401 auth errors
- **Cancellable requests:** Added `AbortController` support to song info fetch — requests are properly cancelled on unmount
- **Fix stale queue:** Queue reloads automatically on WebSocket reconnect instead of only on initial mount
- **Stable list keys:** Queue items now use `videoId` as React key instead of array index
- **Minor cleanups:** Remove unused `styleRef`, add `displayName` to memoized `TabsContainer`

### Install
Download `youtube-music.zip` and install via Decky Loader's "Install from ZIP" option.

ptflp/4deus-mod.body:
This release fixes Steam Deck keyboard and Nested Desktop input issues.

- Keep **Fn** visible when only one Steam keyboard layout is enabled, including when Steam hides the layout switch.
- Recognize renamed **Steam Os** shortcuts by their launcher path. Add / Repair preserves custom names such as **SteamOS Desktop** and reuses the existing shortcut.
- Recover the Nested Desktop AppID from its inherited environment when the Steam launcher exits.
- Prevent a stalled keyboard visibility request from permanently blocking input bridge pause/resume updates; retry failed state updates.
- Repair RustDesk input when its service remains running but its IPC socket files have disappeared. Explicit repair now restarts the service to recreate the input endpoints.

Validation: 74 frontend tests and 280 backend tests passed, along with TypeScript, ESLint, and the plugin build. RustDesk mouse and keyboard input were restored and confirmed on a Steam Deck. Long-session keyboard stability still needs broader usage testing.

hodapp/pixel-faceplate.name: Pixel Faceplate 0.3.1
hodapp/pixel-faceplate.body:
If you've got GabeCubeAura 1.5.0, Pixel Faceplate still works fine next to it, as long as GabeCubeAura's faceplate is switched off.

GabeCubeAura 1.5.0 (Alyenax's light bar plugin) came out today and it has its own JSAUX faceplate support built in now. 0.3.0 stepped aside as soon as it saw a GabeCubeAura that ships faceplate code, whether or not that faceplate was actually turned on... so with 1.5.0 installed and its faceplate off, nothing was driving the panel at all.

0.3.1 fixes that. 1.5.0 writes a claim while its faceplate is on, and Pixel Faceplate now only steps aside while that claim is live. Turn GabeCubeAura's faceplate off and within half a minute Pixel Faceplate takes the panel back, artwork, clock, random pictures and all, while GabeCubeAura keeps the light bar. Turn it back on and Pixel Faceplate lets go again. An older GabeCubeAura build with faceplate code but no way to say it's on still makes Pixel Faceplate step aside like before. So if you're on 1.5.0 and want Pixel Faceplate on the panel, switch GabeCubeAura's faceplate off in its settings. Up to you really, GabeCubeAura's faceplate wants a fair bit of setup per game and per screensaver, and Pixel Faceplate just does the artwork with no setup.

On 0.3.0 you'll get it through the built-in updater (Settings > Updates, hit Check now, then Update, and Decky asks you to confirm). On 0.2.x you need to install the ZIP by hand once (Decky > Settings > Developer > Install Plugin from ZIP File). Tested on my Steam Machine on SteamOS 3.9.5 with Decky Loader 3.3.0 and GabeCubeAura 1.5.0 with its faceplate off.

hodapp/pixel-faceplate.name: Pixel Faceplate 0.3.0
hodapp/pixel-faceplate.body:
If Pixel Faceplate is stuck on Loading... for you, this is the fix.

Decky Loader 3.3.0 came out on Oct 18, the same day as 0.2.2, and it moved its bundled Python from 3.11 to 3.14. The new build leaves out Python's termios module, which my serial code imported, so the plugin's background side crashed on load and the panel just sat there waiting forever. SteamOS has its own termios but it's built for Python 3.13, so it can't fill in. 0.3.0 does the four serial port calls it actually needs through fcntl instead. Tested on my Steam Machine on Decky 3.3.0, and it still works on 3.2.10.

If you're on 0.2.x, install this one by hand the same way as before (Decky > Settings > Developer > Install Plugin from ZIP File). After that it updates itself. It checks GitHub for a newer release when you open it, at most every 6 hours, or when you hit Check now. Tap Update and it downloads the release, checks it against the sha256 GitHub publishes, and hands it to Decky's own installer, which asks you…

hodapp/pixel-faceplate.name: Pixel Faceplate 0.2.2
hodapp/pixel-faceplate.body:
- Big thanks to @kjamert for PR #2. It added art for non-Steam games you've added to Steam (whatever art SteamGridDB put in Steam's grid folder, and if you've set custom art for any game it uses that), art from Steam's CDN for Steam games that aren't in the local library cache (it's downloaded once and kept in the plugin's folder), and random cats between games.
- Between games the panel can now show random pictures, not just cats. None of the sources need an API key: space photos from NASA's image library, the whole Earth from NASA EPIC, public domain paintings from the Art Institute of Chicago, cats (TheCatAPI, with CATAAS as backup) and twinkling stars drawn right on the console. Pick one in "Pictures of", or pick "A bit of everything" and it rotates through all of them except the cats.
- You get a new picture every 1, 3, 5 or 10 minutes (10 is the default), and there's a Next picture button. Every picture is one flash write, which is why they change every few minutes and not…

hodapp/pixel-faceplate.name: Pixel Faceplate 0.2.1
hodapp/pixel-faceplate.body:

- Style and logo position can be set for one game. While a game is…

hodapp/pixel-faceplate.name: Pixel Faceplate 0.2.0
hodapp/pixel-faceplate.body:
- Artwork style: art + logo with the dark band behind the logo (same as before), art + logo without it, art only, or logo only. A few people found the band darkened too much of the picture, so it's now up to you.
- Logo position: top, center or bottom.
- Style and logo position can be set for one game. While a game is running, turn on "Just for" that game.
- Upside down: flips the picture if you mount the faceplate with the cable coming out the right side. The included cable won't reach, so you'll need a longer one.
- The plugin now locks the serial port while it's using it, so two programs can't send to the panel at once. If something else has it, the status tells you and the plugin waits.

To update, install the new ZIP the same way as before (Decky > Settings > Developer > Install Plugin from ZIP File). Your settings carry over. Decky doesn't update plugins installed from a ZIP on its own.

raygunjohn/decky-trainers.name: v0.2.0
raygunjohn/decky-trainers.body:
## What’s new

- Shared-secret authentication protects the trainer API. The plugin creates and reuses the secret automatically.
- Request bodies are limited to 1 MiB, including chunked uploads. Oversized requests return `413` before an action runs.
- Support for 32-bit (WoW64) games, including fixes for 32-bit instruction encoding.
- Shutdown verifies that the trainer process has exited and its listener has closed. Failed stops keep tracking the process for retries.
- Status makes one API request and preserves the last confirmed attachment state while the trainer is busy.
- Trainer detection protects the game’s wineserver.

Thanks to [@coddingtonbot](https://github.com/coddingtonbot) for 32-bit support, wineserver safety and securing exposed endpoints ([#1](https://github.com/raygunjohn/decky-trainers/pull/1), [#2](https://github.com/raygunjohn/decky-trainers/pull/2), [#3](https://github.com/raygunjohn/decky-trainers/pull/3)).

## Install

1. On the Deck, press **…** (Quick Access) and open the **Decky** tab — the plug icon.
2. Tap the **⚙ gear** in the top right, then **Settings → General**, and turn on
   **Developer mode**.
3. A **Developer** tab appears in that same settings page. Open it and paste this
   into **Install Plugin from URL**:

```text
https://github.com/raygunjohn/decky-trainers/releases/download/v0.2.0/DeckyTrainers.zip
```

4. Tap **Install**. **DeckyTrainers** now shows up in the Decky menu.

## Use

Launch a game, open **…** → Decky → **DeckyTrainers**, pick a `.ct` table, and tap
**Build trainer**. When it finishes, tap ▶ to start it and **Attach** — the feature
list appears and you can flip cheats with the gamepad.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/raygunjohn/decky-trainers/compare/v0.1.2...v0.2.0

dpacc/deckcast.name: DeckCast v1.0.0
dpacc/deckcast.body:
# 📺 DeckCast v1.0.0

The first official release of DeckCast — cast your Steam Deck screen to any browser at 60fps, share recordings, upload to YouTube, and stream to Twitch. All from Gaming Mode.

## 📺 Tutorial

**[▶️ Watch the Installation Tutorial](https://youtu.be/WLSNrbv94IU)**

---

## ✨ Highlights

### 📺 Live Cast
Cast your Steam Deck screen to **any browser** on your local network at **60fps**. One tap to start.

- Hardware-accelerated capture via gpu-screen-recorder + PipeWire
- Configurable resolution (720p / 800p / 1080p) and quality (4–12 Mbps)
- ~5–8 second latency over local network
- Optional simultaneous recording while casting
- Browser player with volume control, fullscreen, and Picture-in-Picture

### 📲 Wi-Fi Transfer
Transfer recordings of any size — scan a QR code, download on any device. No internet needed.

### 🎬 YouTube Upload
Upload to YouTube from Gaming Mode. Title, tags, privacy — all configurable. Background uploads.

### ✂️ Clip Trimmer
Instant trim with zero quality loss (FFmpeg codec copy). No re-encoding.

### 📡 Live Streaming
Stream to YouTube, Twitch, or any RTMP endpoint.

---

## 🚀 Installation (Step by Step)

### Prerequisites
You need [Decky Loader](https://decky.xyz) installed on your Steam Deck. If you don't have it:
1. Go to https://decky.xyz on your Steam Deck browser
2. Follow their install instructions (takes 2 minutes)

### Option A: Install from Desktop Mode (easiest)

1. Download **DeckCast.zip** from this page (click the file at the bottom ⬇️)
2. Switch to **Desktop Mode** on your Steam Deck
3. Open the file manager (Dolphin) → navigate to **Downloads**
4. Right-click `DeckCast.zip` → **Extract** → **Extract Archive Here**
5. You should now have a `DeckCast` folder. Move it to the plugins directory:
   - Open a **second file manager window**
   - Navigate to `/home/deck/homebrew/plugins/`
   - Drag the `DeckCast` folder into `plugins/`
6. Open a terminal (**Konsole** from the app menu) and run these 3 commands one by one:
   ```
   sudo systemctl stop plugin_loader
   ```
   ```
   sleep 3
   ```
   ```
   sudo systemctl start plugin_loader
   ```
   Enter your password when prompted.
7. Switch back to **Gaming Mode** → open Quick Access Menu (`...` button) → Decky tab (🔌) → **DeckCast** is ready!

### Option B: Install via terminal (Desktop Mode)

1. Download **DeckCast.zip** from this page
2. Switch to **Desktop Mode**
3. Open **Konsole** (terminal) and run:
   ```bash
   # Go to Downloads (or wherever you saved the zip)
   cd ~/Downloads

   # Unzip to plugins folder
   sudo unzip -o DeckCast.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/

   # Restart the plugin loader (NEVER use 'restart' — always stop/start)
   sudo systemctl stop plugin_loader
   sleep 3
   sudo systemctl start plugin_loader
   ```
4. Switch back to **Gaming Mode** — DeckCast appears in Decky!

### Option C: Install from another computer via SSH

Make sure SSH is enabled on your Deck (**Settings → Developer → Enable SSH**).

```bash
# 1. Download the zip to your computer
curl -L https://github.com/dPacc/DeckCast/releases/download/v1.0.0/DeckCast.zip \
  -o /tmp/DeckCast.zip

# 2. Upload the zip to your Deck
scp /tmp/DeckCast.zip deck@DECK_IP:/tmp/DeckCast.zip

# 3. SSH into your Deck
ssh deck@DECK_IP

# 4. Unzip to plugins folder
sudo unzip -o /tmp/DeckCast.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/

# 5. Restart plugin loader (stop → wait → start)
sudo systemctl stop plugin_loader
sleep 3
sudo systemctl start plugin_loader
```

Replace `DECK_IP` with your Deck's IP address (find it in **Settings → Network → your Wi-Fi → IP Address**).

> ⚠️ **Never use `systemctl restart plugin_loader`** — it causes a port conflict crash loop that requires a hard reboot. Always use **stop → sleep 3 → start**.

---

## 🎮 How to Use

1. Open the **Quick Access Menu** ( `...` button) in Gaming Mode
2. Go to the **Decky** tab (🔌 plug icon)
3. Tap **DeckCast**
4. Tap **Start Casting**
5. The cast URL appears on screen (e.g. `http://192.168.1.231:8420/cast`)
6. Open that URL on **any device's browser** on the same Wi-Fi — your Deck screen streams live at 60fps!

To stop: tap **Stop Casting** on the Deck, or click **Stop** in the browser.

---

## 📋 Requirements

- Steam Deck running SteamOS 3.x
- [Decky Loader](https://decky.xyz) installed
- gpu-screen-recorder (pre-installed on most SteamOS setups)
- FFmpeg (pre-installed on SteamOS)

For YouTube upload features only:
```bash
pip install google-auth google-auth-oauthlib google-api-python-client qrcode Pillow
```

otisabiburada/finally-3d-game-cases-plug.body:
## Finally 3D Game Cases 1.11.1

Install the new zip the same way as before. It replaces the old version and keeps all your looks, wears, names and settings.

### New
- **Eject animation when you quit a game.** The case flies out and opens, the disc (or game card) comes back out of the slot, drops into its tray, and the case closes and flies back to its place. It has its own switch and a **Preview the eject** button, and works without the insert animation too.
- **Shrink-wrap tear on first launch.** A sealed game (never played, or set to *Sealed*) gets its shrink-wrap ripped off when you launch it, with crinkle and rip sounds, then the case opens as usual. A game you set to *Sealed* yourself switches to normal wear afterwards.
- **Less motion.** Choose *Full motion*, *Less on battery* or *Less motion* under Effects. It turns off the drifting, the foil shine and the leaning neighbours; the covers stay 3D. *Less on battery* switches back when you plug in.
- **Template frames.** Use printed console frames instead of plain colours, for example the SteamGridDB [Templates](https://www.steamgriddb.com/collection/20087) collection by MANE0395. Put the pictures in `~/homebrew/settings/3d-game-cases/templates/` and press **Reload templates** (Looks, colours and presets → Colours → Templates). Each frame becomes a look for a game, a collection or the default, with the game's art inside the frame's window. No frames are included in the plugin.

### Faster
- **Near-zero cost at rest.** Covers you're not on are now flat 2D with the same look, so no extra GPU layers. Only the game you're on becomes 3D, and the turn in and out look the same as before.
- **Nothing animates forever.** The gentle drift plays two slow cycles and stops.
- **Sleeps while you play.** While a game is running the plugin stops watching Steam's pages, stops its timers and pauses its animations, then catches up when you quit.

### Fixed
- **Huge, blocky ghost with a white ring around the focused game on Home.** Steam draws a blurred glow copy of each cover next to the real one, and its newer scrambled class names meant the plugin turned that copy into a case too. The copy is now recognised by where it sits and left alone.
- **Insert animation sometimes played twice.** When Steam Cloud sync (or a cloud conflict dialog) delayed the game's start, the launch was counted twice. The animation now plays once per launch.
- **Black case and disc in the insert animation with 3D cases off.** The animation now finds the game's cover on screen by itself, or loads Steam's art or your custom art.
- **Strong perspective from Steam magnified the tilted case.** The plugin now uses its own perspective. Wide items also tilt a bit less.

Download `Finally-3D-Game-Cases-v1.11.1.zip` below and install it from Decky (*Install Plugin from URL* with this zip's link, or *Install Plugin from ZIP File*).

Update from 1.9.0: install the new zip the same way as before. It replaces the old version and keeps all your looks, wears, names and settings.

### Fixed: huge, blocky ghost with a white ring around the focused game on Home
- Steam's Home draws every cover twice: the real cover inside the tile you move onto (a role=link Focusable), and a blurred glow copy in a box right next to it, outside that tile. Steam's class names are scrambled now, so the plugin no longer recognised the copy and turned it into a case too. On focus that copy was tilted, un-blurred and drawn on top of the real cover.
- The copy is now recognised by where it sits (same picture, next to the cover, outside Steam's focus target), is never turned into a case, and keeps Steam's own glow. When two copies can't be told apart, both are kept, so the real cover is never dropped.
- Works whichever of the two Steam creates first, and when Steam re-creates them. On Home the panel now shows about as many…

Updating from 1.8.2: install this zip the same way you installed 1.8.2. It replaces the old version and keeps all your looks and settings. **New: insert animation with its own switch. Press Play in the library or on a game page and the case opens, and the disc (printed with the game's art) goes into the slot, with sounds. Choose to play it before or after Steam's game logo. Works with or without the 3D cases.**

* Added clear instructions on how to use custom `.bin` vehicle/character files so they persist across game updates.

### 🧹 Quality of Life & Repository Cleanup
* Purged duplicate stray Python scripts and old build files from the root directory to keep the repository extremely lightweight.
* Officially added the BSD-3-Clause `LICENSE` file to maintain proper open-source compliance with the original upstream architecture.

feelsrat/decky-renodx.name: Decky RenoDX v0.5.1
feelsrat/decky-renodx.body:
### Fixes
- **Steam Deck OLED peak brightness was set to 604 nits instead of 1000.** The panel's EDID reports about 604 nits, but SteamOS's compositor (gamescope) ignores that and uses its own profile for the panel: 1000 nits peak, 800 full-frame. Games see gamescope's values, so the plugin now uses them for the Deck OLED, the Zotac Zone and the OneXPlayer F1. Games set up with 0.5.0 show **Repair**. It replaces the old automatic value, and anything you set yourself is kept.

feelsrat/decky-renodx.name: Decky RenoDX v0.5.0
feelsrat/decky-renodx.body:
### New
- **Brightness matched to your screen.** On install, the plugin reads the active screen's HDR peak brightness from its EDID. Docked, that's the external screen. A Steam Deck OLED that reports none counts as 1000 nits. The value goes in:
  - **RenoDX**: as the mod's peak brightness (`ToneMapPeakNits`) in `ReShade.ini`.
  - **Special K**: as its HDR luminance.

  The screen and its peak are shown under Plugin → "Match brightness to the screen", which turns this off.

### Fixes
- **Reinstalling or Repair no longer resets your RenoDX settings.** Changes made in the RenoDX tab (presets, sliders) are carried over, and they win over the automatic brightness.

feelsrat/decky-renodx.name: Decky RenoDX v0.4.6
feelsrat/decky-renodx.body:
### Fixes
- **Unity games got ReShade as `opengl32.dll`, so it never showed up.** `UnityPlayer.dll` always links OpenGL, but Unity renders with Direct3D 11/12 on Windows, loading it at runtime. The plugin saw only the OpenGL import and hooked the wrong API: ReShade loaded, but never saw a frame. There was no banner, Home did nothing, and RenoDX never ran (Against the Storm, Wobbly Life). Unity games now get `dxgi.dll`, as in 0.0.x. Affected installs show **Repair**.
- When the graphics API is only a guess from a game DLL's imports, PCGamingWiki's API list wins if it has one.

novasound6945/deckygram.name: Deckygram v0.7.7
novasound6945/deckygram.body:
### Changed / 변경

- Clip quality is one list now: frame and bitrate together, sixteen rows,
  each stating the rate the encoder will use and what a minute weighs at
  it. The two separate choices had a gap between them: the bitrate did not
  follow the frame, so 480p came out the same size as 800p, and a
  one-minute clip came out at 43 MB whatever was picked because the size
  limit was deciding (reported 2026-09-16: "all qualities and fps and
  bitrate produced the same file size"). The reference is 800p at
  12.8 Mbit/s, a touch above the most a Deck records, so that row means
  the recording as it is; the other three are Steam's own tiers, and each
  smaller frame gets the same four scaled by pixel count - 480p has 36 %
  of the pixels and gets 36 % of the rate. "As recorded" is gone as a
  choice: a setting that held it lands on the top row for its frame, and
  an older 800p figure stored with a smaller frame lands on the scaled row.
  클립 화질이 목록 하나가 됐습니다. 화면 크기와 비트레이트를 한 줄로
  고르며, 열여섯 줄 각각이 인코더가 쓸 값과 그 값으로 1분을 보낼 때
  무게를 적습니다. 따로 고르던 두 설정 사이에 빈틈이 있었습니다.
  비트레이트가 화면 크기를 따라가지 않아 480p가 800p와 같은 크기로
  나왔고, 1분 클립은 무엇을 골라도 크기 한도가 결정해 43 MB였습니다
  (2026-09-16 리포트: "화질, fps, 비트레이트를 바꿔도 같은 크기"). 기준은
  800p·12.8 Mbit/s로 덱 녹화 최대치보다 살짝 위라 그 줄이 곧 녹화본
  그대로이고, 나머지 셋은 스팀 자체 등급이며, 작은 화면은 같은 네 줄에
  화소 비율을 곱해 받습니다. 480p는 화소가 36%라 36%를 받습니다. "원본"
  선택지는 사라졌고, 저장돼 있던 "원본"은 그 화면의 최고 줄로, 작은
  화면과 함께 저장된 예전 800p 숫자는 비례한 줄로 옮겨집니다.

- A 60 fps recording sent at 30 fps keeps the bits each frame was given
  rather than the bits per second, so it comes out about half the size.
  Before, the ceiling stayed at the recording's whole rate and the halved
  frames simply got twice the bits each, which cannot add detail the
  frames never had.
  60fps 녹화를 30fps로 보내면 초당 비트가 아니라 프레임마다 받던 비트를
  유지해 파일이 절반쯤 됩니다. 전에는 상한이 녹화 전체 비트레이트에
  머물러 절반이 된 프레임이 각각 두 배의 비트를 받았는데, 그건 프레임에
  없던 디테일을 더해 주지 못합니다.

### Fixed / 수정

- Clip captions were hours off. Steam names a clip folder in UTC, and the
  caption printed those digits as they were, so a clip taken at 19:58 read
  16:58 - or, in Korea, one taken at 00:30 read 15:30 the day before. The
  folder time is now read as UTC and shown in the Deck's own zone.
  Screenshots were never affected; their captions come from the file's
  own time.
  클립 캡션의 시각이 몇 시간씩 어긋났습니다. 스팀은 클립 폴더 이름을
  UTC로 짓는데 캡션이 그 숫자를 그대로 찍어서, 19:58에 찍은 클립이
  16:58로, 한국에서는 00:30에 찍은 클립이 전날 15:30으로 나갔습니다. 이제
  폴더 시각을 UTC로 읽어 덱의 시간대로 표시합니다. 스크린샷은 파일 자체의
  시각을 쓰므로 원래 문제가 없었습니다.

- The queued-clips size shown in the panel never exceeds what the
  recordings weigh on disk, whatever row is picked; before, only "as
  recorded" was quoted that way.
  패널의 대기 클립 용량 예상치가 어떤 줄을 골라도 녹화본의 실제 크기를
  넘지 않습니다. 전에는 "원본"을 골랐을 때만 그렇게 견적했습니다.

### Thanks / 감사

- **@EslamBradwil**, for the size table across every setting and for
  spotting the clock.
  설정별 크기 표와 시각 문제를 짚어 주신 **@EslamBradwil**님, 이번에도
  고맙습니다.

novasound6945/deckygram.name: Deckygram v0.7.6
novasound6945/deckygram.body:
### Changed / 변경

- Clips are decoded on the GPU as well as encoded there. v0.7.5 put the
  hardware encoder first but still decoded in software, and on the Deck
  that decode was most of the cost: a 15-second 60 fps clip going to
  480p spent 8.4 CPU-seconds across nearly six threads in one burst.
  With the decode on the video block, the frame-rate drop done on GPU
  frames, and a software scale in between only when a smaller frame is
  asked for, the same clip spends 3.7 CPU-seconds on about one thread;
  at the recorded size, 1.5 CPU-seconds on half a thread. The output is
  identical - SSIM against the same reference agrees to six digits -
  and the encode still runs at about five times real time. Software
  decode into the same encoder stays as the fallback, and x264 behind it.
  클립을 인코딩뿐 아니라 디코딩도 GPU에서 합니다. v0.7.5는 하드웨어
  인코더를 1순위로 뒀지만 디코딩은 여전히 소프트웨어였고, 덱에서는 그
  디코딩이 비용의 대부분이었습니다. 15초짜리 60fps 클립을 480p로 보내는
  데 CPU 8.4초를 스레드 여섯 개 가까이에 한꺼번에 몰아 썼습니다. 디코딩을
  비디오 블록으로 옮기고, 프레임 수는…

novasound6945/deckygram.name: Deckygram v0.7.5
novasound6945/deckygram.body:
### Changed / 변경

- Clips are encoded on the GPU again, still as H.264. v0.7.4 moved the
  encode to the CPU for a small gain in picture (SSIM 0.9537 against
  0.9407 for the hardware encoder) and paid for it with three times the
  encode time - and on the Deck's APU the CPU and the GPU draw on the
  same power budget, so an encode running during play takes frames from
  the game. The gap is not visible at phone size; the frame drops are.
  The hardware H.264 encoder now goes first, the frame is still scaled
  in software, and x264 stays behind it as the fallback, capped at two
  threads so that even the fallback leaves the game most of the CPU.
  HEVC and the GPU scaler stay out.
  클립을 다시 GPU에서 인코딩합니다. 코덱은 그대로 H.264입니다. v0.7.4는
  약간의 화질(SSIM 0.9537, 하드웨어 인코더는 0.9407)을 위해 인코딩을
  CPU로 옮겼고, 그 대가로 인코딩 시간이 세 배가 됐습니다. 덱의 APU는 CPU와
  GPU가 전력 예산을 나눠 쓰므로, 플레이 중에 돌아가는 인코딩은 게임의
  프레임을 가져갑니다. 그 화질 차이는 휴대폰 화면에서 보이지 않지만 프레임
  저하는 보입니다. 이제 하드웨어 H.264 인코더가 1순위이고, 크기 조정은
  여전히 소프트웨어로 하며, x264는 폴백으로…

novasound6945/deckygram.name: Deckygram v0.7.4
novasound6945/deckygram.body:
### Fixed / 수정

- Picking 30 fps did nothing to a 60 fps recording. The frame rate is
  set during the encode, and a clip small enough to send skipped the
  encode - the same gap that made the resolution cap do nothing.
  30fps를 골라도 60fps 녹화가 그대로 나갔습니다. 프레임 수는 인코딩할 때
  정해지는데, 전송 가능한 크기의 클립은 인코딩을 건너뛰었습니다. 해상도
  상한이 동작하지 않던 것과 같은 자리입니다.

### Changed / 변경

- Clips go out as H.264, the codec Steam records in, and the scaling is
  done in software. Both had been chosen for speed and both were
  costing picture. Measured on a Deck at 2.5 Mbit/s from one source,
  as SSIM against that source: libx264 0.9537, h264_vaapi 0.9407,
  hevc_vaapi 0.9345, and the previous first choice - HEVC with the GPU
  scaler - 0.9310. The files are within 5 % of each other in size.
  Encoding takes longer for it; a 48-second clip went from 5 to 15
  seconds.
  클립을 스팀이 녹화하는 코덱인 H.264로 내보내고, 크기 조정도
  소프트웨어로 합니다. 둘 다 속도를 위해 고른 것이었는데 둘 다 화질을 깎고
  있었습니다. 같은 원본 2.5 Mbit/s 기준 덱 실측 SSIM은 libx264 0.9537,
  h264_vaapi…

novasound6945/deckygram.name: Deckygram v0.7.3
novasound6945/deckygram.body:
### Fixed / 수정

- The resolution cap did nothing. A clip small enough to send skipped
  the encode, and the scale went with it, so 480p went out at the
  recorded size. Forcing the encode then hit a second problem: with the
  bitrate on "as recorded" the encode was aimed at whatever the size
  limit allowed - 26 Mbit/s for a short clip - so the smaller frame came
  out larger than the original and was thrown away for it. The encode is
  now capped at the source rate and the scaled file is the one sent.
  해상도 상한이 동작하지 않았습니다. 전송 가능한 크기의 클립은 인코딩을
  건너뛰는데 그때 크기 조정도 같이 건너뛰어서, 480p를 골라도 녹화된 크기
  그대로 나갔습니다. 인코딩을 강제하니 두 번째 문제가 드러났습니다.
  비트레이트가 '원본 그대로'면 용량 제한이 허용하는 값(짧은 클립은
  26 Mbit/s)을 목표로 잡아서, 작아진 화면이 원본보다 커지고 그 이유로
  버려졌습니다. 이제 원본 비트레이트를 넘지 않게 잡고, 크기를 조정한
  파일을 전송합니다.

### Changed / 변경

- The gallery list is five times quicker to open. It no longer walks
  every file in the recording folders to date them - the folder's own
  timestamp does - and reads each clip's length only for the rows…

  proven MoonDeck anchor model: a zero-height anchor in Steam's header context,
  absolute native focus-group positioning, and TopCapsule visibility tracking.

## Sonnenschein Client 0.2.1-test — Stream-Button funktioniert jetzt wirklich

### Behoben nach echtem Deck-Test

**Der Stream startete nicht.** Ursache: Unser eigener Easy-Mode-Code sondierte bei jedem frischen Stream-Start (jeder Decky-Start ist einer) einmal die komplette Hardware-Decoder-Fähigkeit — direkt gefolgt von der echten, ebenfalls vollständigen Decoder-Initialisierung des Streams selbst. Dieser doppelte GPU-Auf-/Abbau im selben Prozess, unmittelbar hintereinander, war auf dem PC nie aufgefallen (dort läuft der Client über mehrere Starts weiter), traf aber jeden einzelnen Deck-Start. Die Easy-Mode-Sondierung nutzt jetzt eine schlanke Variante ohne Decoder-Erstellung — die volle Sondierung bleibt exklusiv dem Diagnose-Befehl vorbehalten. Zusätzlich: **jeder Fehlschlag beim Stream-Start wird jetzt sichtbar angezeigt** statt lautlos die App zu beenden — sollte trotzdem mal etwas schiefgehen, siehst du jetzt genau warum.

**Der Button war zu groß und hat die Seite kaputt…

artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.name: v0.4.1
artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.body:
## What's Changed (since v0.4.0)

Three additions on top of v0.4.0's trust-network feature, all aimed at keeping the receiver healthy when network state isn't immediately useful:

### Boot-time DNS race
- At Steam Deck boot, NetworkManager reports wifi as `active` before DNS is reachable, so `receiver.start()` could fail with `fetch failed` errors against YouTube's lounge API and take down the whole plugin (`Backend process ended before signaling READY`).
- Initial reconcile is now wrapped in try/catch — failure no longer kills the plugin.
- Network poll always runs reconcile (not just on change), so a failed initial start auto-retries every 10s until DNS comes up.

### SSDP rebind across trusted networks
- SSDP/DIAL multicast sockets are interface-specific. Switching networks while advertising left the socket on the old interface, so the phone couldn't see the receiver on the new one.
- New `boundNetworkUuid` tracks the interface the receiver bound to. If it differs from `currentNetwork.uuid` while advertising, reconcile stops + restarts so SSDP rebinds.

### Log hygiene
- Reconcile only logs on actual state change (not every 10s poll).
- `safeReconcile` suppresses repeated identical error messages and prints `Reconcile recovered after prior failure` on success after a previous failure.

## Full Changelog
https://github.com/artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1

artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.name: v0.5.0
artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.body:
## What's Changed

This is the v0.3.0 stable model (single `Receiver Enabled` toggle, persisted across reboots, default off) with the v0.4.0 install-on-top fix kept in. The trust-network feature from v0.4.x has been removed — it had unresolved boot-time race conditions where the receiver tried to start before DNS was reachable.

### Kept from v0.4.x

- `main.py` stages `bin/node` and `bin/yt-dlp` to `/tmp/youtube-cast-receiver` before exec. Plugin-folder binaries are never busy, so Decky's reinstall `extractall` can't hit Linux `ETXTBSY`. **Reinstall on top works without manual uninstall.**
- Process-group `SIGTERM`/`SIGKILL` via `os.killpg` with bounded waits and a 200ms grace so any `yt-dlp`/`nmcli` grandchildren are reaped before unload returns.
- Shutdown fail-safe: 1.5s hard exit, `receiver.stop()` raced against 1s timer.
- Stale-session timeout bumped 5 min → 30 min so paused tracks don't drop the cast session.

### Removed

- Trust-network feature, `backend/src/network.ts`, all…

artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.name: v0.4.0
artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.body:
## New Features

- **Trust this network** — A single toggle on the player page lets you mark the current Wi-Fi (or ethernet) connection as trusted. The receiver only advertises while connected to a trusted network, and automatically stops when you roam to an untrusted one. Roam back and it resumes within 10 seconds.
- Replaces the previous `Receiver Enabled` toggle. Trust list is keyed by connection name (SSID), stable across reconnects.

## Bug Fixes

- **Reinstall on top now bulletproof** — `main.py` stages `bin/node` and `bin/yt-dlp` to `/tmp/youtube-cast-receiver/` at startup and executes from there. The plugin folder's binaries become static files Decky can overwrite freely; `extractall` can't hit Linux `ETXTBSY` regardless of what children are running at unload time.
- **Stale-session timeout** bumped 5 min → 30 min. Pausing music briefly no longer drops the session.
- **Tighter unload** — extra `SIGKILL` to the process group plus 200ms grace after `wait` reaps orphaned `yt-dlp`…

artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.name: v0.3.0
artistro08/youtube-cast-receiver.body:
## Bug Fixes

- **Install-on-top no longer hangs** — Decky's reinstall flow extracts the new ZIP over the existing plugin directory. If our Node process or its orphaned `yt-dlp` children still held `bin/node` or `bin/yt-dlp` open, Linux returned `ETXTBSY` and the extract hung at `Installing plugin...` indefinitely.
  - `main.py` now spawns Node in its own session/process group (`start_new_session=True`) and tears it down via `os.killpg`, killing yt-dlp orphans alongside Node
  - All `process.wait()` calls run in a thread executor with bounded `asyncio.wait_for` timeouts (2s SIGTERM, 3s SIGKILL safety) — no more event loop blocking
  - `server.ts` has a 1.5s hard-limit fail-safe and races `receiver.stop()` against a 1s timer so SSDP teardown stalls can't keep us alive

You can now reinstall the plugin on top of itself without a manual uninstall first.

## UI / Copy Refinements

- Player idle text mentions YouTube Music explicitly
- Subtitle line only renders when the track has an…

# NetDeck v1.0.31

Advanced networking plugin for Steam Deck and handheld PCs.

## Features
- MAC address spoofing for bypassing network restrictions
- WiFi hotspot creation with dual-adapter support
- Internet sharing through NAT bridging
- Hidden SSID support for privacy
- Secure credential generation with anonymous SSIDs
- Connected client monitoring and management

3. Restart Decky Loader

## Compatible Devices
- Most devices running SteamOS

## Requirements
- Two WiFi adapters (built-in + USB adapter recommended)
- NetworkManager for connection management
- Root permissions for network configuration

18798aa12/deckyproxy.name: v0.2.6 — SteamOS 筛选与更新兼容修复
18798aa12/deckyproxy.body:
v0.2.6 包含复杂筛选与 SteamOS Python 3.13 空匹配兼容修复，并解决开启 TUN 时检查更新失败的问题。

- 固定更新、镜像及 GitHub 发行 CDN 域名使用真实 DNS，避免虚拟 IP 被安全下载器拒绝；继续拒绝内网/保留地址。此改动覆盖插件更新链路。
- Decky 冻结后端默认 CA 为空时加载固定系统证书库；保留 HTTPS 证书链、主机名和发行签名验证，无系统信任时明确失败。
- 插件状态、更新器及健康确认统一读取安装包版本；个人订阅、规则、节点选择和设置保持在独立目录。

验证：483 项本地 Python 测试通过，覆盖率 89.49%；[Linux CI](https://github.com/18798aa12/DeckyProxy/actions/runs/39476513858) 的前后端、Python 3.13、真实内核组成员 API、隔离 TUN 启停、打包与脱敏全部通过。

Steam Deck Python 3.13.5 实机已完成更新后的配置校验、代理启动、节点和策略组读取、TUN 接口及专用路由、HTTPS 连网，以及开启 TUN 时插件内检查更新（签名验证成功）。个人配置文件与升级前逐字节一致。休眠、Wi-Fi 切换、UDP 等完整验收仍待补充。

安装包自带锁定内核和离线 GEO/ASN 数据，源码与许可证随同提供。SHA256SUMS、update.json 及 Ed25519 签名随包发布，不包含个人订阅链接、凭证或运行配置。

18798aa12/deckyproxy.name: v0.2.5 — 修复 SteamOS 筛选兼容与版本一致性
18798aa12/deckyproxy.body:
> 后续兼容修复：SteamOS Python 3.13 的筛选、TUN 下更新 DNS 与 Decky 系统证书问题已在 [v0.2.6](https://github.com/18798aa12/DeckyProxy/releases/tag/v0.2.6) 修复，建议直接使用最新版。

v0.2.5 修复 SteamOS Python 3.13 对空筛选结果 `(?!)` 的解析优化导致“节点筛选表达式过于复杂”的问题，包含 v0.2.4 的复杂筛选兼容改进。无需修改订阅中的表达式。

同时将更新器、状态显示与健康确认统一到安装包版本，避免重复更新提示或错误回退。更新保留个人配置，安装前停止代理。

验证：
- 478 项本地 Python 测试通过，后端覆盖率 89.43%；生产构建、Ruff、安装包/源码脱敏审计与更新签名验签通过。
- [Linux CI](https://github.com/18798aa12/DeckyProxy/actions/runs/39474875873) 全部通过，包括新增 Python 3.13 后端检查、真实内核筛选 API 与隔离 TUN 启停。
- Steam Deck Python 3.13.5 上已完成实际保存配置的预检、Decky 安装升级、节点/策略组读取、TUN 接口及路由、普通 HTTPS 与 GitHub API 联网检查；个人订阅及设置校验保持一致。休眠、Wi-Fi 切换、UDP 等完整验收仍待补充。

安装包自带 Mihomo v1.19.32 Linux amd64-v1 内核及离线 GEO/ASN 数据。源码、许可证、SHA256SUMS 与签名更新清单随同发布；个人配置、订阅链接及凭证不在安装包或源码内。

18798aa12/deckyproxy.name: v0.2.4 — 修复复杂节点筛选兼容性
18798aa12/deckyproxy.body:
> 后续兼容修复：SteamOS Python 3.13 的筛选、TUN 下更新 DNS 与 Decky 系统证书问题已在 [v0.2.6](https://github.com/18798aa12/DeckyProxy/releases/tag/v0.2.6) 修复，建议直接使用最新版。

v0.2.4 修复导入或启动订阅时，合法节点筛选被误报“过于复杂”的问题。嵌套前瞻、复合重复、长多分支与更多反引号分段会在限时隔离进程中计算，然后转为精确节点名称匹配，继续保留策略组和规则。

- 不再仅因表达式结构复杂而拒绝；语法、容量、处理失败和实际执行超时分别提示。
- 单个原始筛选支持最多 16 KiB UTF-8，保留 CPU、内存、总输出大小限制，避免卡住后端。仍有 Python/Mihomo 正则扩展及 Unicode 语义兼容范围，详见 README。
- 更新包校验要求包含完整筛选运行模块。更新保留个人订阅、规则和设置；先停止代理，再从插件“检查更新”安装。
- 本地 466 项 Python 测试与 80 项前端测试通过，后端覆盖率 89.38%，类型检查、Ruff、生产构建、真实内核组成员 API 校验、安装包与源码脱敏审计及更新清单签名验签通过。

Linux CI 已通过前后端、打包脱敏、真实内核筛选 API 和隔离网络/挂载空间的 TUN 启停及清理检查：[验证记录](https://github.com/18798aa12/DeckyProxy/actions/runs/39472529418)。

安装包自带 Linux amd64-v1 Mihomo 内核和离线 GEO/ASN 数据。源码及许可证随同发布。此版本尚未在 Steam Deck 真机完成更新后的验收。

18798aa12/deckyproxy.name: v0.2.3 - TUN 修复与折叠策略组
18798aa12/deckyproxy.body:
修复开启 TUN 后误报“路由未建立”、内核自动停止且策略组消失的问题，并默认折叠策略组与节点列表。

- 兼容 iproute2 的字符串路由表编号，并使用数字输出检查专用路由表及规则冲突。
- 对路由 JSON 和优先级做边界检查；错误接口、错误表号和缺失路由仍会拒绝启动。
- 增加真实 Linux 内核的隔离网络命名空间 TUN 启停、策略组及专用路由清理检查。
- 策略组与节点默认折叠；点击或按 A 展开总列表，再展开需要的策略组选择节点和测速。轮询保留展开状态，切换配置或停止代理后重新折叠。
- 保留本地 YAML 导入、原始策略组/规则与 B 键修复。升级前停止代理；个人配置保留，无需重新导入 YAML。

验证：前后端测试、类型与静态检查、Linux 真实内核/规则/TUN 检查、安装包与源码附件脱敏及签名校验。Linux 隔离检查不等同于 Steam Deck 上的 DNS、UDP、休眠或更新全流程验收。

安装包已包含锁定内核与离线数据，无需另行下载内核。SHA256SUMS 提供校验值，配套源码附件包含项目及精确版本的上游源码。update.json 与签名用于插件更新。尚未上架 Decky 官方商店。

18798aa12/deckyproxy.name: DeckyProxy v0.2.2
18798aa12/deckyproxy.body:
修复选择 YAML 后没有反应，以及 B 键提示后仍无法返回 Decky 的问题。

- 原生文件选择器隐藏快捷菜单时保留面板实例，选择完成后继续导入；隐藏期间不抢回焦点。
- 按钮旁分别显示“正在选择 YAML 文件…”与“正在导入 YAML…”，成功或失败提示持续保留，不被后台状态轮询清除。
- 导入成功后在配置列表中选中新配置；已有活动配置时，仍需点击“使用此配置”才切换。
- B 键直接监听 Steam 原生取消事件，第一次拦截并提示，2 秒内第二次正常传给 Decky；长按重复事件不算第二次。

v1k0d3n/monoink.body:
## What's new in v0.1.2

A fix release for installing and updating.

### Fixed
- **ZIP updates no longer stall.** Updating with *Install Plugin from ZIP
  File* while monoink was running could stop part-way, leaving Decky's
  install dialog spinning. monoink now runs a private copy of its program,
  so Decky can always replace the plugin's files during an update.

### Updating from v0.1.1
Update **once using Install Plugin from URL** (the link below). A ZIP update
from v0.1.1 can still stall, because v0.1.1 itself has the old behavior;
from v0.1.2 onward, either method works.

If a link install seems to hang for a minute or two at the start, leave it
running: Decky first reports the install to its own plugin-store server and
waits for it even when that server is slow.

### Documentation
- The README's status line no longer names a specific version; see the
  Releases page for the latest.
- The install guide and privacy page cover the above.

## Install or update

1. In Gaming Mode, open Quick Access (**⋯**) → **Decky** → ⚙ **Settings**, and turn on **Developer mode**.
2. Decky → **Developer** → **Install Plugin from URL**:
   `https://github.com/v1k0d3n/monoink/releases/latest/download/monoink.zip`
3. Or download **monoink-v0.1.2.zip** below and use **Install Plugin from ZIP File**.

Updating keeps your settings. Full guide: [docs/install.md](https://github.com/v1k0d3n/monoink/blob/v0.1.2/docs/install.md)


## What's Changed
* README: make the status line version-agnostic by @v1k0d3n in https://github.com/v1k0d3n/monoink/pull/22
* Fix ZIP updates stalling while the plugin is running by @v1k0d3n in https://github.com/v1k0d3n/monoink/pull/23
* Release v0.1.2 by @v1k0d3n in https://github.com/v1k0d3n/monoink/pull/24


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/v1k0d3n/monoink/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2

codevski/decky-ftpd.name: v0.1.4
codevski/decky-ftpd.body:
### Added
- Username/password authentication, on by default with credentials `deck` / `deck` (editable in Settings).
- Anonymous (no-password) mode as an opt-in toggle, gated by a confirmation prompt.
- Login row on the main panel showing the active username (or "anonymous").

### Changed
- Root directory is now locked to `/`. Navigate to subdirectories from your FTP client. This sidesteps a "no access" bug seen when the configured root resolved through a symlink (notably `/run/media` for the SD card).
- Settings modal: removed the Root directory field; added Username, Password, and Anonymous access controls.
- Quick Paths panel removed from the main screen.
- Settings moved from a bottom button to a gear icon in the panel title bar. The Options section is gone; the QAM panel is now action-only.
- Login and Sharing rows merged into a single line (`<user> · /`) to tighten the FTP Server section.

### Migration
- Existing installations with a custom `root_dir` setting will start serving `/` after upgrade. Authentication is on by default, so existing users automatically gain credential protection.

otisabiburada/decky-video-pip.body:
## Video PiP 0.6.0 (beta)

Watch YouTube in a small window **over your game** in Gaming Mode, and pick what plays from your phone.

### Highlights
- **Cast from the YouTube app**: the Deck shows up as **Steam Deck** in the app's cast list. Your phone is the remote
  (play, pause, seek, volume, next, queue, subtitles). A **TV code** works when the Deck isn't in the list.
- **Floating window** in any corner, any size, drawn over games.
- **Subtitles on/off** and a **video-only volume** slider (game sound untouched).
- **Phone link**: scan a QR code, paste a link.
- **Nothing in the window opens a browser**; YouTube's overlays are hidden.
- Optional: **hide the window while the Steam / Quick Access menu is open**.
- Casting **on/off** and **Disconnect phones**; reconnects after sleep.

### Install
Decky settings > Developer mode on > **Developer** > **Install Plugin from URL**:
Or download `video-pip-v0.6.0.zip` below and use **Install Plugin from ZIP File**.

### Known limits
- Videos whose owner blocks embedding can't play (skipped). Ads play as normal. Not signed in on the Deck.
- Phone and Deck must be on the same Wi-Fi; guest networks with client isolation block discovery (use the TV code).
- Uses undocumented Steam internals for the overlay; a Steam update can break it (More > Help > Check setup).

Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

vindeckyy/slipstream.name: v0.24.0
vindeckyy/slipstream.body:
# Slipstream 0.24.0

Slipstream 0.24.0 brings the streaming host to Windows, alongside web console polish and
hardening across the Linux host paths.

## Supported downloads

- Linux x86_64 host archive
- Steam Deck client Flatpak
- Steam Deck Decky plugin zip
- Android clients continue on the rolling `v0.23.0-public` release

## Windows host (new)

A Windows PC can now be the streaming host. Build `slipstream-host` and `slipstream-tray` on
Windows (MSVC or GNU toolchain); the Linux, Android, and Steam Deck clients connect to it the
same way they connect to a Linux host. See the [Windows host guide](https://vindeckyy.github.io/slipstream/docs/windows-host).

- **Capture:** Windows Graphics Capture with DXGI fallback (`SLIPSTREAM_CAPTURE_METHOD` selects
  `auto`, `wgc`, or `dxgi`); the pointer is embedded in the frame.
- **Encode:** NVIDIA NVENC over D3D11 when the driver answers, with the honest codec list from the
  driver probe; openh264 H.264 software fallback otherwise.
- **Display:** Mirror a monitor by default, or plug a RustDesk indirect display when that driver
  is installed.
- **Audio:** WASAPI loopback capture with resample/remap to 48 kHz.
- **Input:** `SendInput` keyboard/mouse/pen injection with native Unicode text; host cursor hides
  during sessions. (A virtual gamepad is not wired up yet.)
- **Clipboard:** Text, HTML, RTF, and PNG in both directions.
- **Service & tray:** Run headless under the Service Control Manager (`sc create slipstream-host`),
  with a system-tray icon for service state, console deep links, and pairing approvals.
- **QoS:** MMCSS and qWAVE cover the low-latency profile.

AMD AMF and Intel Quick Sync are not encode backends on Windows; requesting them fails loudly
instead of silently substituting.

## Web console

- Library empty state redesigned as an intentional dashed affordance.
- Getting Started and pairing PIN presentation refined.
- Design tokens, shell density, and chart palette reworked with light/dark parity.

## Host hardening

- Cursor, frame-queue, and video paths hardened (TV-only cursor visibility, queue occupancy
  reservation, defensive cropping of unaligned frames on older drivers).
- Settings: shared guidance, dependency-aware configuration, safer saves.
- Clippy 1.96 hygiene across the workspace.

## Operations

- Release artifacts include SHA-256 checksums, third-party notices, SBOM, and build provenance
  attestations.
- The repository scans full Git history for secrets and validates first-party links, generated
  API files, packaging metadata, and pinned GitHub Actions.

See the [installation guide](https://vindeckyy.github.io/slipstream/docs/install) and
[security policy](https://github.com/vindeckyy/slipstream/security/policy) before exposing a host
outside a trusted LAN.

ch1mpleo/decky-dns-unblock.name: DNS Unblock v0.2.0
ch1mpleo/decky-dns-unblock.body:
Reliability release: Automatic provider selection with DNS + HTTPS checks, safer restore,
honest diagnostics, and clearer status.

### Features

- **Provider Automatic** (default on new installs): try Cloudflare → Google → Quad9 (then plain
  backups in Auto mode). Saved 0.1.0 providers (e.g. Cloudflare) are **not** remapped on upgrade.
- Selection verifies **Steam DNS and HTTPS** (SNI/Host) before committing a provider. DNS-only
  success can stay applied with “Steam unverified”; full failure falls back to network DNS.
- Status shows the active provider and transport (e.g. `Active · Google · Encrypted`).
- Diagnostics columns: **Network / Provider / Deck / HTTPS** against the active or configured
  resolver (not a fixed Cloudflare DoH probe). Sticky results clear when mode/provider/device changes.

### Fixes

- Restore marker cleared only after a successful restore; unload retries restore before stopping
  dnsproxy; startup restores before killing a leftover proxy the link may still need.
- Generation guards discard stale apply/diagnostics work after reconnect or settings changes.
- Two-failure hysteresis before replacing an established provider; 60 s health reuse on panel open.
- Probe dnsproxy on ports 15353–15355 for selection/diagnostics without touching live link DNS.
- Plain mode tests each server independently and applies only verified addresses.
- Auto mode still keeps a plain provider IP as link backup behind dnsproxy.

### Tests / CI

- Plugin lifecycle tests for Automatic failover, fallback, diagnostics cancel, shutdown restore.
- Release workflow runs the same TypeScript check as CI before packaging.

### Field notes

- VNPT / Viettel behaviour from 0.1.0 still applies as a baseline.
- **FPT is not claimed fixed** without affected-user Steam confirmation on that ISP.
  Compare Automatic vs Cloudflare vs Google on the same link (see `docs/field-test.md`).

- Encrypted DNS through a bundled, checksum-pinned AdGuard dnsproxy v0.86.0 on `127.0.0.2:53`, using IP-address
  DoH upstreams so nothing is looked up through the ISP's DNS.
- Safe fallback chain: encrypted -> plain public DNS -> the network's own DNS. Each step is verified by resolving

## What's new in v0.1.3

### Workarounds section
New **Workarounds** panel in the plugin UI with two toggles that get prepended to the generated launch option string:

**Disable vSync** (`MESA_VK_WSI_PRESENT_MODE=immediate`)
Recommended for all frame generation use. Prevents Mesa's compositor vsync from interfering with the layer's frame insertion timing. Without this, the display sync interval fights the layer's inserted presents, causing stutter.

**Disable vkbasalt** (`DISABLE_VKBASALT=1`)
Enable if you see black screens or visual artifacts. vkbasalt post-processing can conflict with frame generation layers by processing the inserted frames.

When active, the launch option shown in the Usage panel and copied by the clipboard button automatically includes the enabled workarounds at the front:
```
MESA_VK_WSI_PRESENT_MODE=immediate DISABLE_VKBASALT=1 ENABLE_OMFG_RUST=1 OMFG_HOT_CONFIG_PATH=... %command%

## Void Deck 1.0

Void Deck now covers the whole Steam Deck experience, from Home to the screensaver, and it is polished enough to call 1.0.

**Notifications, restyled.** Achievements unlock as a dot that stretches into a pill with the trophy inside, then folds back into the corner. Friend notifications (in game, online) use the same pill with the friend's avatar and a status dot. A panel toggle brings back Steam's own style.

**A screensaver of widgets.** Steam's slideshow of your games is replaced with a large dot-matrix clock, the date, the battery as a row of dots and the weather for a city you pick in the panel (powered by Open-Meteo). It follows Steam's 12/24-hour setting, and there is a button to preview it.

**Updates from the panel.** When a new version is released, the Void Deck panel shows *Update available*: one press and Decky installs it. This is the last time you need to install by URL.

**Also new**

- Your settings are kept across restarts.

alejandrotenorioc/voiddeck.name: v0.2.2
alejandrotenorioc/voiddeck.body:
## Void Deck 0.2.2 — lighter and easier on the battery

A performance release. Nothing changes visually.

- **Cheaper Home animation.** The light sweep across the dot grid is now handled by the GPU instead of being redrawn every frame, and it rests between passes. On my Deck it went from about 21% to 7% of a CPU core.
- **Paused while you play.** The Home animation stops whenever a game is running, so it never competes with the game in the background.

60plus/deckycache.name: DeckyCache 0.4.8
60plus/deckycache.body:
# DeckyCache 0.4.8

Choose whether cache covers entire selected drives or specific folders. Installation and update writes no longer allocate new cache blocks, and the final **Other cached data** tile explains occupancy outside the game list.

## Compatibility

**SteamOS Stable only.** Beta, Preview and Main are not supported.

| Requirement | This release |
| --- | --- |
| Tested SteamOS PC | 3.8.28, build 20260922.1, NVIDIA x86-64 |
| Required kernel | `6.18.50-valve2-1-neptune-618-gc7289a96b14d` |
| Library filesystem | Separate ext4 data partitions |
| Tested Decky Loader | 3.2.10 |

The kernel bundle is unchanged from 0.4.7. No kernel rebuild or on-device compilation is required.

## Changes

- **Cache scope:** choose **Entire selected drives** or **Selected folders**. Add Steam libraries or browse for folders across enabled drives.
- **Write-around:** copying, installation and Steam update writes go to the original HDD without allocating new cache blocks. Cached overlaps remain coherent.
- **Other cached data:** always the last tile, using the disk-and-rocket icon. It accounts for blocks outside the current game list without counting Small fragments twice.
- **Folder controls:** added spacing between selected folders and the Add folder action.
- **Preservation:** changing scope does not remount libraries or clear existing cache. Compatible built-in plugin updates retain the mounted cache and tracking IDs.

## What the scope choice means

Folder mode controls read admission, not whether a game is running. Reading selected files for copying, unpacking or verification can still populate cache.
Some direct or asynchronous reads cannot be assigned to a directory and bypass cache in folder mode.
The engine has 32 class slots per volume, shared by game tracking and selected folder roots. A new folder is refused if no required slot remains.

Previously cached data is retained. A large Other cached data tile can include data saved by older versions.
Use **Clear cache** if you want to discard all cached copies; the games on the HDD and the prepared SSD filesystem remain intact.

## Install or update

Download the attached **DeckyCache plugin ZIP**, not the source-code archive.
Enable Developer mode in Decky settings and use **Install Plugin from ZIP File** or **Install Plugin from URL**.

For an existing installation with the current updater, close games and finish Steam downloads, then use **Check for updates** in DeckyCache.
Confirm Decky's installer; the plugin reloads automatically.
Cache preservation requires the compatible built-in updater. The old updater in 0.4.5 or earlier and manual ZIP replacement can rebuild cache once.

## Validation

A native Decky update to the development build preserved occupied cache bytes, the library mount and all 31 installed Steam game entries.
Folder selection applied online without remounting or clearing cache. Isolated ext4 checks covered write admission, selected/excluded reads, cache hits, overwrites and atomic replacement.

After a normal PC restart, a 90-second MOUSE loading/gameplay observation measured **1.05 GiB from cache and 69 MiB from HDD**.
Approximately **94% of the measured storage-read bytes came from cache**, with matching physical NVMe reads and zero cache errors.
This confirms retained cache and real NVMe reads for that sample. It is not a loading-time benchmark or a measurement of RAM reads.

A real Steam download/update was not run for this release; file-update coherence was checked with controlled writes.

capraaudio/capralink.name: CapraLink 0.3.1
capraaudio/capralink.body:
0.3.0 was never released: 0.3.1 is the first release with these features, and it also includes fixes from an outside security and reliability review.

## What's new

- **Push-to-talk.** Pick a button for each connection and choose *Hold to talk* (with a short 200 ms tail so word endings aren't cut) or *Press to toggle*. It works while a game has focus, and a short chirp tells you when you start and stop talking. On the Steam Deck the back grips (L4, L5, R4, R5) work directly, with no Steam Input mapping needed. Windows uses a listen-only method that doesn't take the key away from your game. On a Mac, CapraLink asks for the Input Monitoring permission. If the button's keyboard or controller is unplugged, or keys can't be read for a moment, talking stops at once until the next press.
- **Music Mode/Hi-Fi.** A new Hi-Fi switch next to Music Mode streams lossless 24-bit audio (about 2.3 Mbit/s each way). Lost packets are re-sent instead of being covered up (never more than were sent, so a misbehaving computer can't use resends to flood the network). If the network can't keep up, it falls back to Music Mode by itself and tries Hi-Fi again after a clean minute. Both computers need 0.3.1 for Music Mode/Hi-Fi; with an older version it simply stays in Music Mode.
- **Volume and mute.** Send and Receive volume sliders (0–150%) and a Mute button, remembered for each connection. Changes apply instantly, without reconnecting, and fade smoothly instead of clicking.
- **Delay readout.** The window shows how much delay each direction has, e.g. "You hear them: 45 ms · They hear you: 60 ms".
- **One-click updates.** From this version on, "New version available!" comes with an **Update now** button that downloads, checks and installs the update, then restarts CapraLink. (Linux .deb/.rpm installs, and Mac releases that change the audio drivers, still link to the download page.)
- **Steam Deck Game Mode plugin.** A Decky Loader plugin puts CapraLink in the Quick Access Menu: connection status, Connect/Disconnect, Music Mode, Music Mode/Hi-Fi, Mute, volume, push-to-talk and the delay readout. Download `CapraLink-Decky-0.3.1.zip` below and install it from Decky's Developer settings (Install Plugin from ZIP File).
- **Command-line control.** `capralink --status`, `--connect`, `--disconnect`, `--music`, `--hifi`, `--mute`, `--volume`, `--ptt` and `--ptt-set` let scripts control a running CapraLink.
- **Accessibility.** The whole window works with the keyboard (Tab, Enter/Space, Esc closes menus), every control has a screen-reader label, status changes are announced, "reduce motion" is respected, and text contrast is improved.

## Fixed

- **Pairing is more reliable.** Pairing, or connecting again right after a refused connection, could occasionally fail with a dropped connection (seen mostly on Windows).
- **Mac permissions no longer reset with every update.** CapraLink is now signed with its own stable certificate, so macOS remembers the microphone and Input Monitoring permissions across updates.
- **Safer Mac installer.** The installer keeps its temporary files in the private folder macOS gives each install, instead of a shared location.
- **Disconnect always works while a connection is starting.** Disconnecting while the other computer's connection was still opening your audio devices no longer leaves the two computers connected.
- **Settings changed while connecting take effect.** Picking another microphone, speaker, channel count or bitrate while a connection is starting no longer gets lost.
- **Music Mode rides out longer Wi-Fi dropouts.** Wi-Fi stalls longer than half a second are now measured too, so the buffer grows to cover them (up to 1 second), and when it shrinks again it drains smoothly instead of skipping audio.
- **Changing a setting never undoes another one.** The window and the tray menu now send only the setting you changed.
- **Clean sound on low-rate headsets.** Playback on devices below 48 kHz (e.g. 16 kHz Bluetooth headsets) no longer has harsh artifacts.
- **Less CPU on high-sample-rate devices.** Devices running at 96 kHz and above use 2–8× less processing time.
- **Quit is always quick.** Quit no longer waits while the engine is still starting, and it still stops the engine then (unless it runs in the background).
- **A wrong address can't hold up connecting.** Something on the network that answers in place of the other computer, but never finishes connecting, is given up after 5 seconds so the right address is tried.
- **Automatic reconnects keep trying.** If the audio has to be rebuilt and the first reconnect fails, CapraLink keeps retrying (when auto-reconnect is on) instead of staying disconnected.

## Good to know

- **Mac:** because of the new signature, macOS asks for the microphone permission (and Input Monitoring, if you use push-to-talk) one more time after installing 0.3.1. If CapraLink is already listed there, remove it with **−** and allow it again.
- **Windows:** the installer isn't code-signed. If Windows' Smart App Control is on, it may block the installer.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/CapraAudio/CapraLink/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.1

## 🔒 Security & Authentication Overhaul (PKCE)

This release introduces a critical security update by implementing **PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange)**, eliminating the need for a client secret and aligning with modern OAuth2 standards for public applications.

### 🛡️ Security Improvements
* **PKCE Implementation:** Transitioned the OAuth2 flow to use Proof Key for Code Exchange. This standard is significantly more secure for installed apps (mobile/desktop).
* **No More Client Secret:** Completely removed `CLIENT_SECRET` from the source code/binary. The application now functions strictly as a public client.

### 🛠️ Technical Enhancements
* **Optimized OAuth2 Flow:** Authorization now utilizes code challenge/verifier instead of hardcoded credentials.

jinzhongjia/decky-tools.name: v0.1.2
jinzhongjia/decky-tools.body:
## 改进：系统监控开销大幅降低
在 Steam Deck OLED 上实测（每秒采样一次，新旧版本交替运行对比）：
- 监控进程 CPU 占用降低约 32%（面板关闭约 713 → 485 µs/s，面板打开约 708 → 483 µs/s），读文件的系统调用从每秒约 20 次降到 6–7 次。
- 面板关闭时，插件的 Python 进程不再有任何定时唤醒（82 → 0 µs/s）；面板打开时其开销降低约 66%（1376 → 467 µs/s）。

具体改动：
- Steam Deck 等 AMD APU 上，CPU / GPU 的频率、温度、占用和 APU 功耗改为一次读取 SMU 指标获得，取代 ACPI 温度区与十余个单独的文件读取。CPU 温度改用 SMU 给出的核心温度，与旧数据源相差约 1–2 °C。
- 充放电状态改为由内核事件驱动：插拔电源后 1 秒内更新，不再每秒查询交流适配器。电量与充放电功率仍每秒读取，保持准确。
- 监控进程以低优先级运行，被唤醒时不会抢占游戏线程，每秒一次的唤醒可与其他定时器合并以省电。
- 图表数据由监控程序直接生成，插件后端与 Decky 原样转发，不再逐层解析；每帧数据量减少约 28%。

## 修复
- APU 功耗偶发读数为 0 mW 时，图表不再画出掉到 0 的假尖刺（当作缺失处理）。

## 其他
- 构建工具链升级到 Zig 0.17.0。

## 安装
下载下方 `Decky.Tools.zip`，在 Decky 设置中开启开发者模式后，通过「从 ZIP 安装插件」安装或覆盖升级。

Decky Tools 首个版本：SteamOS 游戏模式下的工具箱插件，在右侧快捷菜单（QAM）中使用。

## 功能

### Proton 运行时
- 浏览并一键安装 GE-Proton、Proton-CachyOS 的发布版本
- 自动选择适合本机的构建：跳过 aarch64 包；CPU 支持 x86-64-v3（如 Steam Deck）时优先 CachyOS 的 v3 优化版

- 安装 / 卸载后一键重启 Steam 使其生效（Steam 只在启动时扫描兼容层）

下载下方 `Decky Tools.zip`，在 Decky 设置中开启开发者模式后，通过「从 ZIP 安装插件」安装。

otisabiburada/decky-screen-mirror.body:
## Screen Mirror PiP 0.5.0 (beta)

Mirror your **iPhone's screen** into a small window **over your game** in Gaming Mode, with the iPhone's built-in
Screen Mirroring (AirPlay). Sound plays from the Deck. No setup and no extra app: the AirPlay receiver comes with the plugin.

### Highlights
- **Window over any game**, any corner and size; phone-shaped, or fill a wide window. Opens and closes by itself.
- **Mirror volume**: just the iPhone's sound; game sound untouched.
- **Approved phones only** (optional): a new iPhone types a PIN once; a notification shows the PIN.
- **Rename** the Deck, **quality** presets (1080p / 720p / 540p), **60 fps**, **low delay** mode.
- **Recovers by itself** after sleep, Wi-Fi changes and receiver crashes.
- **Check setup** and **Save problem report** built in.

### Install
Decky settings > Developer mode on > **Developer** > **Install Plugin from URL**:
`Or download `screen-mirror-pip-v0.5.0.zip` below and use **Install Plugin from ZIP File**.
Then on the iPhone: Control Center > Screen Mirroring > **Steam Deck**.

### Known limits
- About 0.1-0.3 s of delay: great for watching, not for playing iPhone games through the Deck.
- Same Wi-Fi; guest networks with client isolation block AirPlay discovery.
- Copy-protected video (e.g. Netflix) shows black, as on any AirPlay receiver.
- Uses undocumented Steam internals for the overlay; a Steam update can break it.

### Status
Beta. Mirroring is confirmed on a Steam Deck (SteamOS 3.8) with an iPhone; newer options (PIN, 60 fps, low delay)
are tested in a SteamOS-like environment.
Problems: More > Help > **Save problem report** and attach the file to an issue.

### Licenses
Plugin code: BSD-3-Clause. Bundled receiver: UxPlay (GPL-3.0), FFmpeg AAC/ALAC decoders, GStreamer plugins and
libplist (LGPL-2.1+). Their complete sources are attached below as `screen-mirror-pip-v0.5.0-third-party-sources.tar`.

Not affiliated with Apple. AirPlay and iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc.

koffcheck/potato-deals.body:
## What's changed

### 🐛 Bug fixes
- **Steam Beta UI**: Added `SteamClient.Browser?.OpenURL` fallback so links open correctly in the new Beta UI (fixes #1)
- **Loading stuck forever**: `sync_wishlist` now has a 120 s frontend timeout — the spinner can no longer get permanently stuck

### ⚡ Performance fixes
- **First-open hang (2+ min)**: Removed blocking network calls from the `get_bootstrap` startup path — plugin opens instantly even on slow networks
- **Decky event loop blocking**: Backend now runs in a thread pool (`asyncio.to_thread`) instead of blocking the event loop directly
- **Double network round-trip on sync**: `sync_wishlist` no longer calls `get_bootstrap` a second time — eliminates up to 90 s of extra work after every wishlist refresh
- **Sales tab blocking**: Removed HEAD-request loop + page-fetch loop from `get_sales_events` (was adding up to 95 s of blocking per call)
- **Wishlist auto-mode**: Removed 6th duplicate HTTP request in auto-mode without API key

### 📦 Installation
Download `potato-deals-v3.1.15.zip` and install via **Decky Loader → Settings → Install Plugin from ZIP**.
