koua29/decky-stwebsrv.name: v0.2.0 — Verified uploads, Add to Steam, steam_appid.txt
koua29/decky-stwebsrv.body:
**STWebSRV 0.2.0 is the new stable version.** Everything tested in the betas is now on the stable channel: sending big files without fear, choosing which address the QR code shows, adding a program to your Steam library from the web page, and creating the `steam_appid.txt` file some games need.

## What's new since 0.1.0

### Uploads you can trust
- 📦 **Resumable, verified uploads**: files are sent in 8 MB chunks, each checked with CRC32 and sent again if it arrives damaged. If the network drops, the upload retries by itself; if you close the page, sending the same file again resumes where it stopped.
- 🛡️ A file only gets its real name once complete and its checksum verified, so **an existing file is never damaged**. Free space is checked before starting, and abandoned uploads are cleaned up after 24 hours.
- 📊 **Transfer progress**: for each file and for the whole batch — sent / total, percentage, **speed** and **time left**, with a **Cancel** button.

### Your library, from the browser
- ▶️ **Add to Steam**: a button on programs (`.exe`, `.bat`, `.msi`, `.sh`, `.AppImage`…) creates a **non-Steam game shortcut**, without restarting Steam. Editable name, **Proton turned on by default for Windows programs**, optional launch options, Linux programs made executable if needed. A notification shows up on the console; tapping it opens the game's page.
- 🆔 **`steam_appid.txt`**: some Steam games started from a non-Steam shortcut do not launch without this file. The **ID** button in the toolbar creates it in the open folder, and a checkbox creates it next to the program in "Add to Steam". Type the App ID, the **game's name** (searched on the Steam Store) or a Store link; for a DLC the page offers the base game's ID.

### Several networks at once
- 🌐 Ethernet + Wi-Fi, USB dock: the server answers on **all** of them. Each address is shown with its type (Wired, Wi-Fi, Other), **wired first**, and the **Address shown** menu picks the one used for the QR code. The choice is remembered; unplug that adapter and the automatic order comes back.

## How to update

### From v0.1.0 or a beta (built-in updates)
1. Open STWebSRV in the Decky menu and press **Check for updates** (bottom of the panel).
2. Press **Update to 0.2.0**.
3. Decky shows its confirmation window, checks the zip's checksum and reloads the plugin.

Beta users get this version too, and can turn **Beta versions** off to stay on stable from now on.

### If your panel has no "Check for updates" button: install by hand, once
An older build can't update itself. Install 0.2.0 over it:
1. Decky → ⚙️ Settings → General → turn on **Developer mode**.
2. Decky → ⚙️ → **Developer** → **Install plugin from URL**, paste this link and confirm:
   ```
   https://github.com/koua29/decky-stwebsrv/releases/latest/download/STWebSRV.zip
   ```
   Or download `STWebSRV.zip` below and use **Install plugin from ZIP file**.
3. From then on, new versions show up right in the panel.

Your password and settings are kept either way.

## Download
**`STWebSRV.zip`** — Decky Loader plugin for SteamOS (Steam Deck, Legion Go, ROG Ally…).

rayekkk/ayaneo3companion.body:
### ✨ Added

- **About:** **Use Rayek's store** makes Rayek's store Decky's store channel after you confirm, so Decky's Store
  tab lists Rayek's plugins and offers their updates.

### 🔧 Changed

**Panel**
- The B button on a module page goes back to the module list instead of closing Quick Access, with focus
  on the module you came from.
- Leaving Fan Control or TDP with unsaved curve or Custom limit changes first asks "Discard changes?".
- Labels and titles use sentence case and US English (for example **Key binding**, **Bypass charging**,
  "color").
- Loading shows a spinner, and a failed first TDP read offers **Try again**.
- Confirmations ask a question ("Eject the left module?") and report their result in a notification.

**About**
- Shows version, author and included modules, with **Updates** at the bottom using the same texts as the
  other plugins.

**Updates**
- A downloaded ZIP is shown as `~/Downloads/…`, and if the plugin cannot start, the updater stays
  available.
- A release ZIP is fetched only from GitHub's own download servers, and an incomplete release names the
  file it is missing.
- A newer release that cannot be offered now says why instead of only showing its version.

**Fan**
- The curve graph uses the editor shared with the other plugins and is edited the same way (A or a tap,
  LB/RB, D-pad, dragging); B now reads "Done".

**Errors**
- When something fails unexpectedly, the panel shows a short message and the details go to the Decky log,
  never file paths.

**Downloads**
- RyzenAdj, the speaker calibration file and plugin updates are downloaded by a separate helper with
  a time limit, so a stalled connection can no longer hold up the plugin.
- RyzenAdj's download no longer uses the RAM-backed `/tmp`.

### 🐛 Fixed
- **TDP:** on battery the console no longer turns off with **Performance** in demanding games: the limits
  written stay at or below 30/35/40 W (SPL/SPPT/FPPT) until the charger is connected, and the panel keeps
  your values.
- **Settings:** an empty settings file no longer blocks every change as lost settings.
- **Settings:** a damaged settings file is kept as `.corrupt-<time>` before it is replaced.
- **Settings:** settings that could not be read back are never written, and recovery copies are as private as the
  settings themselves.

### ✨ Added

**TDP**
- Game profiles like on the Legion, per game and optionally with separate battery and charger values.
- Global keeps a game's profile unused instead of deleting it.
- CPU energy preference (EPP) next to CPU Boost, globally or per game and charger state; Uninstall restores
  both.

**Fan**
- Your own fan curve with eight points from 0 to 100°C in the fan's own percent, three starting curves
  (Silent, Balanced, Aggressive) and a full-screen editor.
- The graph shows the live temperature and measured RPM; below 10% the fan stops, and the 100°C point never
  goes below 40%.
- Optionally a curve per TDP preset: Silent, Balanced, Performance and Custom can each use their own, others
  use the global one.
- A separate watchdog returns the fan to the console's automatic curve if Companion stops, crashes or the
  console goes to sleep, and sets full speed at 100°C even if Companion is frozen.
- A fan that does not spin up or stop as asked turns Fan Control off and shows…

### ✨ Added
- **Fan:** see the fan's speed in RPM, keep the console's automatic curve, or choose a manual speed from 60% to
  100%, when supported by the console's kernel.
- **Fan:** an independent timer restores automatic control if Companion stops responding; stopping the plugin or
  resuming the console also returns the fan to Auto.

### 🔧 Changed

**Panel**
- Faster startup and smoother menus; speaker checks, slow settings saves and other background work are
  less likely to hold up unrelated controls.
- Reopening a page or quickly switching games no longer piles up repeated battery and profile checks;
  Companion refreshes the page or game you are currently using.
- Temporary read failures are shown alongside the last confirmed values and clear after a successful
  refresh, while separate failed actions keep their own explanation.

**Downloads**
- Update and hardware-helper downloads have time limits.

**Updates**
- An update installs the exact version shown in the menu.…

### 🐛 Fixed

**Settings**
- Complete settings are committed atomically with a last-good recovery copy, and unsafe paths or
  unreadable settings are refused instead of overwriting your choices.

**Controller**
- Hardware writes stay serialized through cancellation and plugin shutdown, and the previous setting
  is restored when a write or save step fails.
- Hardware write readbacks are verified, partial button-map changes are recovered, and repeated
  interface failures back off while resume and drift recovery stay in place.

**TDP**
- Edits captured for a game that is no longer active are rejected.

**Lighting**
- Pending RGB and vibration changes are preserved when closing a page, rapid slider changes are
  merged, and stale status replies no longer revert saved controls.

**Panel**
- Native dropdown selections stay on their current page, confirmed overview and update results are
  retained, and overlapping or hidden status polls stop.
- Delayed app notifications are cleared on…

### 🐛 Fixed

**Controller**
- AYANEO vendor-HID writes are verified against the firmware's current report and retried when
  stale.
- FF_GAIN is restored whenever the physical rumble input node is recreated, and virtual or unrelated
  external controllers are ignored.

**Lighting**
- RGB or vibration settings that drift after startup, resume or controller-device recreation are
  repaired automatically.
- RGB, firmware vibration and FF_GAIN changes go through one queue, so rapid adjustments cannot
  overwrite one another with stale controller state.

**Magic Modules**
- Ejection is isolated from background recovery and plugin unload, and controller settings are
  restored after a real module reconnection without an unnecessary firmware save or mechanical reset.

**Display**
- The original public Gamma 2.2 OLED definition is recognized as Companion-owned.
- Unknown existing definitions now require explicit replacement confirmation and are backed up and
  verified before the Companion…

wolfg1969/retroarch-ai-translate.name: v1.0.0 — RetroArch AI 实时翻译服务
wolfg1969/retroarch-ai-translate.body:
RetroArch AI Translation 的首个正式发布版本。在 RetroArch 模拟器上按快捷键，即可将游戏截图中的日文实时翻译为中文，并以画面叠加层显示。支持 Docker 多用户部署和 Steam Deck Decky 插件。

## 核心功能

- **Vision LLM OCR + 机器翻译**：截图 → 视觉模型识别日文 → 翻译模型输出中文，延迟约 1 秒
- **画面叠加层**：翻译结果以半透明底色 + 白色中文文字渲染在游戏画面上，自动识別角色名和对话
- **LRU 翻译缓存**：智能裁剪截图边缘（排除光标/状态栏），相同对话不重复翻译
- **游戏专属配置**：YAML 格式的术语表、角色语气、标志性台词、场景模式，翻译风格贴合原作
- **多设备独立**：Docker 模式下通过 IP 区分不同 RetroArch 客户端，各自选择不同游戏

## 内置游戏配置

逆转裁判（gyakuten）、火焰纹章（fire_emblem）、塞尔达传说 缩小帽（zelda_minish）、弹丸论破（danganronpa）

## Web 管理界面

浏览器打开 `http://localhost:4404/`：
- 首页：切换游戏配置，实时生效
- API 设置：配置 OCR / 翻译 API 密钥，保存后无需重启

## Steam Deck 插件

通过 Decky Loader 在 QAM 中直接管理：
- 启动 / 停止翻译服务
- 切换游戏、配置 API 密钥、查看实时日志
- 开机自动启动

## 部署方式

| 方式 | 适用场景 |
|------|----------|
| Docker Compose | NAS / 家庭服务器，多用户共享 |
| Python 直接运行 | 本机，与 RetroArch 同机 |
| Decky 插件 | Steam Deck，QAM 一键管理 |

## 许可证

GPLv3


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wolfg1969/retroarch-ai-translate/commits/v1.0.0

rayekkk/deckyeq.name: DeckyEQ 1.1.0
rayekkk/deckyeq.body:
### ✨ Added

**Panel**
- The main screen holds **Enable EQ**, **Volume boost**, **Preset**, the curve, and **Bass**,
  **Treble** and **Stereo width**; **Save** and **Discard** appear there while the sound has unsaved changes.
- Rows under **More** open **Equalizer**, **Presets**, **Output** and **About**, each with a
  one-line summary; **B** goes back one page and the row you came from is selected again.

**Curve editor**
- Drag a dot of the curve up or down, or press **A** and use the D-pad: **←/→** choose the
  band, **↑/↓** change it in 0.5 dB steps, **X** sets it flat.
- **Edit full screen** shows the curve larger with the preset list, **Five sliders**,
  **Save**, **Discard** and **Done**; there **LT/RT** make a band wider or narrower and **Y** changes its
  filter type.

**Five sliders**
- Five sliders instead of ten, each moving two neighbouring bands; switching never changes
  your sound, and the choice belongs to this console, not to a preset.

**Games**
- While a game runs, **Own sound for <game>** gives it its own preset and edits, which come
  back whenever the game runs.
- **Presets → Games with their own sound** lists them with a **Forget** button; up to 200 games
  are kept.

**Volume boost**
- Up to +12 dB more for every preset and game, for speakers that are too quiet at full
  volume.

**Stereo width**
- From mono (0%) to twice as wide (200%), applied live.

**Limiter**
- An always-on limiter turns loud peaks down smoothly instead of letting them crackle, so boosts
  can stay loud; the bass has its own limiter, so a bass hit no longer turns down voices.

**Presets**
- New built-in presets **Clear voices** (brings dialogue forward), **More bass** (fuller low end)
  and **Legion Go 2** (a speaker tuning made by ear from the Legion Go S preset; choosing it also sets
  **Volume boost** to 9 dB).
- **About this preset** describes each built-in preset.
- Every preset uses the same ten bands, 31.5 Hz to 16 kHz, so the sliders and dots stay the same
  whichever preset you pick.

### 🔧 Changed

**Updating from 1.0**
- A band's frequency can no longer be changed; a band you moved in 1.0 keeps its own
  frequency and is named by it, and only its gain (in full screen also its width and type) changes.
- Going back from 1.1 to 1.0 may fail to read settings that use stereo width or other
  1.1-only settings, so export your presets first.

**Volume and output**
- Steam's volume and output stay untouched; the equalizer is now a WirePlumber smart
  filter in front of the output you choose, and the volume slider and buttons work exactly as without EQ.
- DeckyEQ no longer sets your speakers to 100%, changes the default output or moves
  streams; when Steam plays to another output, EQ waits (**Standby**).
- If the filter stops, playback continues on the output at your volume.

**Output**
- While EQ is on, Steam lists **DeckyEQ** as an output; choosing it is the same as choosing the
  output EQ applies to.
- Requires WirePlumber 0.5 or newer (SteamOS 3.7 and newer).
- **Speaker port only** is now **Speakers only**, and **Output** holds just **Apply EQ to** and
  **Speakers only**.
- **Refresh / reconnect EQ** is now **Reconnect EQ**.

**Headroom**
- The **Automatic headroom** switch is gone; headroom is always on and lowers the level only
  for EQ boosts above +6 dB, leaving the rest to the limiter.
- Most presets play louder than in 1.0, and presets that had the switch off may play slightly
  quieter (the Go S preset by about 0.6 dB); your **Input level**, **Volume boost** and stereo width are never
  taken back.

**Bands**
- Band frequencies are fixed and the frequency slider is gone; in full screen a band's width and
  filter type can still be changed.

**Presets**
- Import and export sit under **Show import or export** in **Presets**: **Export this sound**,
  **Export your presets** and **Export this sound to…**.
- **Save as new…** starts with the current preset's name, and a repeated name gets " (2)".
- **Legion Go S · Original** is now called **Legion Go S**.

**Panel**
- The **View** dropdown is gone.

**Updates**
- Only a ZIP that a GitHub Actions run in this repository uploaded to a release is offered; releases
  carry a build-provenance attestation that `gh attestation verify` can check.

**Messages**
- Errors stay on the page that caused them and also appear as a toast; outcomes such as an export
  path appear as a toast.
- While EQ is not live, the pages say why.

**Performance**
- No CPU is used while nothing plays; the filter sleeps with its output, and with EQ off DeckyEQ
  no longer runs audio tools in the background.

**Install**
- The plugin ZIP is about 200 KB instead of 2.7 MB.

### 🐛 Fixed

**Volume**
- In 1.0 the speakers could stay at 100% when Decky crashed, when you picked the speakers in Steam,
  or after headphones or Bluetooth came and went; DeckyEQ no longer touches volumes.
- A volume that 1.0 still owed is restored once at startup when its device returns.

**Bluetooth**
- Playback no longer moves to the speakers when you turn EQ on.

**Switching**
- The filter starts and stops flat and then moves to your settings, so turning EQ on or off is
  smooth.

**Stability**
- A slow audio tool (for example while a game loads) no longer pauses EQ, and a PipeWire restart
  rebuilds the filter.
- A filter that keeps failing retries after 8, 16, 32 and then 60 seconds instead of constantly.

**Errors**
- A change that cannot be applied puts back the previous sound, and a change lost in transit keeps
  its notice instead of silently reverting.

**File pickers**
- Import and Export to a folder open again after an earlier error, and closing the picker is
  no longer reported as an error.

**Presets**
- **Edited** no longer flickers on Flat, and Delete and Discard act on the preset they were opened
  for.

**Updates**
- A Downloads folder that is a link, read-only, full or not writable gets its own message.
- After a download About says **Ready to install**, and partial downloads left by an interrupted
  run are removed.

**Settings**
- Damaged settings fall back to the last good copy.
- Preset names with invisible characters that broke saving are refused, and frequencies where
  PipeWire's filters become unstable snap to 20 Hz or 20 kHz.

**Startup**
- DeckyEQ refuses to run as root, which would lock you out of your own settings.

**Unloading**
- Unloading no longer stalls on Decky 3.3.

### ✨ Added

**Plugin**
- First public release.

**Equalizer**
- Ten bands, with changes applied while audio plays.

**Tone**
- **Bass** and **Treble** sliders, each from -9 to +9 dB.

**Filters**
- Bell, low shelf or high shelf for each band, with gain, frequency and width.

**Presets**
- Your own presets, up to 64; update, rename, copy, delete or revert to the saved sound.
- Built-in presets Flat and GAZuOOT's community **Legion Go S · Original**.

**Import and export**
- Single sounds or the whole library as JSON files, to `~/Documents/DeckyEQ/` or a
  folder you choose.

**Drafts**
- Your latest edits survive closing the menu or restarting Decky.

**Input level**
- With optional automatic headroom for boosts.

**Output**
- Output selection, with **Speaker port only** bypass on by default.

**Volume**
- The physical output is set to 100% and your volume moves to the virtual **DeckyEQ** output, and

branchingjade/reboot-to-windows.name: Reboot to Windows 1.0.1
branchingjade/reboot-to-windows.body:
## 中文

**修复：点了「重启进 Windows」只排队、不重启。**

- **根因**：Decky Loader 是 PyInstaller onefile 程序，它给插件进程注入的 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 指向自己的 `/tmp/_MEIxxxx/` 解包目录，里面自带一个旧版 `libcrypto.so.3`。插件后端以 root 直接调用 `/usr/bin/systemctl reboot` 时，动态加载器发现系统 `libsystemd-shared` 需要 `OPENSSL_3.4.0`，`systemctl` 在联系 logind **之前**就中止了：

  ```
  /usr/bin/systemctl: /tmp/_MEI.../libcrypto.so.3: version `OPENSSL_3.4.0' not found
  (required by /usr/lib/systemd/libsystemd-shared-257.7-*.so)
  ```

  `efibootmgr` 不依赖 OpenSSL，所以设置 `BootNext` 一直成功 —— 于是只有一次性启动项被写好、机器却从不重启，面板看起来就像"已排队"。旧代码用裸 `Popen`、不读退出码，错误被完全吞掉还返回成功。
- **修复**：所有特权子进程（`efibootmgr` / `systemctl`）一律剥掉 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`、`LD_PRELOAD`、`LD_AUDIT`、`LD_DEBUG`；重启改为回收子进程并校验退出码，直连失败自动回退 `sudo -n`（sudo 自身会清理环境），真失败以 `reboot_failed` 上报面板，不再假装成功。
- 面板新增 `reboot_failed` 的中英文案（中文：「重启命令没有生效，本次切换未完成」）。

**验证（SteamOS 213 实机，Decky Loader v3.2.10-pre1）**

- 复现对照：`LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/_MEI… systemctl --version` → rc=1 同一报错；剥掉该变量 → rc=0。
- 部署后把 reboot 换成探针脚本实测：父进程 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 有毒时，子进程拿到的是干净环境；换成不存在的二进制时返回 `{'ok': False, …}` 而不是成功。
- 用 Decky 自己的 `loader/reload_plugin` 重载后端：新进程以 root 启动，日志 `loaded (euid=0, …, rule=already present)`。

---

## English

**Fix: pressing "Restart into Windows" only queued the switch and never rebooted.**

- **Root cause**: Decky Loader is a PyInstaller one-file build. It exports `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` pointing at its own `/tmp/_MEIxxxx/` bundle, which ships an older `libcrypto.so.3`. When the root plugin backend called `/usr/bin/systemctl reboot` directly, the dynamic loader saw that the system's `libsystemd-shared` needs `OPENSSL_3.4.0` and aborted **before** `systemctl` ever reached logind:

  ```
  /usr/bin/systemctl: /tmp/_MEI.../libcrypto.so.3: version `OPENSSL_3.4.0' not found
  (required by /usr/lib/systemd/libsystemd-shared-257.7-*.so)
  ```

  `efibootmgr` does not use OpenSSL, so writing the one-shot `BootNext` kept succeeding — the boot entry was set, the machine never restarted, and the panel looked like it had merely "queued" the switch. The old code used a bare `Popen`, never checked the exit status, and reported success anyway.
- **Fix**: every privileged child (`efibootmgr` / `systemctl`) now runs with `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `LD_PRELOAD`, `LD_AUDIT` and `LD_DEBUG` stripped; the reboot command is reaped and its exit status checked, a failing direct exec falls back to `sudo -n` (sudo sanitizes the environment itself), and a real failure is reported to the panel as `reboot_failed` instead of a silent success.
- The panel gained a localized `reboot_failed` message in Chinese and English.

**Verified** on the real SteamOS 213 machine (Decky Loader v3.2.10-pre1) — reproduction, env-stripping probe, failure reporting, and a backend reload through Decky's own `loader/reload_plugin` route.

branchingjade/reboot-to-windows.name: Reboot to Windows v1.0.0 — 一键切到 Windows 11（一次性）/ one-shot switch
branchingjade/reboot-to-windows.body:
# Reboot to Windows v1.0.0

[English below](#english)

## 简体中文

Decky Loader 插件：在 SteamOS 游戏模式下**一键重启进入 Windows 11**，而且只生效一次 ——
下次开机自动回到 SteamOS，不会把机器卡在 Windows 里。

### 功能

- 面板一键切换：把 UEFI 的**一次性**启动项（`BootNext`）指向 Windows 引导条目，随后立即重启。
- **一次性**：`BootNext` 用完即清，下一次开机仍是正常的启动顺序（SteamOS）。
- 重启前有确认弹窗；误触了也能在面板里**取消**已排队的切换。
- 面板显示引导状态：是否存在 Windows 引导条目、是否已排队。
- **中英双语面板**，默认中文，可在面板里切换，选择会被记住。
- 自我修复：后端重建免密 sudo 规则，SteamOS 镜像更新抹掉 `/etc/sudoers.d/*` 后不会失效。

### 权限说明（重要）

Decky 3.x 默认把插件后端跑成桌面用户（`uid 1000`），这个身份不能写 UEFI 启动项。
因此本插件在 `plugin.json` 中声明了 `"flags": ["root"]`，Decky 会把后端以 **root** 启动
（已实测：后端进程 euid=0）。这样即使免密 sudo 规则被 SteamOS 更新抹掉，插件下次加载也会自己写回。

### 安装

1. 下载本页的 **RebootToWindows.zip**。
2. Decky → 设置 → 通用 → **从文件安装插件**，选择该 zip。
   （也可以解压到 `~/homebrew/plugins/reboot-to-windows/` 后重启 Decky。）

### 前置条件

机器是 Windows + SteamOS 双系统，且 Windows 引导条目编号为 `Boot0000`。
如果不是，请修改 `main.py` 里的 `WINDOWS_BOOT_ENTRY`。

配合 Decky Loader v3.2.10-pre1 实测通过：`status()` 返回
`{"ok": true, "has_windows": true,…

garicst/autowhite.body:
Первый публичный выпуск. / First public release.

**Возможности / Features**

- Автоматическая подстройка точки белого по датчику освещённости (ALS) через виртуальную
  точку белого gamescope — `GAMESCOPE_DISPLAY_VIRTUAL_WHITE` (CIE 1931 x/y).
  / Ambient-light adaptive white point driven through gamescope's virtual white point.
- Плавное сглаживание перехода: тик 0.2 с, опрос датчика раз в 1 с, мёртвая зона 0.0005 —
  без рывков и ступенек. / Smooth exponential transitions — no jumps.
- Применение сразу при старте консоли; при выключении возвращается нейтральная D65.
  / Applied at boot; disabling restores neutral D65.
- Панель: тумблер, ползунок «Холоднее — Теплее», статус (освещённость и текущая точка).
  / Panel: toggle, Cooler — Warmer slider, live status.
- Русский и английский интерфейс — автоматически по языку системы.
  / Russian and English UI, picked from the system language.
- Самодостаточность: нужны только Decky Loader, `xprop`, `runuser`, gamescope и ALS.
  / Self-contained: Decky Loader, `xprop`, `runuser`, gamescope, ALS.
- Самовосстановление: точка белого сверяется каждые 5 с, поэтому сброс после перезагрузки
  консоли или чужое вмешательство исправляются автоматически.
  / Self-healing: the white point is verified every 5 s, so a reset after a reboot or an
  external change is corrected automatically.
- Кнопка **«Проверить обновление»** в панели: спрашивает у GitHub последний релиз.
  / **Check for updates** button in the panel: asks GitHub for the latest release.
- Переносимость: пользователь сессии берётся из `DECKY_USER` (не жёстко «deck»),
  X-дисплей определяется автоматически, поддерживаются разные названия каналов датчика.
  / Portability: the session user comes from `DECKY_USER` (not a hard-coded `deck`),
  the X display is auto-detected, and several ALS channel names are supported.

**Установка / Install**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GaricST/AutoWhite/main/install.sh | sh
```

**Проверено на / Verified on:** Lenovo Legion Go 2 (SteamOS), датчик `als` в
`/sys/bus/iio/devices/iio:device1`.

**Зависимости / Requirements:** Decky Loader, gamescope, `xprop`, `runuser`.

**Лицензия / License:** MIT.

branchingjade/boot-volume.name: BootVolume v1.4.0 — 睡眠唤醒修复 + 中英双语面板 / resume fix + bilingual panel
branchingjade/boot-volume.body:
# BootVolume v1.4.0

[English below](#english)

## 简体中文

Decky Loader 插件：**SteamOS 开机动画播放期间自动压低系统音量**，动画结束后恢复原值。
本版本加入了「睡眠唤醒后第一次启动动画」的修复，并把面板做成中英双语（默认中文）。

### 新增

- **睡眠唤醒后的第一次启动动画也会被压低。** 之前插件只在 Decky 自身加载时、以及
  `steamwebhelper` 的 pid 变化时触发；而唤醒后那次动画是同一个 Steam UI 进程在放（pid 不变），
  所以插件根本没被触发，表现就是「长时间睡眠后第一次开机动画不响、第二三次才正常」。
  现在通过 `time.time() - time.monotonic()` 的差值跳变检测 resume，唤醒后立刻开压。
- **中英双语面板**，默认中文，可在面板底部切换，选择会被记住。

### 优化与修复

- 开压前不再扫描全部 17 个动画文件（冷缓存下会拖慢约 1 秒），改用加载时测好的时长，
  动画开头几秒不再漏压。
- 压低期间每秒复查一次音频输出：唤醒后重新枚举出来的 USB / HDMI 设备（满音量）也会被一起压低，
  结束时正确还原。
- 音频图未就绪时短暂重试，不再直接报 `no hardware sinks found` 退出。
- 面板「当前输出」显示真实的默认输出及其音量（带设备名）。

### 安装

1. 下载本页的 **BootVolume.zip**。
2. Decky → 设置 → 通用 → **从文件安装插件**，选择该 zip。
   （也可以解压到 `~/homebrew/plugins/` 后重启 Decky。）

配合 Decky Loader v3.2.10-pre1 实测通过：开机压低 3 路输出到 40%、保持 14.01 秒后原样还原。

---

## English

A Decky Loader plugin that **lowers the system volume while the SteamOS boot animation plays** and
restores the previous values afterwards. This release fixes the first startup movie after a resume
from sleep and makes the panel bilingual (Chinese by default).

### Added

- **The first startup movie after a resume from sleep is ducked.** The plugin used to trigger only on
  Decky's own load and on a `steamwebhelper` pid change, but the movie played right after a resume
  comes from the *same* Steam UI process, so nothing fired — hence "the first boot animation after a
  long sleep is quiet, the second and third are fine". The resume is now detected from the jump in
  `time.time() - time.monotonic()` and the duck starts immediately.
- **Bilingual panel** (Chinese default, English), switchable at the bottom of the panel and remembered.

### Improved / fixed

- No `ffprobe` scan on the hot path (it delayed the duck by ~1 s with a cold cache): the duration
  measured at load time is reused, so the first seconds of the animation are covered.
- The sink list is re-checked once per second during the duck, so USB/HDMI outputs re-enumerated at
  full volume after a resume are ducked too and restored correctly.
- Briefly retry when the audio graph is not up yet instead of logging `no hardware sinks found`.
- The panel's "current output" now shows the real default output and its volume, with the device name.

### Install

1. Download **BootVolume.zip** from this release.
2. Decky → Settings → General → **Install Plugin from file**, pick the zip.
   (Or unzip it into `~/homebrew/plugins/` and restart Decky.)

Verified on-device with Decky Loader v3.2.10-pre1: three outputs ducked to 40 % for 14.01 s on boot,
then restored to their previous volumes.

xiaominghui/deckyally.name: DeckyAlly v0.1.2
xiaominghui/deckyally.body:
DeckyAlly 0.1.2 实验版。

本版调整恢复策略，解决正常解锁后重复刷新手柄以及锁屏变慢的问题：

- SteamOS 锁屏期间不采集设备状态、不读取服务日志，也不重启 InputPlumber。
- 休眠开始时立即取消正在进行的基线探测，并关闭恢复闸门。
- 唤醒后等待 Steam UI 明确确认已解锁，再给予 SteamOS 8 秒自行恢复时间。
- 输入链路结构正常时不干预；检测状态不确定时也不重启。
- 仅在物理接口或 InputPlumber 合成链路连续 3 次异常时重启一次服务。
- 旧版保存的“每次唤醒都尝试恢复”设置会自动迁移为条件恢复。

本版已通过 TypeScript 类型检查、前端构建、38 项自动化测试及安装包验证。

安装请下载 `DeckyAlly-0.1.2.zip`，不要下载 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包。覆盖解压后重启 `plugin_loader.service`。

限制：InputPlumber 没有提供“Steam 已收到实际按键”的无侵入健康状态。因此若设备结构完整但按键仍无响应，本版会保守地不重启，请保留诊断日志供后续改进。

xiaominghui/deckyally.name: DeckyAlly v0.1.1
xiaominghui/deckyally.body:
DeckyAlly 0.1.1 实验版。

修复在 Ally X 真机上发现的 Decky/AppImage 动态库环境冲突：插件调用 SteamOS 的 `systemctl`、`journalctl`、`busctl` 和 `dbus-monitor` 时，现在会清除继承的 `LD_*` 动态链接器变量并使用系统命令路径，避免错误加载 Decky 自带的 `libcrypto.so.3`。

本版新增对应回归测试，并已通过 TypeScript 类型检查、前端构建、34 项自动化测试及安装包验证。

安装请下载 `DeckyAlly-0.1.1.zip`，不要下载 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包。覆盖解压后重启 `plugin_loader.service`，再进行一次休眠/唤醒测试。自动恢复实际按键的效果仍需真机复测。

xiaominghui/deckyally.name: DeckyAlly v0.1.0
xiaominghui/deckyally.body:
DeckyAlly 0.1.0 实验版。

wankyo83/decky-ai.name: Decky AI v0.1.6
wankyo83/decky-ai.body:
## Decky AI v0.1.6

음성 입력을 Gemini API 방식에서 완전한 로컬 Whisper 음성 타이핑으로 변경한 릴리스입니다.

### 주요 변경 사항

- 음성 인식에서 Gemini API 호출을 완전히 제거했습니다.
- `whisper.cpp`와 한국어 지원 다국어 `small-q5_1` 모델을 기기에서 직접 실행합니다.
- 최초 사용 시 필요한 약 200MB 다운로드를 미리 안내합니다.
- 다운로드 중 받은 용량과 전체 용량을 메시지 입력창 위에 표시합니다.
- 음성 인식 결과는 메시지 입력란에만 추가되며 자동으로 질문을 전송하거나 검색하지 않습니다.
- Gemini 무료 사용량을 소진해도 로컬 음성 타이핑을 사용할 수 있습니다.
- 변환할 때만 최대 CPU 4스레드를 사용하고 완료 시 Whisper 프로세스를 종료합니다.

### 파일과 개인정보

- 녹음된 WAV와 임시 변환 TXT는 성공·실패·취소 후 자동 삭제됩니다.
- 중단된 다운로드 임시 파일도 자동 삭제됩니다.
- 다음 음성 입력에 필요한 whisper.cpp 실행 파일 약 9MB와 모델 약 190MB만 설정 폴더에 유지됩니다.
- 녹음된 음성은 Gemini, Google 또는 다른 외부 서버로 전송되지 않습니다.

### 설치

1. 아래 `decky-ai-plugin-v0.1.6.zip`을 다운로드합니다.
2. Decky Loader의 Developer 메뉴에서 `Install Plugin from Zip File`을 선택합니다.
3. 다운로드한 ZIP을 선택합니다.
4. 업데이트 후 이전 화면이 남으면 Decky Loader 또는 Steam을 다시 시작합니다.

Gemini API 키 설정과 검색 모드별 차이, YouTube 공략 검색 방식은 저장소의 README를 참고하세요.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wankyo83/Decky-AI/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.6

vahn84/decky-hostsleep.name: v0.5.0 — wake retries until the host is confirmed awake
vahn84/decky-hostsleep.body:
## Changed
- **Wake is now closed-loop.** Broadcast WOL delivery to a sleeping wired NIC through a client-isolating router turned out to be stochastic — byte-identical packets sometimes wake the host, sometimes vanish (verified with packet captures). Instead of firing a blind burst, the plugin now sends a volley, listens on a raw socket for the host to announce itself (gratuitous ARP/DHCP broadcast on resume), and retries every 3 s for up to 45 s.
- **Honest feedback.** The Test button and resume toast now report the real outcome: *confirmed awake in N s* or *no response from host* — never a blind "sent".
- **Resume robustness.** Wake no longer aborts if the first sends fail while the Deck's Wi-Fi is still reassociating after resume — it keeps retrying through the window.

## Notes
- `sol.json` (attached, unchanged from v0.4.2) is still the recommended host-side config for sleep-on-lan.
- On non-root/non-Linux environments the plugin falls back to the previous fire-and-forget burst.

vahn84/decky-hostsleep.name: v0.4.2 — fix wake-then-resleep (buffered sleep packets)
vahn84/decky-hostsleep.body:
## Fixed
- **PC no longer goes straight back to sleep after waking.** The plugin used to send the reversed-MAC sleep packet 3× for redundancy; the extra packets were buffered through the suspend transition and replayed by sleep-on-lan on resume, immediately re-sleeping the host regardless of wake source (WOL, controller, mouse). Sleep is now sent exactly once — the host NIC is awake at that point, so redundancy isn't needed. See [SR-G/sleep-on-lan#22](https://github.com/SR-G/sleep-on-lan/issues/22).

## Changed
- **Wake burst stretched: 8 packets over ~5 s** (was 3 over 0.6 s). Broadcast delivery to a sleeping wired NIC through a client-isolating router is flaky; the longer window makes wake reliable.

## Recommended host-side hardening
Download the attached `sol.json` and drop it next to `sol.exe` on the host PC (then restart the SleepOnLAN scheduled task or reboot). It enables `AvoidDualUDPSending`, so duplicate sleep packets can never re-sleep the PC, whatever the sender does.

vahn84/decky-hostsleep.name: HostSleep v0.4.1
vahn84/decky-hostsleep.body:
**Wake now broadcasts to the /24 directed address too.** On routers that isolate wireless from wired clients and only flood the directed subnet broadcast (e.g. `192.168.0.255`) across the boundary — not global `255.255.255.255` — WOL wake previously never reached the sleeping wired host. Wake and sleep now share the same broadcast logic, hitting the global, configured, and directed-/24 broadcasts on UDP 9 and 7.

Install: download `HostSleep.zip` → Decky → Settings → Developer → Install plugin from ZIP.

vahn84/decky-hostsleep.name: HostSleep v0.4.0
vahn84/decky-hostsleep.body:
**UDP sleep now uses broadcast** — fixes hosts behind routers that isolate wireless from wired clients.

On such routers, unicast from a wireless Deck to a wired host is dropped, so the HTTP sleep and the old unicast UDP sleep never arrived — but layer-2 broadcast still floods across. UDP sleep now sends the reversed-MAC magic packet to the /24 directed broadcast and the global broadcast on UDP 9 and 7, the same envelope WOL wake already uses.

If your host is on Wi-Fi or your router doesn't isolate clients, HTTP mode still works and gives you delivery confirmation; switch to **UDP** mode only if HTTP times out.

Install: download `HostSleep.zip` → Decky → Settings → Developer → Install plugin from ZIP.

vahn84/decky-hostsleep.name: HostSleep v0.3.0
vahn84/decky-hostsleep.body:
First public release.

**HostSleep** sleeps your Steam Remote Play host PC when the Deck suspends and wakes it (Wake-on-LAN) when the Deck resumes — without closing the running game.

- Sleep-on-suspend / wake-on-resume toggles
- "Only when using Remote Play" gating (detects the Deck's `streaming_client` process; wake only fires if the plugin slept the host)
- Sleep transport: HTTP (`sleep-on-lan` REST, default) or reversed-MAC UDP packet
- Manual **Sleep host now** / **Wake host now** test buttons
- **Debug mode**: in-panel timestamped event log (every hook fire, gating decision, packet/request sent, error) + debug toasts on resume

**Install:** download `HostSleep.zip` on the Deck → Decky → Settings → Developer → *Install plugin from ZIP*.
**Host setup:** run [sleep-on-lan](https://github.com/SR-G/sleep-on-lan) on the Windows PC (defaults work). See the README for details.

vaddum/vkbasalt-decky.body:
## vkBasalt Manager — Decky Loader Plugin (v1.3.0)

### ✨ Added

- **Profiles**: create as many named configurations as you want! Each profile has its own shader toggles, built-in effect sliders, and toggle key. The "Copy launch option" button adapts automatically: `ENABLE_VKBASALT=1 %command%` for the Default profile, or `VKBASALT_CONFIG_FILE="..." ENABLE_VKBASALT=1 %command%` for a named one (vkBasalt's native per-config mechanism)
- **5 more external shaders with sliders**: Border, ColorMatrix, Clarity, Monochrome, and DPX join the 13 already adjustable — 18 external shaders total now expose their most impactful parameter (or two, for GaussianBlur/FakeHDR/Vignette) directly in the Quick Access Menu
- **Collapsible sections**: Built-in Effects and the three external categories (Light/Medium/Heavy) are now toggle buttons with a small squared +/− indicator, collapsed by default — much less scrolling to reach what you actually want to change
- **Reset All Effects to Default** button (Settings, marked with a red ⚠️): resets the active profile's shader toggles and built-in effect sliders, and also resets every external shader's parameter(s) back to their coded default directly in the `.fx` file. Note the split scope: toggles/built-in sliders reset only the active profile, while external shader parameters reset globally across all profiles, since those values live in the shared `.fx` file rather than in a per-profile config
- **Default value shown on every slider**: each of the 22 adjustable parameters (4 built-in + 18 external) now displays its min–max range and default value under its name

### 🎨 Changed

- Category color squares replaced with colored text: shader names and section headers are now tinted (green/orange/red/blue) directly, no separate swatch
- Removed the visual separators between Profiles / Built-in Effects / External Shaders / Settings for a more compact, continuous layout
- Unified font size (13px) across every label, shader name, section header, and button in the plugin
- The "Copy launch option" button wraps and shrinks its text instead of overflowing the panel width

### 🐛 Fixed

- **Profile selection silently reverting to Default**: the dropdown-based selector could revert to the first entry after picking another profile. Replaced with a button-per-profile list (the same reliable pattern already used for Install/Uninstall/Create/Delete elsewhere in the plugin)
- **Broken launch command for profile names containing spaces**: the `VKBASALT_CONFIG_FILE` path is now quoted
- **TypeScript build warning**: removed a `placeholder` prop that isn't part of `TextFieldProps` in `@decky/ui`

### 📦 Installation

Same as before — download `vkbasalt-manager.zip` below, then in Gaming Mode: Quick Access Menu → **Settings** → **Developer** → **Install Plugin from ZIP File**.

See the [README](https://github.com/Vaddum/vkbasalt-manager/blob/main/decky-plugin/README.md) for the full shader list, profile usage, and troubleshooting.

m15t/decky-egpu-helper.name: v0.7.14
m15t/decky-egpu-helper.body:
## New since v0.7.11
- **RX 6800 support.** Cards are named from libdrm's `amdgpu.ids`, so a reference RX 6800 shows as "RX 6800", not "RX 6800 XT".
- **Resizable BAR on the eGPU.**
  - Docked at boot: the sleep hook installs `options thunderbolt host_reset=0`, which keeps the firmware's PCIe tunnel and its full BAR (16 GB on an RX 6800). Takes effect at the next boot.
  - Dock plugged in after boot: Auto-switch runs `egpu-sleep.sh rebar` through one passwordless sudo rule (`/etc/sudoers.d/zz-egpu-helper`, checked with `visudo`). It frees the dock's empty ports and re-adds the card with a full BAR; Gamescope then restarts once, onto the eGPU.
  - **Status** shows Resizable BAR On or Off with the BAR size.
- **Auto-switch waits for the card.** It counts the eGPU ready only once amdgpu has registered its DRM card. Before, Gamescope could restart a few seconds early and land on the built-in GPU after wake.
- **Quieter, card-driven fan hold during sleep.** The hook keeps the speed the card's own curve runs at that moment, at least 25% of the card's top speed, instead of a temperature table.

## Update
Install **decky-egpu-helper.zip** with Decky's ZIP install option. Then turn **Setup → Sleep hook** off and on again to install the new files (asks for your password). A docked reboot gives the full BAR at boot.

## Validation
- Ran 89 tests, TypeScript checks and the frontend build passed.
- Tested on a ROG Xbox Ally X with a reference RX 6800 in an AG03 dock:
  - Docked boot: 16 GB BAR; it stayed 16 GB across sleep and wake.
  - Dockless boot, then plug: Auto-switch ran `rebar`, the BAR went to 16 GB and Gamescope restarted once onto the RX 6800. Monster Hunter Wilds then ran for 47 minutes with no GPU ring timeouts.
  - Four wakes in a row started Gamescope on the RX 6800.
  - Keep dock linked off still needs the dock's TB5 button after wake, as before.

## Known issues
- Unplugging the dock while Gamescope runs on the eGPU can leave the screen black. Sleep first, then unplug.
- One earlier `rebar` session saw GPU ring timeouts that later runs did not reproduce; `rebar` output now goes to the journal (`journalctl -t egpu-sleep`).

jacobdonahoe/decky-game-optimizer.name: v0.1.0 - Initial Release
jacobdonahoe/decky-game-optimizer.body:
## Game Optimizer v0.1.0

Automatically fetches and applies community-sourced optimal settings for your installed Steam Deck games.

### Features
- Scans all installed Steam games across all library locations
- Fetches hardware settings (TDP, GPU clock, refresh rate, FSR mode) from **SteamDeckHQ**
- Fetches compatibility ratings from **ProtonDB**
- Applies settings per-game: launch options, Proton version, and hardware tuning via PowerTools
- SQLite cache with 24h TTL for offline use after initial sync
- Optional auto-apply when a game launches
- Optional restore to defaults when a game exits

### Requirements
- [Decky Loader](https://decky.xyz)
- [PowerTools](https://git.ngni.us/NG-SD-Plugins/PowerTools) (optional, for TDP/GPU clock control)

### Installation
1. Download `decky-game-optimizer-v0.1.0.zip`
2. Extract to `~/homebrew/plugins/game-optimizer/` on your Steam Deck
3. Restart the Decky plugin loader
4. Open Quick Access Menu → Game Optimizer

### Data Sources
- [SteamDeckHQ](https://steamdeckhq.com) — hardware settings
- [ProtonDB](https://protondb.com) — compatibility tiers

danielcamilo1/decky-cloud-saves.name: v0.1.0
danielcamilo1/decky-cloud-saves.body:
First release.

- Finds non-Steam games from Steam's `shortcuts.vdf` and locates each one's Proton prefix
  under `steamapps/compatdata`.
- Bundled database of save locations for 51 games, with path templates that resolve both
  inside a Proton prefix and against a real Windows profile.
- Google Drive backup using the `drive.file` scope only, so the plugin can never see
  anything in your Drive that it did not create itself.
- Sign-in via the OAuth device-code flow, which works in Gaming Mode without a browser.
- Snapshot-based sync: each backup is one timestamped zip, with configurable history.
- Steam Cloud style conflict resolution — when both sides changed, you pick, and the copy
  you do not keep is archived locally first.
- Automatic sync when a tracked game starts and exits.
- Windows companion app sharing the same engine, shipped as a single .exe.

## Installing

**Steam Deck** — install in Decky Loader with **Settings → Developer mode → Install Plugin from URL**, using the `.zip` link below, or download it and copy it to the Deck.

Already running [Decky Bazaar](https://github.com/danielcamilo1/decky-bazaar)? Add `danielcamilo1/decky-cloud-saves` to it and let it update itself.

**Windows** — download `DeckCloudSaves.exe` and run it. Sign in with the same Google account you linked on the Deck.

Both ends need a Google OAuth client the first time; see the README for the five-minute setup.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/danielcamilo1/decky-cloud-saves/commits/v0.1.0

third-party notices apply.

Games found via a Steam collection or the "All" library scope that aren't

installed games' local manifest files. Now resolved from Steam's own local
metadata cache (\`appcache/appinfo.vdf\`) — still no Steam Web API key
needed. Verified against real collections (24/24 and 119/119 names

miguellara999/decky-apdetail.name: v0.1.0 — first release
miguellara999/decky-apdetail.body:
First release.

APDetail shows which WiFi access point (BSSID) your Steam Deck is connected to, and lets you
switch to a different AP on the same SSID — useful on mesh networks where the Deck gets stuck
on a distant access point.

### Features

- Current connection: SSID, BSSID, AP vendor, live signal in dBm and %, band, channel, link rate, IP.
- All APs on your SSID sorted by signal, each with vendor, MAC, band, channel, dBm/% and the age
  of the reading. A toggle lists every visible network instead.
- Tap an AP to switch to it — a fast reassociation that does not drop the connection.
- Vendor lookup from an embedded IEEE OUI database (works offline).
- UI follows the Steam language: Spanish when Steam is in Spanish, English otherwise.

### Install

Download `APDetail-v0.1.0.zip` below, then on the Deck: Decky → ⚙ → Developer →
**Install plugin from zip**.

### SteamOS note

SteamOS uses **iwd**, which only allows choosing an access point in developer mode. The first time
you open the plugin, press **Enable iwd developer mode**: it adds a systemd drop-in and restarts
iwd (WiFi drops for a few seconds and reconnects by itself). The same button reverts it, and
uninstalling the plugin reverts it automatically. See the
[README](https://github.com/miguellara999/Decky-APDetail#steamos-and-iwd) for the details.

Tested on SteamOS with a two-AP network sharing one SSID.

logic-mle/decky-guide.name: Decky Guide v1.0.0 · 首个正式版
logic-mle/decky-guide.body:
## Decky Guide 1.0.0 · 首个正式版

在 Steam Deck 游戏模式中自动识别当前游戏，搜索游民星空攻略，并在 Decky 侧栏直接阅读图文内容。

### 主要功能

- 自动匹配中文游戏名称，支持手动搜索并按游戏记住别名。
- 图文阅读、章节目录与关键词筛选、上一页 / 下一页和原文入口。
- 按游戏保存阅读进度，支持继续阅读、三档字号和图片放大至 200%。
- LB / RB 按住滚动，X 打开目录，Y 打开阅读设置，B 分层返回。

### 安装

1. Steam Deck 需先安装 [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader#installation)。本项目以 3.2.8 接口为基准，其他版本兼容性需实机确认。
2. 在本页 Assets 下载 **DeckyGuide-v1.0.0.zip**，无需解压或编译。
3. 在 Decky 设置中启用开发者模式，使用从 ZIP 安装；若界面提供从 URL 安装，可使用下方直链。
4. 安装完成后打开 Decky Guide，启动游戏或手动输入中文游戏名搜索。

[下载安装 ZIP](https://github.com/Logic-mle/decky-guide/releases/download/v1.0.0/DeckyGuide-v1.0.0.zip)

GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包不含编译产物，不能作为插件安装包。`.zip.sha256` 用于校验下载完整性，不需要安装。

### 从测试版升级

这是基于 0.6.5 功能整理的首个正式开源版本，补齐文档、版本和发布流程。直接覆盖安装；本地存储键保持一致，保留 Steam UI 本地存储时无需迁移。清理本地存储会删除记录。

### 验证与已知限制

发布流程自动执行类型检查、5 项阅读状态测试和构建，并校验 ZIP 内容。未在本次发布流程中执行 Steam Deck 实机兼容性测试；浏览器模拟不能替代原生手柄焦点验证。

需要联网，游民星空页面变化可能影响搜索或解析；重名及非 Steam 游戏可能需要手动匹配。视频、互动地图与脚本内容可能需打开原文查看。阅读进度不跨设备同步。

插件代码采用 MIT 许可证；攻略文字、图片及商标归各自权利人所有。本项目不是 Valve、Decky Loader 或游民星空官方产品。

[完整使用说明](https://github.com/Logic-mle/decky-guide#readme) · [更新日志](https://github.com/Logic-mle/decky-guide/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/Logic-mle/decky-guide/issues/new/choose)

## DSU server manager — now called Gyro DSU

**Legion Go Gyro DSU** to **Gyro DSU**.

  as used by Cemu and Eden, and on additional ports you configure.

**Legion Go Gyro DSU** plugin in Decky.

edinh86/memoryeditor.name: MemoryEditor v0.5.0 — Memory Workbench
edinh86/memoryeditor.body:
The big one: a **Memory Workbench** that brings a Cheat-Engine-style workflow to the Steam Deck.

### 🧰 Memory Workbench (new)
Attach to a game, then press **Open Memory Workbench** in the Quick Access panel for a full-screen page with:

- **Address list** — add addresses by absolute value (`0x…`) or by **module + offset**, give each a label and a type, and watch its **live value**. Per row: set a new value, freeze/unfreeze, view in the hex viewer, or remove.
- **Memory viewer** — a **hex + ASCII** dump of any address.
- **Cheat tables** — **Save / Reload / Delete** a table of addresses per game, keyed by its **Steam App ID**, so your list is there next time.
- **Static tagging** — addresses inside a loaded module are labelled with the module name.
- **Add to Workbench** — send any search result straight into the saved table.

### Everything from before
Async scans with progress + cancel · live value refresh · value freezing + frozen panel · undo · hex/negative numpad entry · range + string search · auto-detect the running game.

### Install (Desktop Mode)
Download `memoryeditor-0.5.0.zip` below, copy it to the Deck, then:

    sudo rm -rf ~/homebrew/plugins/memory-deck ~/homebrew/plugins/memoryeditor
    sudo unzip memoryeditor-0.5.0.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/
    sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader

Requires [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader). Personal project — not on any plugin store; install the attached zip manually.

### Notes
- Found addresses aren't guaranteed to be the same after a game restart (ASLR). Saved tables keep your labels and types; re-find the address in a new session, or use `module + offset` for addresses inside a module. (Pointer scanning, which makes cheats survive restarts, is the next planned step.)
- This plugin reads and writes another process's memory. It can crash games. Use at your own risk.

ddordie/newfreedeck-arm64.name: NewFreedeck v0.3 — armada (ARM64)
ddordie/newfreedeck-arm64.body:
armada 掌机（ARM64 / Fedora bootc）适配版，基于上游 NewFreedeck v0.3 release 包。

## 适配改动

- `defaults/bin/7zz`、`defaults/bin/aria2c` → **ARM aarch64 原生二进制**（独立子进程，原生执行最快）
- `py_modules/libnewfreedeck_core.so` → **保持 x86_64**（被宿主 PluginLoader 以 ctypes 加载；armada 的 decky 宿主是 x86_64 + FEX，动态库必须同架构）
- `main.py` → 修复 `_auto_extract` 重复触发导致的两个 7zz 并发解压同一目录（IO 翻倍、系统卡顿）
- 启动前缀 → `/usr/libexec/armada/armada-game-launch %command%`（默认开启，设置项改名「自动添加 armada 启动包装」）

## 安装

```bash
sudo rm -rf ~/homebrew/plugins/NewFreedeck
sudo unzip -o NewFreedeck-v0.3-arm64-fixed5.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/
sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader
```

## 说明

- 仅对新导入的游戏注入启动前缀；已导入的需手动改启动选项或重新导入
- 模拟器 AppImage 需自行从天翼云盘下载（插件不附带），且需 arm64 版本

michpalm/showreel.name: Showreel 0.1.0
michpalm/showreel.body:
First release.

## What it does

- **One button:** Record, then Stop, in the Quick Access menu. Everything on screen is recorded, Quick Access and Decky panels included, to H.264 MP4 at the screen's own resolution and 60 fps (about 5–6 MB per minute at 1080p on the Steam UI). No audio.
- **Files** go to `~/Videos/Showreel/`, and `latest.mp4` always points to the newest one.
- **Download page** (off by default): switch it on and open `http://<device-ip>:8790/` on another device. Tools can fetch `/recordings.json` and `/latest.mp4`. It is read-only.
- **Steam UI only:** Record is unavailable while a game runs, and a game that starts mid-recording stops it. On SteamOS 3.8, stopping a full-size screen capture while a game draws can crash gamescope.
- **Works with [Ambideck](https://github.com/michpalm/ambideck) 1.2.0+**, which steps aside while Showreel records (capture lock described in the README).

## Requirements

SteamOS in Game Mode with Decky Loader, and the GPU Screen Recorder…

nucat176/decky-16x10-fixes.name: v0.1.19-rc.1 — Resonance camera test
nucat176/decky-16x10-fixes.body:
## Camera test for Final Fantasy Resonance

This prerelease tests a possible correction for the image compression or reduced horizontal view reported with v0.1.18 at 1920x1200 on Legion Go 2. It changes the upstream mod's camera policy from preserving vertical field of view to preserving horizontal field of view. The expected result is the original horizontal scene width plus additional scenery above and below. The result has not yet been verified on the device.

HUD constraining stays disabled, the upstream movie correction stays enabled, and the same pinned full-game mod v0.3.0 is used. Only one byte of the mod changes; both original and adjusted hashes are checked before installation.

## Try it

1. Close the game and install `16x10-fixes.zip` from this prerelease through Decky.
2. Open 16:10 Fixes, press **Rescan**, select **Final Fantasy Resonance (Experimental)** and press **Reinstall Fix**. Updating the plugin alone does not replace the game mod.
3. Keep the game at **1920x1200** and SteamOS scaling on **Auto** or **Fit**.
4. Compare the same scene and camera position with v0.1.18. Check the left/right landmarks, extra visibility above/below, and whether characters retain their proportions.

To return to the earlier camera behavior, install the v0.1.18 plugin ZIP and press **Reinstall Fix** again. Both versions keep HUD constraining disabled.

## Validation

Seven backend tests, the Decky build/package, application typechecking with skipLibCheck, and local install/rollback using the actual upstream release ZIP passed. Character proportions, scene framing, HUD, menus, battle transitions and cutscenes still need on-device validation.

yifeplayte/rayneo-control.name: RayNeo Control v1.0.0
yifeplayte/rayneo-control.body:
A Decky Loader plugin that controls RayNeo XR glasses from the Steam Deck over USB — no phone app required.

> ### ⚠️ RayNeo GT Max only
>
> Developed and tested against the **RayNeo GT Max (雷鸟 GT Max)** and nothing else.
>
> The protocol is shared across the family, so other RayNeo / FFalcon models may work — but nothing here has been verified on them, the capability gating has only been exercised against one unit's bitmap, and the brightness table is selected by device type. Treat any other model as untested.
>
> If you try it on one, please open an issue with your `tools/rayneo_cli.py caps` output.

## Install

1. Download `RayNeo-Control.zip` below
2. Decky → **Settings → General** → turn on **开发者模式 / Developer mode**
3. Go to the new **开发者 / Developer** tab → **第三方插件 / Third-Party Plugins** → **浏览文件 / Browse** next to **从 ZIP 压缩文件安装插件 / Install Plugin from ZIP File** → pick the zip and confirm
4. Plug the glasses in over USB-C and press **Connect**

Decky hides the ZIP option behind developer mode, so step 2 is required.

No udev rules, no system packages. `plugin.json` declares `"flags": ["root"]` because the glasses' USB node is `0664 root:root` and a plugin running as `deck` cannot open it.

## What it does

| Section | Controls |
| --- | --- |
| 连接 Connection | Connect / disconnect, model + firmware readout |
| 显示 Display | 屏幕亮度 brightness, 显示模式 2D/3D, 屏幕尺寸 115 % / 100 % / 85 %, 场景模式 通用/电影/护眼/阅读, 动态画质 SDR / AI-HDR, 色彩增强 |
| 声音 Sound | 音量 volume, 音效 标准/轻语/空间环绕, 导音鳍 Sound Tube |

Every control is gated on the capability bitmap the glasses report, so unsupported options grey out rather than failing a write.

## Notable in this release

* **Both sliders write on every tick**, matching the official app, and brightness commits once at the end of a drag. Median round trip measured at **11 ms**, down from 515 ms in the first working version.
* **The panel never assumes a change landed.** Every silent command is confirmed against the status read-back, and a refusal moves the control back to where the hardware actually is rather than showing the requested value.
* **It recovers on its own.** Three unanswered polls release the handle and it keeps looking for the glasses, so replugging needs no button press — while a disconnect *you* asked for is left alone, not undone.
* **Debug mode** (one switch at the bottom of the panel) hides the diagnostic tools and silences the per-frame trace, the startup protocol tables and the timing notes. Errors and warnings are never silenced.

## Known limitations

* **Brightness tops out at 12 steps while the panel may reflect fewer.** The glasses stop reporting brightness above the current display strategy mode's band even though the write is accepted — the same reason the official app's slider appears to fall back on its own. The mode is not on the wire, so the ceiling is fixed rather than learned.
* **阅读 (reading) mode refuses colour enhancement in hardware** and reports success anyway; the toggle is greyed out there rather than trusting the read-back.
* **`0x0D` (brightness save) is sent but has never been observed to do anything** on this hardware. It is kept because the official app sends it.
* **Refresh rate is not exposed** — the protocol supports 60/120 Hz and the device reports 120 Hz, but the official app offers no such setting on this model, so neither does the plugin.
* Changing 3D mode briefly blanks the glasses and shows a split screen. That is the device's normal behaviour.

## How it was built

The official Android app (雷鸟 XR 眼镜 v2.1.2) was decompiled and the native library carrying all device traffic, `libFFalconXRServer.so`, was reverse-engineered to recover the USB framing and the full command set. Nothing from the app is redistributed; this is an independent implementation of the wire protocol.

The command table was recovered twice by two independent methods (raw disassembly and Ghidra's decompiler), which agree on all 33 opcodes. The write-up is in [`docs/PROTOCOL.md`](docs/PROTOCOL.md), and the engineering notes behind the behaviour above are in [`docs/NOTES.md`](docs/NOTES.md).

## Requirements

* Steam Deck with Decky Loader
* RayNeo GT Max glasses

---

MIT licensed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by RayNeo or FFalcon.

m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper.name: v1.2.1 – First release
m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper.body:
**Xbox Wireless Helper**, a Decky Loader plugin that makes the Xbox Wireless Adapter behave on Bazzite, SteamOS, and other Linux gaming setups.

## ✨ Features

- **Fixes the controller after sleep.** No more unplugging and replugging the adapter. After every wake, the plugin waits for USB to settle and resets the adapter in software. If the gentle reset fails, it escalates: re-authorize → USB port power-cycle → USB reset.
- **Wake the PC with the Xbox button.** One toggle enables wake on the adapter, its hubs, the USB controller, and the matching firmware (ACPI) wake entries. It's re-applied after every reset and replug, and your original settings are restored when you turn it off or uninstall.
- **Pairing button.** Put the adapter into pairing mode from the Quick Access menu, without reaching behind the PC.
- **Live status.** The panel shows the adapter, connected controllers and how each is connected (adapter / Bluetooth / cable), wake status, and the last reset result.
- **Keep USB powered in sleep** (last resort). Switches sleep to s2idle for boards that cut USB power in deep sleep. ⚠️ May keep the fans running.

**Requirements:** Decky Loader, and the `xone` driver for the adapter (default on Bazzite). Pairing and wake-from-sleep need `xone`.

## ⚠️ Known limitations

- Bluetooth-connected controllers can't wake the PC on Linux. Use the adapter or a cable.
- "Keep USB powered in sleep" (s2idle) keeps most desktop boards in their "on" power state, so the fans keep spinning.
- BIOS options vary a lot between manufacturers. Please open an issue with your board model if wake doesn't work for you.

Tested on Bazzite with the Xbox Wireless Adapter for Windows.

## What's Changed
* Bump @types/react-dom from 19.1.1 to 19.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper/pull/7


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m2aadhil/decky-xbox-wireless-helper/compare/v1.0.0...v1.2.1

alf1995/playtime-tracker.name: Release v1.0.1
alf1995/playtime-tracker.body:
# PlayTime Tracker v1.0.1 🎮

Plugin de seguimiento de tiempo de juego para SteamOS mediante Decky Loader.

## Características

- Seguimiento automático del tiempo de juego.
- Estadísticas diarias, semanales, mensuales y acumuladas.
- Historial de sesiones y gráficos de actividad.
- Recordatorios de descanso y límites diarios.
- Exportación de estadísticas en JSON y CSV.
- Soporte para español e inglés.
- Almacenamiento local mediante SQLite.
- Interfaz optimizada para el menú de Decky Loader.

## Instalación

1. Descarga `PlayTime-Tracker-v1.0.1-INSTALL.zip` desde los archivos adjuntos de esta Release.
2. Abre Decky Loader en SteamOS.
3. Activa el modo desarrollador.
4. Selecciona **Developer → Install Plugin from ZIP**.
5. Instala el archivo descargado.

## Compatibilidad

Diseñado para SteamOS y dispositivos compatibles con Decky Loader.

**Nota:** la detección del tiempo de juego se basa en procesos del sistema y puede ser aproximada. Algunas funciones dependen de la compatibilidad del dispositivo.

Para más información, consulta el README del repositorio.

mwgih/scopy.name: SCopy for Decky (latest from main)
mwgih/scopy.body:
# Install SCopy on a Steam Deck or Steam Machine

SCopy is a [Decky Loader](https://decky.xyz) plugin. Install Decky Loader first if you haven't already.

## From the URL (easiest)

1. In Decky's settings, turn on **Developer mode**.
2. Open **Developer**, choose **Install plugin from URL** and paste this address:

```text
https://github.com/MWGIH/SCopy/releases/download/decky-latest/SCopy.zip
```

To update, press **Update plugin** in SCopy, or install from the same URL again.

## If the URL doesn't work, use the zip instead

1. Download **SCopy.zip** from this release (under **Assets**) in the Deck's browser (Desktop Mode), or copy it to the Deck's Downloads folder.
2. In Decky's **Developer** settings, choose **Install plugin from ZIP** and pick `SCopy.zip`. Don't unzip it first.

## Use it

Press the **...** (Quick Access) button, open the Decky plug icon and pick **SCopy**. Press **Start sharing**, then open the address it shows in a browser on your PC or phone and enter the PIN.

zacharyqin/power-timeline.name: v0.3.13
zacharyqin/power-timeline.body:
## 0.3.13 — 2026-10-28

### English

- Include daily battery-health history and account-scoped persistent game icons from the preceding development build. Health observations remain independent of rolling timeline retention; saved icons can be reused after their original artwork disappears.
- Archive native icons served from Steam's current `community_assets/images/apps` path as well as its older public-image path. Keep the fixed Steam download origin, exact AppID/image-hash checks and account-scoped stored bytes. Fixes visible game icons not being saved for later reuse.
- Keep the battery-health plot at a fixed 132-pixel height, with coordinates sized to its actual width and fewer date labels in narrow layouts. Prevent large displays from enlarging the chart and its text while preserving real history, range selection and scrubbing.
- Share explicit runtime/source manifests and archive exclusions between local and CI packaging. Exclude authoring GLB/projection files, caches and debug output; preserve runtime images, notices and matching Decky API rebuild sources. Validate source freshness and publish only the exact generated runtime/source ZIP pair.
- Replace the three hardware PNG layers with lossless WebP, preserving visible pixels and transparency. Keep only executable code, WebP assets, Loader metadata and essential offline notices in the install ZIP; provide matching sources separately with a version-specific download link. Disable release source maps and exclude documentation, old PNGs and duplicate license files from the runtime package.

### 中文

- 本版本一并交付此前开发版的每日电池健康度历史与按账户隔离的游戏图标持久缓存。健康度独立于功率历史滚动保留，原图来源失效后可回退已存图标。
- 补齐 Steam 当前 `community_assets/images/apps` 原生图标路径，同时保留旧公共图片路径支持。下载仍限定固定 Steam 来源、精确 AppID／图片哈希与账户隔离，修复图标已显示却未保存、无法在来源消失后复用的问题。
- 健康度图表固定为 132 像素高，按实际宽度绘制坐标，窄布局减少日期刻度，避免大屏把图表与文字一起放大；保留真实历史、范围选择和游标操作。
- 本地与 CI 共用明确的运行包／源码包清单和排除规则，去除设计 GLB／投影文件、缓存和调试产物；保留运行图片、许可声明与匹配的 Decky API 重建源码。打包前校验源码归档是否最新，构建产物只上传本次生成的安装／源码 ZIP 对。
- 三张硬件 PNG 图层改为无损 WebP，保留可见像素与透明度。安装 ZIP 仅保留运行代码、WebP、Loader 元数据与必要离线许可内容；匹配源码单独交付并提供对应版本下载入口。关闭发布 source map，排除运行包中的文档、旧 PNG 和重复许可文件。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.15 — 引擎环境不再被 PyInstaller 遮蔽
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
## 症状

引擎正常启动、界面能开，但配置管理的**同步**失败：

```
读取远端快照失败：git clone https://github.com/<user>/<repo>.git 失败 (exit 128)
… /_MEI0000054cWWSwqE/libssl.so.3: version `OPENSSL_3.5.0' not found
   (required by /usr/lib/libcurl.so.4) …
致命错误：remote helper 'https' aborted session
```

## 根因

SteamOS 的 `/usr/bin/flatpak` 是 PyInstaller 打包的，它把自带的旧 OpenSSL 解包到 `$TMPDIR/_MEIxxxxxx/`。Decky 服务进程的 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 指向这种目录，于是**所有子进程**（node、git、git-remote-https）都优先从那里加载 libssl，版本不够就 abort。

v0.1.6 修过一模一样的坑，但只修了「启动浏览器的环境」（`_gui_env`）；**启动引擎的环境**（`_build_env`）仍然原样继承 `os.environ` —— 引擎活了，它下面的 git 死了。

## 修法

清洗提到最外层统一入口 `_sanitize_inherited_env()`，引擎与浏览器两条 spawn 路径都走它。比 v0.1.6 更克制也更彻底：

- `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` / `LD_PRELOAD` 里**只删**指向 `_MEI…` 的条目和已不存在的目录，**你手动设的合法值会被保留**（v0.1.6 是整条丢掉）
- 整条都被遮蔽时**移除变量**而不是留空（空条目在加载器语义里等于「当前目录」）
- `TMPDIR` 只在「是 `_MEI` 目录 / 不可写 / 不存在」时才换成 `/tmp`

## 升级

下载下方的 `dsh-decky.zip` 覆盖安装，然后**重启引擎**（插件改的是启动环境，不重启不生效）。

## 应急（不升级也能救）

```bash
env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH TMPDIR=/tmp <原来的 dsh 启动命令> --profile web --no-open --port 3080
```

或把配置管理的同步通道从 **Git** 换成 **Gist / WebDAV** —— 那两条走 Node 的 HTTPS，根本不 spawn `git`。

## 测试

`tests/run_tests.py` 新增 8 项 env 清洗回归检查，全量 95 项通过。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.14 — 方案C：注册为游戏库条目（游戏模式内可见）
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机定案（v0.1.12/13）：外部浏览器确实能启动，但窗口开在桌面显示 :0 上，游戏模式看不到——gamescope 只合成自己的 Wayland 画面，X11 客户端无法盖在游戏之上。方案 B 在游戏模式结构性走不通。

方案 C 把启动交给 Steam 自己：由 gamescope 会话内启动浏览器，窗口自然得到合成。

- 后端 prepare_nonsteam()：生成稳定的启动脚本，并把会轮换的 token URL 写入 last-url.txt（Steam 注册时会快照 Exec 目标，URL 必须放在脚本外）；引擎每打印新 token 都自动刷新该文件
- 前端通过 SteamClient.Apps.AddShortcut 注册（先移除同名条目保持幂等），API 不可用时给出手动「添加非 Steam 游戏」的准确路径
- 有意不手写 shortcuts.vdf：那是 Steam 自己的二进制格式，写错会毁掉用户整个游戏库

用法：游戏模式 → 插件 → 添加为游戏库条目（方案 C）→ 回首页启动「DSH Browser」。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.13 — 分离启动延迟回读诊断
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机确认：v0.1.12 的 X11 路线让 Firefox 窗口成功开出来了——但开在桌面模式的 :0 显示上，游戏模式（gamescope）看不到它。X11 窗口无法进入 gamescope 合成，方案 B 的外部浏览器在游戏模式里天生受限。

本版为诊断增强：flatpak 交接启动后 6 秒回读——pgrep 应用真实进程存活状态 + 读取继承的 stderr + 记录实际 DISPLAY，写入面板日志。用于区分"活在别的显示"与"交接后崩溃"。（方案 C：注册为 Non-Steam 游戏由 Steam/gamescope 直接启动，下一版。）

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.12 — 强制 X11：Wayland 注入导致 GTK seat 崩溃
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机日志显示 Firefox 已能启动（org.mozilla.firefox:2），随即死在 `gdk_seat_get_keyboard: assertion 'GDK IS SEAT (seat)' failed`（附 minidump）。原因：插件注入了 WAYLAND_DISPLAY=gamescope-0，但 flatpak 沙箱内的浏览器够不着 gamescope 的 Wayland socket，GTK 拿到空 seat 直接断言崩溃。

本版强制走 X11（XWayland :0，与 Steam 内置浏览器同一显示路线）：移除 WAYLAND_DISPLAY、设 GDK_BACKEND=x11、MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND=0。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: v0.1.11 — 接受 flatpak run 的 fork 语义（退出码0=成功）
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
真机日志：这台机器的 flatpak 不认识 --nofork（未知选项）。不再对抗 fork：flatpak run 派生应用后自己退 0 被判定为启动成功（detached_ok 候选专属语义），仅非 0 退出才换下一个候选。

注意：「关闭外部窗口」对分离启动的应用用 pkill -f 按 app id 精确匹配——若桌面上同时开着另一个 flatpak Firefox，会一并被关闭（如实声明的已知限制）。

3570548848/dsh-decky.name: DSH Launcher v0.1.2
3570548848/dsh-decky.body:
**最新版本。** 新增第二种打开方式：用外部浏览器开一个独立窗口。

> **⚠️ 装哪个版本？** 请**明确下载 v0.1.2**（下方附件）。不要用 `/releases/latest`——它指向 **v0.1.1**，因为本版标着 Pre-release 被跳过了，而 v0.1.1 **不含本版功能**。

---

## 本版新增：两种打开方式

原先只有一条路：把界面交给 Steam 自带浏览器。现在设置里多了一个选项。

| | 方式 A · Steam 内置浏览器（默认） | 方式 B · 外部浏览器独立窗口（新增） |
|---|---|---|
| 做法 | `Navigation.NavigateToExternalWeb(url)` | 插件启动真实浏览器：Chromium 系 `--app=<url>`；Firefox 系 `--kiosk <url>` |
| 形态 | 在 Steam 浏览器内打开 | 无地址栏窗口，**盖在游戏模式之上** |
| 依赖 | Steam 未公开 API（`CreateBrowserView` 等） | **完全绕开** Steam 私有 API |
| 抗更新 | 较弱（Steam 升级可能失效） | **较强**（用的是标准浏览器） |
| 前提 | Steam 浏览器可用 | 设备上装着浏览器（含 flatpak 版） |

方式 B 会自动探测浏览器：原生路径（`/usr/bin`、Homebrew、nix、snap）→ flatpak。面板里新增 **「探测可用浏览器」** 按钮，可直接看到它会用哪一个。

### 为什么值得加方式 B

它**不碰任何 Steam 未公开 API**，因此不受 Steam 更新影响；方式 A 依赖那些黑 API，Steam 一升级就可能失效。代价是窗口**盖在游戏模式之上**，而不是嵌在 Decky 面板里。

### 两个实现要点

flightdan/opti2xmx.body:
# Opti2XMX 0.3.6

- Fix FSR 4.1.2 Lite XMX image corruption with the current 20261119 XMX runtime. Its patched Mesa 26.3.1 driver handles sampler descriptor tables using the runtime compiler. The legacy 20261005 runtime retains its per-game compiler correction.
- Add the managed --launcher-skip option for Cyberpunk 2077 and a Repair action for existing XMX installations. Repair tells you to launch and exit the game once if its Proton prefix still needs initialization.
- Improve Opti reinstall and prefix checks so an uninitialized Proton prefix can be repaired before the XMX transaction changes game files.

If you set up FSR with an earlier plugin version, exit the game, turn XMX off and back on in Opti2XMX, then select FSR again. This refreshes the per-game launcher and compiler cache. Start the game from Steam.

The Decky ZIP uses the same separately downloaded XMX runtime. Import the original, pinned FSR model ZIP from a local file in the plugin.

## Verification

- On an ONEXPLAYER 3 with SteamOS and Intel Arc B390, Cyberpunk 2077 rendered normally after switching to the runtime compiler and rebuilding the per-game cache. The in-game overlay confirmed FSR 4.1.2 output. The README screenshots show gameplay.
- Linux regression checks cover the modern and legacy compiler paths, the FSR launch guard, runtime validation, and restore.
- This standalone Decky release verifies the reported graphics corruption on the tested configuration. The screenshots are gameplay captures.

Download: [opti2xmx-0.3.6.zip](https://github.com/FlightDan/Opti2XMX/releases/download/v0.3.6/opti2xmx-0.3.6.zip)

enjihn/steamos-ddplus-decky.body:
# SteamOS DD+ 1.0.0-beta.1

This first public prerelease packages the accepted SteamOS Dolby Digital Plus
runtime as a Decky Loader plugin.

## Included

- Optional DD+ 5.1 and DD+ 7.1 HDMI/eARC profiles.
- Direct switching among stock Stereo, stock 5.1 LPCM, stock 7.1 LPCM, DD+ 5.1,
  and DD+ 7.1.
- Live ELD and PipeWire device discovery; no hard-coded HDMI card or PCM.
- Transactional, user-local installation and removal with exact-file ownership,
  crash recovery, and stock-profile preservation checks.
- The accepted x86_64 E-AC-3 runtime, exact corresponding FFmpeg source,
  third-party notices, and SHA-256 checksums.

## Validation completed

- 47 codec, IEC 61937, channel-map, and reference tests.
- Complete legacy deployment, activation, rollback, and recovery test suite.
- Decky backend transaction tests covering all five selections, interrupted
  recovery, exact rollback, and preservation of unrelated defaults.
- TypeScript typecheck and production Rollup build.
- x86_64 packaged-runtime loader and codec self-test in the pinned SteamOS
  builder.

## Prerelease boundary

The bundled DD+ runtime is the already accepted Steam Machine build. The new
portable Decky discovery and installer have automated Linux coverage but have
not yet completed a clean-machine hardware acceptance run across multiple
HDMI/eARC endpoints. Back up important configuration and use the plugin's
Remove action before uninstalling Decky itself.

This independent project is not certified, licensed, endorsed, or supported by
Dolby Laboratories or Valve. Review the repository licensing and third-party
notices before redistribution.

beta.4 主要固化了兼容环境自动准备、米哈游四款游戏的三类区服路由，以及 Epic 和 SteamGridDB 的已验收流程。

- 扩展兼容层发现范围，支持已挂载的 Steam 库和外置存储。

- 修复 Epic 同步后数量缓存不刷新的逻辑，并支持超过 50 款游戏的分页读取。

acestronautical/decky-protonvpn.name: Proton VPN for Decky (Unofficial) v0.1.0
acestronautical/decky-protonvpn.body:
# Proton VPN for Decky (Unofficial) v0.1.0

Initial experimental prerelease of an independent Decky integration for Proton VPN.
Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Proton AG.

## Install

Download **decky-protonvpn-v0.1.0.zip**, not GitHub's source archives. In Decky settings, select **Manual Plugin Install > Load from ZIP file**.

**Upgrading from a development build:** remove the old Decky plugin named **Proton VPN** first, then install **Proton VPN (Unofficial)**. Do not uninstall the Proton VPN Flatpak or remove its account data. This avoids two plugin copies controlling the same VPN.

## Included

- Native Connection, Settings, and Account tabs with controller navigation.
- Fast NetworkManager-only connection viewing, Quick Connect, country selection, and disconnect.
- Encrypted sign-in, verified account-name display, and confirmed sign-out.
- Kill-switch controls with disconnected-state guards, NetShield, VPN Accelerator, and Moderate NAT.
- Confirmed user-scoped Proton VPN Flatpak installation when missing, with resumable panel status and compatibility verification.
- Shared operation coordination across panel remounts and guarded, non-destructive keyring access.

## Verification and Limits

- 166 automated tests, TypeScript checking, and packaging verified locally.
- Earlier on-device connection, disconnection, authentication, and IPv4 routing checks passed; these are not comprehensive leak or security certification.
- Live first-install testing, reboot/session-transition durability, and comprehensive IPv6/DNS leak testing remain outstanding.
- Unsupported Proton implementations fail closed. Close Proton's desktop GUI before using plugin controls.
- Keep the Deck awake and do not restart Decky during Flatpak installation. Job state survives panel reopening, not backend restart.

## License and Branding

Software remains BSD-3-Clause with inherited attribution preserved. Dependency notices and the custom artwork notice are included in **NOTICE.md** inside the ZIP. The software license does not grant trademark rights. The custom icon is retained as supplied and confirmed for use by the maintainer; it is not presented as an official Proton logo.

SHA-256 checksums are provided in **SHA256SUMS**.

dawoodtogoo2020-code/helixsr-decky-armad.body:
Adds verified HelixSR 2.0 management for PRAGMATA on Odin 3 running Armada Linux: local source registration, adoption, original-FSR/Helix toggles, INT8/wave/network/reactive-mask settings, atomic recovery and protection from legacy V762 actions.

Startup no longer runs a Wine/GPU probe. The H2 path avoids worker-thread shutdown failures observed under Decky/FEX; two final reloads stopped cleanly in 0.1 seconds. Confirmation dialogs now survive the side panel closing.

Validation: 48 frontend tests; 67 relevant native Odin backend tests; 156 general backend tests on x86 Linux. Actual Decky UI toggles, live settings changes, exact restoration, installed file hashes and reloads were checked. See the attached review for measured results and limitations.

A new 30-second gameplay sample at 960x540 Balanced, INT8 on, wave auto, current WinNative driver and 1100 MHz measured about 29.5 base FPS with LSFG off; p99 frame time 190.72 ms. This is not an improvement claim or sustained/image-quality acceptance. LSFG 2x and all original game settings were restored.

This is a scoped prerelease. It accepts only the tested PRAGMATA/provider hashes; it is not general Adreno, Android or HelixSR 3.x support. The ZIP contains no runtime/model DLLs, weights or generated shaders. Build the [official 2.0 provider](https://github.com/lonewolf0622/HelixSR/releases/tag/v2.0.0) locally on the target device and select its fsr3-drop-in folder. The setup/runtime stays unmodified; upstream terms apply.

Install `HelixSR-Decky-Armada-0.5.0-adreno-preview.zip` using Decky Loader's ZIP installation option, then open HelixSR Adreno. Matching source and SHA256SUMS are attached. No source downloads are required for an already qualified installation on this Odin.

Build audit: one acknowledged low-severity, build-only deepmerge advisory has a source-reviewed, exact-path exception with rejection tests and a 28 November 2026 expiry. Build tools are not distributed. See SECURITY.md in the source for the review; all other findings fail CI.

lakeland97/timeout-decky-plugin.name: v0.2.0 (alpha)
lakeland97/timeout-decky-plugin.body:
Alpha build for real-world field testing on Steam Deck.

## Update (Oct 14): no self-lockout
- Enabling parental controls now REQUIRES a passcode — the previous build could be enabled with none, leaving no unlock path except Desktop-Mode file editing
- Clearing an existing passcode while controls are enabled is now refused (setting a new one stays allowed — that's the recovery path)
- Whitespace-only passcodes are treated as empty; inputs are trimmed end-to-end
- Fixed: a WRONG passcode in the unlock dialog previously closed the dialog and unlocked anyway (backend always refused — the UI lied). It now visibly fails.

## What's new since v0.1.0 (alpha)

**Enforcement (the plugin's reason to exist)**
- Launch-menu "Cancel" and blocked launches (curfew / out of credits / cooldown) now actually stop the game instead of letting it run unlimited
- "Start Full" with insufficient credits is blocked, not swallowed
- Game termination is verified (SIGTERM → rescan → SIGKILL → verify) with a 60s retry loop — a failed kill can no longer end enforcement
- Fair cap/curfew kills are streak-neutral (runaway days still break the streak)

**Crash-safety / low breakage (plugin handles its own errors)**
- Every background task supervised; startup runs in independently guarded stages
- Stale focus AND stale game-limits sessions reconciled at boot (power-off mid-session can't cause boot-time modals, toast spam, or pre-outage kills)
- Corrupt settings.json restored from an automatic .bak snapshot; full read-boundary type sanitizer; all settings mutations serialized behind a lock
- Frontend: Steam callback wrapped, dismount hardened, promise hygiene, listener lifecycle balanced — SharedJSContext stays intact

**Security / parental controls**
- Passcode stored as salted SHA-256 (household-grade, honestly labeled)
- Locked users can no longer bypass protections through update_settings, import, or factory reset; raw settings RPCs privatized

**First-run UX**
- Installed-games picker list with search, curfew day-mask UI, in-game overlay badge (remaining time / credits / curfew)
- Backup paths contained (~/Documents, ~/Downloads) with clear refusal messages; custom-sound traversal blocked

**Tester kit**
- `TESTING.md` at repo root: 10 numbered manual test scenarios + known limitations — run it in order

## Install
Decky Loader → Settings → General → "Install from Zip" → select `timeout-decky-plugin.zip` (NOT the source zip) → restart Decky Loader.

**Alpha caveats:** passcode is household-grade; store listing items pending; see TESTING.md known-limitations before relying on it.

venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.name: Gleipnir 0.2.1
venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.body:
The battery clamp now writes 100000 µA (100 mA) instead of 0 (Armada's `constant_charge_current`) or 1000 (the fork's `charge_control_limit`), after review feedback on armada-os/armada#677 that values that low are below the safe minimum for the Thor and can upset less intelligent chargers.

**Re-run the safety test after updating.** The verification marker stores the clamp value, so an existing marker (`value=0`) no longer arms the daemon until `gleipnir --test --run` passes again.

Tested on one Thor (Armada kernel 7.2.6, 2026-10-24): with the 100000 clamp the charging current fell from 4.5 A to 12-29 mA, then charging resumed after release; the test passed. Not verified: the 0.2-5 W wattage fluctuation the reviewer described (the test measures current, not wattage), the clamp holding at 80 %, and other chargers or builds.

Also in this release: opt-in debug logging (`GLEIPNIR_DEBUG=1`), the FEX kernel-detection fix and the sleep-clamp hold fix from the changelog. The zip has a single top-level `gleipnir/` folder.

venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.name: Gleipnir 0.2.0
venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.body:
Adds the sleep clamp and its setting to Gleipnir, the 80 % battery charge ceiling for the AYN Thor on Armada OS.

**New since 0.1.0**
- The cap now holds through native sleep. Armada's native sleep freezes the daemon, so a Thor that slept at 78 % on a charger woke at 88 %. `gleipnir-sleep.service` clamps just before the suspend.
- A setting, in the Decky panel and as `gleipnir --set-sleep-floor N`: always hold the cap (default; the Thor then does not charge while asleep), hold from 70 % up, or off. The panel shows Armada's current sleep type and hides the setting in fake sleep, where the daemon keeps running.
- A watchdog fix: a game draining the battery with the status still reading Charging no longer disarms the cap.

**Tested on one Thor only** (Armada `20261006.9c7dd3e`, kernel 7.2.6, 2026-10-08): clamp at 80 %, held through a game, charger swaps and sleeps at 60, 76, 79 and 80 %, release at 77 %, charging resumed. Other builds are untested. It starts in watch-only mode and does…

venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.name: Gleipnir 0.1.0
venatrix-ritz/gleipnir.body:
First tagged build of Gleipnir: an 80 % battery charge ceiling for the AYN Thor on Armada OS.

**Tested on one Thor only** (Armada `20261006.9c7dd3e`, kernel 7.2.6, 2026-10-08): clamp at 80 %, held through a game load and charger swaps, released at 77 %, charging resumed, and the cap held through native sleep when the sleep starts at 70 % or more. Below 70 % on a charger the Thor still charges while asleep and can pass the cap. Other builds are untested. It starts in watch-only mode and does nothing to charging until its built-in safety test (`gleipnir --test --run`, charger plugged in) passes on your kernel. Read `docs/evidence.md` and `docs/safety.md` first.

Install: Decky panel > Gleipnir > Install, or `scripts/deploy.sh`. The zip has a single top-level `gleipnir/` folder (Decky plugin layout).

Not affiliated with AYN or Armada.
