koua29/decky-wicked-dupe.name: v0.1.0 — Save and restore the realm to duplicate items
koua29/decky-wicked-dupe.body:
**First release: duplicate items in No Rest for the Wicked from the Decky menu.**

## What's new
- **Save the realm**: copies the realm save files (world, chests). Character files are never touched.
- **Restore the realm**: puts the copy back. Items taken out of a chest after the copy are in the chest again and still in your bag.
- **Undo the last restore**: the realm is always backed up before a restore.
- Finds the save in every Steam library (Proton prefix of AppID 1371980), newest build folder.
- English and French interface.

## How to use
Steam offline → chest → Save the realm → take the items → main menu → Restore the realm → Continue. Back online, pick the **local** save.

## Download
Decky → Developer mode → Install plugin from URL:
`https://github.com/koua29/decky-wicked-dupe/releases/latest/download/WickedDupe.zip`

# Password Reset v0.1.6

SteamOS·Bazzite용 Decky 플러그인 첫 공개 릴리스입니다.

- 기존 비밀번호 없이 Decky 사용자 계정에 새 비밀번호 설정
- SteamOS·Bazzite 및 대상 계정 자동 감지
- 4~128자 입력, 확인 입력 및 준비 상태 안내
- Steam 기본 대화창으로 입력과 재설정을 한 화면에서 처리
- Steam Deck(SteamOS 3.9.6)·Legion Go 2(Bazzite 45)에서 플러그인 변경 후 SSH·sudo 인증 확인

이미 작동 중인 Decky Loader가 필요합니다. 사용자 로그인·sudo 비밀번호가 함께 변경되며 Steam 계정이나 디스크 암호는 바꾸지 않습니다. 기기를 조작해 이 플러그인을 실행할 수 있는 사람은 계정 비밀번호를 재설정할 수 있습니다.

**설치 파일은 아래 `PasswordReset-0.1.6.zip`입니다. Source code ZIP을 Decky에 설치하지 마세요.**

별도 데스크톱 스크립트, sudoers 설정, 복구 부팅 도구는 포함하지 않습니다.

cycledm/decky-clash-manager.name: Clash Manager v0.1.0
cycledm/decky-clash-manager.body:
## Clash Manager 0.1.0

- 修复 Steam Deck 上 FlClash 托管服务因 systemd 工作目录指令解析失败而无法启动的问题。
- 并发下载官方 FlClash 资产及其镜像，采用首个通过 SHA-256 校验的结果。慢速连接可使用更长的下载窗口，全部失败时保留进度最多的续传文件。

在 Decky Loader 开发者模式中选择「从 ZIP 安装」，使用本页的 `Clash-Manager-0.1.0.zip`。


### 下载修复

- 将慢速下载窗口延长至 60 分钟。超时或断流时自动重连，优先从已有字节续传。
- 所有来源都失败时，面板分别显示超时、TLS、HTTP 和校验等具体原因。


### SteamOS 证书修复

- FlClash 下载与版本检查显式使用 SteamOS 的证书库，修复 Decky 自带 OpenSSL 找不到根证书时出现的下载失败。HTTPS 证书和主机名校验保持开启。


### YAML 校验修复

- 校验配置时按 FlClash v0.9.3 的实际文件名加载随包地理规则数据库，修复导入部分包含 GEOIP 规则的配置时内核校验超时的问题。


### 订阅 User-Agent

- 在「当前 User-Agent」下拉框中直接切换。下次下载或刷新订阅时使用新值。自定义 User-Agent 可单独编辑和删除。

gomburger/decky-hangul-ime.name: Hangul IME Bridge v1.3.0
gomburger/decky-hangul-ime.body:
## 새로운 기능

- **리모트 플레이 지원:** Steam Deck에서 다른 PC의 게임을 리모트 플레이로 할 때, 게임을 등록하지 않아도 자동으로 동작합니다. 한글은 호스트 PC의 IME가 조합합니다. Windows 호스트에서 테스트했습니다.
  - Steam 가상 키보드의 한국어 자판은 각 자리의 영문 키를 보냅니다.
  - 지구본 키와 패널의 **가/A** 버튼은 호스트에 오른쪽 Alt를 보내 호스트와 자판의 한/영을 함께 바꿉니다. 호스트에서 오른쪽 Alt가 한/영 전환 키로 설정되어 있어야 합니다.
  - 한국어 자판의 Caps Lock 자리는 **한/영** 키가 되어, 자판은 그대로 두고 호스트의 한/영만 바꿉니다. 왼쪽 스틱 클릭도 같은 동작을 합니다. 호스트와 자판의 한/영이 어긋났을 때 맞추는 데 사용합니다.
  - Steam Deck에 연결한 물리 키보드로 한/영 키나 오른쪽 Alt를 누르면 가상 키보드의 자판도 따라 바뀝니다.

## 개선

- **백그라운드 동작 최적화:** 1초마다 상태를 확인하던 방식에서, 포커스 변경이나 게임·리모트 플레이의 시작과 종료처럼 상태가 바뀔 때 알림을 받아 동작하는 방식으로 바꿨습니다. 매초 실행하던 외부 프로그램 두 개(`pgrep`, `xprop`)가 없어져, 백그라운드 CPU 사용량이 1초에 약 37ms에서 게임 중에는 약 6ms로 줄었고, 게임을 하지 않을 때는 10초에 약 6ms, 1분이 지나면 0으로 줄어듭니다. 가상 키보드를 열고 닫을 때도 최대 1초 걸리던 반응이 바로 이뤄집니다. 일시 중지 중에는 아무 동작도 하지 않습니다.

## 알려진 문제

- 리모트 플레이에서 글자를 빠르게 입력하는 도중에 한/영을 바꾸면 호스트에서 전환이 빠질 수 있습니다. 리모트 플레이가 가상 키보드의 글자와 오른쪽 Alt를 따로 전달하기 때문입니다. 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 바꿔 주세요.
- 호스트의 한/영 상태는 Steam Deck에서 알 수 없어 가상 키보드의 자판 표시와 어긋날 수 있습니다. 대부분의 게임은 텍스트 입력 칸이 닫혀 있을 때 IME를 꺼 두기 때문에, 입력 칸이 닫힌 상태에서 지구본 키를 누르면 자판만 바뀌고 호스트의 한/영은 바뀌지 않는 경우가 가장 흔합니다. 호스트에서 직접 한/영을 바꿨을 때도 어긋납니다. 이때도 입력되는 글자는 호스트의 상태를 따르며, 한국어 자판의 **한/영** 키로 맞출 수 있습니다.
- 게임 실행 중에 플러그인을 업데이트하거나 Decky Loader가 다시 시작되면 입력 서버도 다시 시작되어, 게임이 강제 종료되거나 종료할 때 멈출 수 있습니다. 플러그인은 게임을 끈 뒤에 업데이트해 주세요.

gomburger/decky-hangul-ime.name: Hangul IME Bridge v1.2.6
gomburger/decky-hangul-ime.body:
## 새로운 기능

- **Enter 전 글자 확정:** 기본 (IME) 방식에 게임별 옵션을 추가했습니다. Enter를 누르면 조합 중이던 마지막 글자가 빠지는 게임에서 켜면, 마지막 글자를 확정한 뒤 Enter를 보냅니다.

## 개선

- **재시작 안내:** 게임을 다시 실행해야 할 때 게임 제목 아래에 안내를 표시합니다. 게임 실행 중에 **이 게임에서 사용**을 켜거나 껐을 때, 일시 중지를 해제했을 때, 플러그인이 다시 시작됐을 때 표시되며, 게임을 다시 실행하면 자동으로 사라집니다. 다시 실행하기 전까지는 Steam 가상 키보드가 원래 방식으로 동작합니다.
- **붙여넣기 후 클립보드 비우기:** 붙여넣기 방식으로 보낸 글자가 클립보드에 남지 않도록, 붙여넣은 뒤 2초가 지나면 클립보드를 비웁니다. 그 사이 다른 곳에서 복사한 내용은 지우지 않습니다.
- **게임 중 일시 중지 제한:** 게임이 입력 서버에 연결된 동안에는 **일시 중지**를 켤 수 없습니다. 게임 중에 입력 서버가 꺼지면 게임이 간헐적으로 강제 종료되거나, 종료할 때 멈출 수 있기 때문입니다.

## 수정

- **이 게임에서 사용**을 켜거나 끈 뒤 패널을 닫았다 열면 재시작 안내가 사라지던 문제

## 알려진 문제

- 게임 실행 중에 플러그인을 업데이트하거나 Decky Loader가 다시 시작되면 입력 서버도 다시 시작되어, 게임이 강제 종료되거나 종료할 때 멈출 수 있습니다. 플러그인은 게임을 끈 뒤에 업데이트해 주세요.

gomburger/decky-hangul-ime.name: Hangul IME Bridge v1.2.5
gomburger/decky-hangul-ime.body:
## 개선

- **맨 위로 스크롤:** **이 게임에서 사용**으로 포커스를 옮기면 패널이 맨 위까지 부드럽게 올라가, 게임 이름과 상태가 함께 보입니다.

## 수정

- **중복 입력에 의한 오동작 차단:**
  - **글자 보내는 방식** 선택 창을 B 버튼으로 닫을 때 Decky 플러그인 목록으로 돌아가던 문제
  - A 버튼을 빠르게 누르면 **글자 보내는 방식** 선택 창이 열리자마자 항목이 선택되던 문제
- 키보드 불투명도를 100% 미만으로 낮추면 **고급** 버튼 위의 구분선이 사라지던 문제

gomburger/decky-hangul-ime.name: Hangul IME Bridge v1.2.4

## 개선

- **글자 보내는 방식을 드롭다운 메뉴에서 선택:** 따로 켜고 끄던 **조합 중 글자 바로 입력**과 **붙여넣기로 입력**을 드롭다운 메뉴 하나로 합쳤습니다. 메뉴에서 **기본 (IME)**, **조합 중 글자 바로 입력**, **붙여넣기로 입력** 중 하나를 고릅니다. 방식마다 어떻게 입력하는지, 어떤 게임에서 쓰는지 설명을 보강해서 처음 쓰는 사람도 쉽게 고를 수 있습니다.

luchengfj/decky-mod-manager.name: Decky MOD Manager 0.2.0
luchengfj/decky-mod-manager.body:
Decky MOD Manager 0.2.0 — 在 Steam Deck 游戏模式的 QAM 里管理游戏 MOD（纯手柄，无终端、无 root）。

## 安装
1. 已装 [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader)（v3.x）
2. 下载下方 `decky-mod-manager-0.2.0.zip`
3. QAM → Decky → 设置 → 插件管理 → **从 ZIP 安装** → 选中该 ZIP
4. 安装后 Decky 会自动加载（若没出现，重启一次 Steam）

## 功能
* **星露谷物语**（SMAPI 只检测）：MOD 导入 / 启用 / 禁用 / 卸载 / 回滚，依赖检测与拉取
* **赛博朋克 2077**：root_merge 引擎按文件安装进声明目录（archive/pc/mod、mods/、bin/x64/plugins、r6/scripts、red4ext）
* **任意 Steam 游戏**：面板里指定加载器读取的文件夹即可管理（带反作弊的在线游戏自动拒绝）
* **加载器交接**：一键打开 BepInEx / MelonLoader 官方下载页，把你下载的 ZIP 解压进游戏目录（可随时像普通 MOD 一样卸载）
* 每次变更都有 journal，可回滚；52 个稳定错误码；中英双语界面

## 已知边界
* SMAPI 启动项必须用完整路径：`"<游戏目录>/StardewModdingAPI" %command%`
* 不装 SMAPI 本体、不改 Steam 启动项、不写 Proton prefix、永不 root

## 校验
```
SHA256: 3aa688d296005ae7566475bf041c1a9585db3bafdc0b921cd0448ebfed81e983
```

从源码构建见 [README](https://github.com/luchengfj/decky-mod-manager#构建)。

davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.name: v0.5.9
davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.body:
### Профиль «Музыка» и автоэквалайзер, который успевает за фильмами

- **Новый профиль «Музыка»** (как в модуле для телефона): широкая сцена без нажима. Голос не выделяется, комната маленькая и тихая (RT60 0,25 с), боковые и тыловые каналы чуть тише, динамика не трогается.
- **Автоэквалайзер в фильмах и играх** проверяет речь и музыку каждую секунду и меняет кривую примерно за 2 секунды. Раньше между проверками была пауза около 20 секунд.
- **Жанр уточняется только в профиле «Музыка»:** найденный жанр держится около 20 секунд музыки, затем перепроверяется. Рок и джаз определяются примерно за 5 секунд, метал за 6, электроника за 7.
- Модели по-прежнему выгружаются из памяти при выключении тумблера и после 10 секунд тишины.

davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.name: v0.5.8
davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.body:
### Точный апмикс 7.1 и автоэквалайзер (как в модуле для телефона)

- **Точный апмикс 7.1** (тумблер): стерео раскладывается по частотам. Прямой звук остаётся на своей позиции (лево, центр, право), атмосфера уходит в боковые и тыловые каналы. Жёстко панорамированный звук больше не расплывается на противоположную сторону. В режиме «Кино» с нейросетью отделённый голос идёт в центр синхронно с остальным звуком.
- **Автоэквалайзер** (тумблер): YAMNet отличает речь от музыки, Discogs-EffNet (400 стилей Discogs, заменил MSD-MusiCNN) уточняет жанр. После пространственного рендера плавно применяется мягкая кривая из трёх полос.
- **Бережёт CPU и батарею:** распознавание идёт короткими пробами, после устойчивого результата пауза около 20 секунд. Модели запускаются примерно в 4 раза реже. При выключении тумблера и после 10 секунд тишины модели выгружаются из памяти.
- **Стабильность:** профиль не скачет. Неуверенная проба не сбрасывает уже найденный жанр, при сомнении кривая остаётся ровной.
-…

davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.name: v0.5.5
davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.body:
### Более сочный и объёмный звук в режиме «Кино» + нейросеть
- **Кино-бас (LFE) для стерео:** очищенный нейросетью от голоса фон (`sep_rest`) мягко подмешивается в канал LFE (< 120 Гц) — глубже взрывы, удары и саундтрек без бубнения на диалогах.
- **Шире окружение:** очищенные от речи эффекты и музыка в стерео шире разносятся в боковые и тыловые виртуальные каналы (`0.58 / 0.52`), а в 5.1/7.1 очищенные от дубляжа тылы и бока получают мягкий подъём `+1.4 дБ`.
- **«Воздух» и детализация:** лёгкий верхний подъём (`+2 дБ` выше 4.5 кГц) применяется только к фону без голоса — детали окружения и музыка звучат сочнее без резких сибилянтов на речи.
- Без дополнительной нагрузки на CPU/нейросеть.

davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.name: v0.5.4
davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.body:
### Улучшения баланса диалогов в режиме «Кино»
- Снижен подъём диалогов в центре с `+5 дБ` до более естественных **`+2 дБ`**, чтобы голос не давил на музыку и эффекты.
- В стерео с нейросетью `StemgenRT` в центр переносится **75%** голоса, а **25%** остаётся в L/R — диалоги звучат объёмнее и мягче, без эффекта «сухого моно в лоб».
- В 5.1/7.1 (`_dub_fix_feeds`) сбор голоса переведён на энергосохраняющую норму (`min(norm(weights), 1.25)`), чтобы дубляж из нескольких каналов не перегружал центральный канал.

davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.name: v0.5.3
davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.body:
### Исправления и улучшения
- **Устранены хрипы в режиме «Кино» с нейросетью:** переписан конвейер `PipelinedVocals` (10-блочный джиттер-буфер, строгая синхронизация по порядковым номерам без дублирования блоков и провалов голоса, 2 потока ONNX, прогрев при старте, плавный переход на пассивную матрицу при нехватке CPU).
- **Устранён скрип и микро-обрывы в играх:** `parec` переведён на квант 6 мс (`--latency-msec=6`), а буфер вывода `pacat` увеличен до 30 мс (`--latency-msec=30`), чтобы буфер вывода не опустошался между пачками захвата.
- **Добавлен переключатель «Реверберация (комната)»:** можно полностью отключить комнату/эхо на лету (сохраняется по приложениям и дополнительно снижает нагрузку на CPU).
- **Ленивая загрузка нейросети:** в играх и при выключенной нейросети `StemgenRT` больше не загружается в память и не создаёт фоновых потоков.
- **Прочие исправления:** расширено автоопределение AR/VR-очков (`xreal`, `nreal`, `viture`, `rokid`, `rayneo`, `quest`, `pico`), убран…

davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.name: v0.5.1 — audio in step with the picture
davnozdu/ally-sound-lab.body:
Release v0.5.1 — audio stays in step with the picture.

Fixed
- Live audio could end up permanently ~2 s behind the picture. The worker talks
  to PipeWire through pipewire-pulse, whose streams accept up to 4 MB (about
  2.5 s of 8-channel audio) before they drop anything. Any stall — the first
  neural inference, a page fault, a scene hitch at game start — left that much
  audio queued, and because the worker then reads and plays at exactly real
  time the offset never shrank. A worker restart cleared it, which is why it
  looked random.
- Buffered audio is now capped (23 ms on the capture side, 46 ms on playback)
  and the graph streams run at 12 ms latency.
- If a block does not arrive within 250 ms the worker re-opens both ends and
  continues with live audio instead of replaying the backlog.

Measured on the Ally with Diablo IV running (chirp injected into the plugin
sink, recorded before and after the worker):

    before            2550 ms, and permanent
    after a 1.5 s stall…

Decky Loader plugin for MSI Claw A8 (AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme / BZ2EM).

## Features

- Switch the shared M1/M2 mode immediately: Macro, Combination, Disabled.
- Independent left/right rumble sliders with automatic saving after a 200 ms pause.
- Serialized writes, hardware read-back verification and error recovery.
- Clean uninstall/reinstall buttons and terminal recovery commands.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sekirofly/msi-claw-a8-back-buttons-rumble/v1.0.0/install.sh | bash
```

Requires Decky Loader, Python 3, curl, sudo and systemd. Run as your normal SteamOS desktop user.

**Save work and reboot after installation before returning to Gaming Mode.** On the tested A8, the embedded controller may not be detected until reboot.

**If rumble disappears or controller behavior remains abnormal after reboot, an EC reset may be needed.** A tester reported recovering lost vibration this way. It is not required…

smwatershldhelp/deckling.name: v0.1.0-rc.19
smwatershldhelp/deckling.body:
## [0.1.0-rc.19] - 2026-10-04

### Fixed

- Switching games switches Deckling. The running game was read from `Router.MainRunningApp` on a timer, and that value stayed on the game that was focused when the plugin loaded. After Sephiria, launching Graveyard Keeper still opened the Sephiria chat and the prompt still said Sephiria. Deckling subscribes to `SteamClient.GameSessions.RegisterForAppLifetimeNotifications`, and reads the focused app again when the Quick Access menu opens and on every send. Now playing updates immediately, that game's latest chat opens (or a new one), and a notice says "Switched to Graveyard Keeper". Every request, including a voice line that arrives during the switch, is sent with the game that is focused then. When more than one app is running, the one that just started is used. Older "[Playing: …]" lines in that request are replaced so the model is not still told the previous game.

smwatershldhelp/deckling.name: v0.1.0-rc.18
smwatershldhelp/deckling.body:
## [0.1.0-rc.18] - 2026-10-04

### Fixed

- Screen help works more than once. The first look kept the in-flight request open for the whole vision stream, and the next "what am I looking at" (or Look at my screen) returned without starting a capture and without an error. A new look cancels that request and starts again. Steam's screenshot call gives up after a few seconds and the backend capture still runs. Each shot gets its own file, a file left from the previous shot is not read again, and a gamescopectl or grim process that hangs is killed. For llama.cpp and other local servers, older screenshots are removed from the request and replaced with "[earlier screenshot]", so only the new picture is sent. A failed capture or vision call is shown on screen and in a toast.
- Soft tick while thinking is on for a new install, and for an existing install that never used that switch. Turning the switch off keeps it off.

A second toast says "Looking at your screen...". The toast uses Decky's toaster, so it shows while a game is running and while the Quick Access menu is closed. Vision models get a look_at_screen tool only when Screen help's capture switch is on. The JPEG is attached on the next turn. If capture is off, the tool is not offered and nothing is captured.
- Spoken replies stay words. While spoken replies are on, the system prompt asks for one to three plain sentences, with no markdown, lists, or symbols, unless more detail was requested. Before Piper or KittenTTS, markdown, emoji, and other symbols are removed, lists become sentences, abbreviations such as "e.g." are expanded, a code block becomes "I put the code in the chat.", and a URL becomes "The link is in…

## [0.1.0-rc.16] - 2026-10-03

### Fixed

- Web lookup treats HTTP 202 and any page with no results as a miss, then tries the next source. The order is DuckDuckGo HTML (browser GET), DuckDuckGo lite, then Bing HTML. A 202 is retried once with the cookies from that response and a short random pause. Test web lookup names the backend that answered. If every keyless source fails, the error says to add a SearXNG URL or a Brave or Tavily key.
- After you send a message, a thinking bubble appears immediately, with a typing indicator, a status line (Thinking, Searching the web, Reading pages, Looking at your screen, Writing), and an elapsed time after 3 seconds. The reply still streams into that bubble. Reasoning tokens stay on the Thinking line instead of being written as the answer. Stop stays on screen. A soft tick while thinking is in Voice settings and is off by default.
- Screen capture runs as the deck user when Decky is root, with `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`, `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`,…

reemx/shortcut-forge.name: v2.2.0
reemx/shortcut-forge.body:
- Applications are back, and they are better than before. A switch at the top of the panel flips between **Files** and **Applications**. Press A on it, or L1 and R1 from anywhere on the screen, and the panel remembers which one you used last.
- Your own applications come first. SteamOS's 40-odd tools are folded under **System apps**, and search looks through both.
- Anything already in your library says **In library**, and that now works for Flatpaks too.
- Steam's own menu entries and terminal programs are no longer listed, since neither makes sense as a new shortcut.

- More applications show their icon, including ones that only ship a large one and KDE's own.

Install in Decky Loader with **Settings → Developer mode → Install Plugin from URL**, using the `.zip` link below, or download it and copy it to the Deck.

mavrexsoftware/decky-legion-go-charge-li.name: v0.2.1: Charge limit toggle, acpi_call installer, system partition lock
mavrexsoftware/decky-legion-go-charge-li.body:
Decky Loader plugin that toggles the Legion Go (1st gen) 80% battery charge limit on SteamOS.

Features
- One-toggle 80% charge limit with a firmware read-back
- Setting is re-applied at boot, after resume, and every 5 minutes while enabled
- Built-in acpi_call installer (SteamOS doesn't ship the module)
- Toggle to lock/unlock the SteamOS system partition

Install
Download `legion-go-charge-limit.zip`, then in Decky go to
Settings → Developer → Install plugin from ZIP file.

Notes
- Tested on a Legion Go (1st gen) on SteamOS only
- SteamOS updates remove acpi_call; press **Install acpi_call** again afterwards
- Don't use with hhd's charge-limit setting

See the README for usage and troubleshooting.

decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.name: Decky plugin v3.8.0
decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.body:
## 3.8.0

- **Fixed fan speed**, as in `tdp_gui.py`. The fan section now has a **Fan mode** selector: *Firmware*, *Curve* or *Fixed speed*. In fixed mode a slider sets 0–100 % (5 % steps); the value is applied once the slider stops moving.
- The fixed speed is rewritten every 5 seconds (and the channel switched back to manual) in case the firmware takes the fan over.
- **Overheat guard:** in fixed mode, from 90 °C the fan never runs slower than the curve would; the panel shows a warning while this is active. Below 90 °C the fixed speed returns.
- The mode and fixed speed are saved (`fan_control.mode`, `fan_control.manual_pct`) and restored after a restart and after the `tdp_gui.py` window closes. Old configs migrate: curve on → *Curve*, curve off → *Firmware*.
- New RPC `set_fan_mode(mode, pct)`; `enable_fan_control` / `disable_fan_control` keep working and update the mode.
- Build row shows 3.8.0.

## 3.7.0

Redesigned panel: less text, the important things first.

- **Summary on top:** three tiles — FPS (green / amber / red against the goal, with the goal underneath), TDP and temperature — and one status line with a coloured dot: holding the target, raising TDP, lowering TDP, looking for the lowest TDP, short at the TDP limit, high-load boost, waiting for FPS, Auto TDP off.
- **Last-minute chart** of FPS and TDP with the goal as a dashed line. The history is kept by the backend, so it does not reset when the menu is reopened.
- **Game, display mode and working levels** in one line under the summary.
- Main controls first: Plugin enabled, Auto TDP, Target FPS. **TDP limits** (min, max, start TDP), **More settings** (high-load boost and threshold, poll interval, MangoHud overlay, language) and **Diagnostics** (build, backend, search state, loads, FPS source, fan controller) are collapsed; they stay as left while the plugin is loaded.
- **Fan section:** the curve chart with one caption (°C · % · rpm) instead of five rows.
- The MangoHud / FPS-limit note is shown only when there is no FPS; errors are shown as a banner at the very top.
- Shorter descriptions under toggles and sliders.
- **Language:** one selector (Auto / English / Русский) instead of two toggles. *Auto* follows the Steam language and is the default for new configs; existing configs keep their choice.
- Build row shows 3.7.0.

## 3.6.0

- **Working TDP levels are kept per display mode.** The same game needs different power handheld on the built-in 2K screen and docked on a 2K or 4K monitor. Levels are now stored per game *and* display mode, e.g. `steam:1091500@handheld-1920x1080`, `@external-2560x1440`, `@external-3840x2160`, so a menu exit on the built-in screen no longer jumps to the 4K level (or the other way round).
- The display mode comes from `/sys/class/drm`: which outputs are enabled (built-in eDP or external DP/HDMI) and their native resolution. Any enabled external output means docked; with several, the largest one counts.
- **Dock / undock mid-game:** when the mode changes and that mode already has saved levels, TDP goes straight to its typical level (median of recent levels) instead of waiting for an FPS drop or a long search down. In simulation, docking from 35 W to a 4K screen that needs 68 W and undocking back caused no FPS drop at all.
- The FPS section shows the display mode next to the game.
- Levels saved by 3.4.0–3.5.0 (keyed by game only) are not reused: the mode they were learned in is unknown.
- Build row shows 3.6.0.

## 3.5.0

- **RyzenAdj ships with the plugin.** `bin/ryzenadj` (RyzenAdj v0.18.0, the same file PowerControl v3.15.1 ships) is now in the repository and in the Decky archive, so PowerControl is no longer needed, not even for the first launch. RyzenAdj stays under LGPL-3.0-or-later: the license texts are in `bin/licenses/`, the source link and checksum in `bin/README.txt` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- Decky unpacks archives with Python, which drops the executable bit. The plugin and `tdp_gui.py` now restore it on `bin/ryzenadj` at start. The archive stores `ryzenadj` as 755 and everything else as 644.
- If `bin/ryzenadj` is missing (an old installation), the plugin still copies it from PowerControl.
- **Fan curve as a graph.** The panel shows the curve as a chart (temperature 20–110 °C, speed 0–100 %) with a marker for the current temperature and fan speed. **Edit curve** opens an editor: drag a point to move it, tap empty space to add one; dragging up lifts the points to the right and dragging down lowers the points to the left, so the curve never decreases. A selected point can also be moved with sliders and the ◀/▶ buttons, so the editor works with a gamepad. Delete point, Reset to default, Save and Cancel are in the same window. Replaces the list of per-point sliders.
- Build row shows 3.5.0.

## 3.4.0

- **Fast return after menus.** A menu needs ~10 W, the location ~35 W: when the menu closed, FPS used to stay far below the target for 3–8 s while TDP climbed back. In simulation of the same switch the hard drop (FPS below goal − 4) is now 1–2 s instead of 7–8 s, with no overshoot.
- **No smoothing lag on drops.** A sharp drop (latest reading below goal − 4 fps) is acted on at once, instead of waiting for the 4 s average. A mild deficit counts only readings taken after the last TDP change, so the controller no longer keeps raising after a jump on frames from the old level. Lowering still requires both the long average and the latest reading to show a surplus.
- **Working levels per game.** TDP levels where FPS held near the target for 8 s are remembered and saved per game in `game_stats.json` (game detected from Steam's `SteamLaunch AppId=…` process; anything else shares one entry). On a sharp drop TDP jumps straight to the median remembered level above the current one, capped by an FPS-based estimate (FPS ∝ W^0.9, ×1.5) so a loading screen cannot send it to the maximum. The usual search then trims it down if the scene is lighter.
- **Fixed:** once a plateau had been found, raises were limited to 2 W at every level, even far below that plateau. The small step now applies only near or above the learned ceiling.
- **Fixed:** the raise interval was compared exactly, so timer jitter could skip every second poll. It now has a 10 % tolerance.
- The FPS section shows the detected game and its working TDP levels.
- `tools/simulate_scene_switch.py`: location → menu → location simulation on the real controller.
- Build row shows 3.4.0.

decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.name: Decky plugin v3.3.0
decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.body:
## 3.3.0

- **Plugin enabled switch** is now the first row of the plugin. When it is off, the plugin writes nothing: Auto TDP stops and the fan is handed back to the firmware. The other sections are hidden. The switch is saved as `plugin_enabled` and survives restarts.
- **`tdp_gui.py` pauses the plugin while it is open.** The window writes its PID to `/run/gpd5cachyautotdp/gui.pid`; the plugin checks it every second, stops Auto TDP and the fan curve, and reports back in `plugin.json`. The window applies its own limit and fan mode only after that report (or after 8 s if the plugin does not answer). When the window closes, or crashes, the plugin resumes its saved state. A stale PID that does not belong to `tdp_gui.py` is ignored.
- While paused or switched off, the plugin refuses `start_monitor`, `set_tdp`, `set_fan_speed` and `enable_fan_control`, and does not reset the TDP on unload.
- **Plugin icon**: a chip with a lightning bolt instead of the ⚡ emoji. It follows the Decky theme…

decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.name: Decky plugin v3.2.0
decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.body:
## 3.2.0

- **Fixed fan curve editor layout.** Temperature and speed sliders for one point were placed in a single row, so the section looked like duplicated points. Now all temperature sliders come first, then all speed sliders, each point numbered once.
- **Duplicates in the stored curve are merged.** `curveFromConfig` now collapses several values for the same temperature (e.g. `"70"` and `"70.0"`, or a hand-edited config) into one point, keeping the higher speed. Invalid entries are dropped instead of rendering as extra points.
- **Saving merges duplicates too**, so a curve can no longer be written back with two values for one temperature.
- **Reset already replaced the curve** rather than adding points; this is now covered by tests (3 points → exactly 9, repeated resets stay at 9).
- Build row shows 3.2.0.

## 3.1.0

- **TDP now ramps up proportionally instead of in fixed steps.** The step depends on two values: the width of the available TDP range (max − min) and the…

decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.name: Decky plugin v2.3.0
decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.body:
## 2.3.0

- Removed the Active CPU cores feature completely: the slider, the status text under it, core evacuation, the IRQ and thread moving code, and the saved `active_cores` setting.
- Removed backend modules `cpu_topology.py` and `core_evacuation.py` and the `set_active_cores` RPC.
- One remaining action at startup and on unload: all CPUs are switched back online (backend/cpu_online.py). This restores the full core count if an earlier version left cores disabled. CPU 0 is never touched.
- Status no longer shows "Core evacuation". The interface translations for core control were removed.
- Build row shows 2.3.0.

## 2.2.0

- Interface language: English and Русский. The choice is at the bottom of the screen (Language section). It is saved in config.json as `language` ("en" or "ru") and restored on startup.
- All interface texts come from one dictionary (`src/i18n.ts`); the English and Russian sets have the same keys.
- Backend: `set_language` RPC accepts only "en" or…

decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.name: Decky plugin v2.1.1
decodergit/gpd5cachyautotdp.body:
## 2.1.1

- Active CPU cores: the slider now stays where you set it while the change runs. The change runs in the background; the RPC returns at once. Under the slider the status is shown: stage, current item, result or error.
- Stage text: "включение оставляемых ядер", "вытеснение задач и IRQ", "отключение ядер", with progress counters.
- Evacuation: IRQ write errors no longer block core switch-off. Some IRQs are managed by the kernel and it moves them itself. Threads that already exited (ESRCH) are not counted as stuck.
- Evacuation still refuses switch-off if a user thread is pinned only to the cores being disabled. The reason is shown in the status.
- The saved core count is written only after a successful change.
- FPS hold controller (backend/fps_hold_controller.py) replaces the step logic in the monitor:

haupq/vibepolo-remote-decky.name: v0.1.1 — SteamOS Game Mode remote · host r6
haupq/vibepolo-remote-decky.body:
First public preview of **Vibepollo Remote**, a Decky companion for connecting **Moonlight on a PC/phone → SteamOS Game Mode**.

### Included

- Decky controls for host start/stop/restart, autostart, Moonlight PIN pairing, session status and diagnostics.
- Tested **host r6**: native Gamescope capture, frame pacing, idle encoder-probe streams and a GPU-composited XWayland cursor.
- Generic macOS launcher, editable source, licenses and SHA-256 checksums.

### Download and install

1. Install the **host bundle** on SteamOS as the logged-in user with `bash install-host.sh`.
2. Install **vibepollo-remote-0.1.1.zip** through Decky's ZIP installer.
3. Start the host, create your own Web UI account/API token, then pair Moonlight from the plugin.

The plugin ZIP does not include the host executable. See the repository README for the complete setup.

The **host source archive** includes the patched upstream source and initialized submodules, fetched build dependencies, and source packages for the bundled shared libraries. GitHub's automatically generated source ZIP only contains the plugin repository.

### Validation and limits

Tested on **Legion Go 2 / SteamOS 3.8.28 / Decky 3.2.10**, with **Moonlight 6.2.0 on Mac M4**. The user confirmed faster menu navigation, audible output and pointers visible on both host and client.

Tested preset: **1920×1200, 60 FPS, 40 Mbps, H.264 SDR, Metal on Mac, relative mouse mode**. Host binary SHA-256:
`e2eb7ac2b3c6c41073b285eb2dbfe318050bc7e75beb02fe6544523e858d0722`

This is a preview for the tested stack. Long gameplay, HDR, controller/rumble, suspend/resume and broad hardware compatibility are not established. On a fully static scene, the first picture may require UI activity. Full details are in VALIDATION.md.

Clean dependency installation, TypeScript, **23 backend tests**, frontend build/smoke tests and GitHub CI passed. No device credentials or pairings are included.

TypeScript、103 项 Python 测试、前端交互、构建及安装包验证已通过；未在真实 SteamOS 掌机上验证本版。ROG Ally X 上的实际授权、/run/media/deck/SN512 挂载路径、Steam 游戏库及日志可见性仍需实机确认；自动化状态模拟不代表系统会授予挂载权限。

本次更新将插件整理为更直接的外部存储工具，减少页面切换，方便在 SteamOS 游戏模式中查看设备、挂载卸载和复制日志。

- 改为简洁的单层中文界面，按设备和分区显示容量、挂载及读写状态。
- 将原来的“重新挂载”改为独立的“卸载”和“挂载”。卸载后保持未挂载，用户可自行决定何时挂载。
- 操作后直接更新原有设备卡片。失败时保留页面并说明原因；无法确认结果时明确提示“不确定”。
- 只有真实挂载状态经过验证，才显示成功；设备正在使用时安全停止，不强制卸载。
- 新增大日志弹窗，支持刷新、滚动和全文复制，可查看系统已有的存储、挂载及休眠唤醒原始记录，日志过多时提示截断。
- 移除复杂的详情、筛选、统计和操作历史界面，保留固定更新链接复制。
- 重写项目首页，提供更易读的功能、安装和使用说明。

卸载前请关闭使用该分区的游戏和程序，并备份重要数据。卸载不代表 USB 已经断电；插件不修复文件系统或损坏的硬件。原始日志可能含私人信息，分享前请检查。

请安装本页附件 **External-Storage-Guard.zip**，不要使用 Source code 压缩包。既有 latest/download 安装链接保持有效。

自动化测试和安装包验证已通过；真实掌机的设备兼容性、手柄焦点与游戏模式剪贴板仍需实机确认。

pacificsilent/decky-legion-go-s-rumble-c.name: v1.0.0
pacificsilent/decky-legion-go-s-rumble-c.body:
Control de la intensidad de la vibración para la **Lenovo Legion Go S** en SteamOS, que de fábrica no ofrece ningún ajuste (los motores van siempre al 100 %).

### Instalación

1. Descarga `Legion-Go-S-Rumble-v1.0.0.zip` de aquí abajo.
2. En Modo Gaming: menú de acceso rápido → Decky → ⚙️ → **Developer** → *Install Plugin from ZIP*.

### Qué trae

- Seis niveles — `OFF · MÍN 10% · BAJO 25% · MED 45% · ALTO 70% · MÁX 100%` — y el mando vibra al seleccionarlos.
- Perfiles personalizables: reasigna el porcentaje de cada nivel y siéntelo mientras lo ajustas.
- Ajustes persistentes, reaplicados al arrancar y cuando el USB se re-enumera tras suspender.
- Interfaz en español e inglés.

### Requisitos

Legion Go S (`1a86:e310` / `e311`) con SteamOS y Decky Loader. El backend corre como root porque InputPlumber deja `/dev/input/event*` en modo `000`.

### Cómo funciona

El firmware del Go S no expone intensidad de rumble. El plugin escribe `EV_FF`/`FF_GAIN` en el evdev que `xpad` crea para el mando — que es por donde InputPlumber reproduce los efectos — así que `ff-memless` escala todo el rumble de juegos y de Steam. Detalle completo en el README.

sharkusmanch/decky-download-all-plus.name: v1.3.0 — honest queue verification & phantom download filtering
sharkusmanch/decky-download-all-plus.body:
## Fixed

- **"Last queued N games" no longer lies.** Steam's queue calls (`QueueAppUpdate` etc.) are fire-and-forget and can silently do nothing. The plugin now verifies against a fresh Steam downloads snapshot that each item actually entered the queue before claiming success — with a 30s verdict window because Steam's download events can lag minutes behind (large downloads preallocate first). Failures and unconfirmable runs now surface as toasts and Decky log lines instead of false success.
- **Phantom downloads are no longer "queued" forever.** Items that sit in the download list with no pending update (e.g. a game installed only on another machine, or a half-created install request) can never be queued by the Downloads API. They are now filtered out of both the button count and auto-queue, instead of being re-"queued" on every tick.

## Changed

- Manual queue button always resolves to visible feedback (queued / failed / couldn't confirm).
- Plugin author metadata updated for the…

toto-console/game-hub.name: Game Hub v0.13.0-dev.67 — experimental preview
toto-console/game-hub.body:
# Game Hub 0.13.0-dev.67 — Store handoff and overlay recovery

## Install
Download **Game-Hub-0.13.0-dev.67-decky.zip** (or **Game-Base-Social.zip**, identical plugin bytes). Install through Decky's ZIP installer. Do not install GitHub's automatic Source code ZIP.

## Changes since dev.60
- Game News dismisses the full-screen Control Center modal before opening its Steam Store listing, preserving the Back return. Missing Store navigation no longer silently closes the card.
- In-game Control Center waits for Steam to classify a new overlay window and recovers when its activation bridge becomes available late. Native Steam recovery remains available.
- Settings > Control Center and the Decky quick panel offer compatibility checks and sanitized report export. Reports contain no friend/account IDs, messages, cookies or tokens.
- Friend cards load public Steam bios for the selected friend, refresh while visible, preserve existing text during temporary failures, and stop automatic retries after three failures. Private/friends-only bios cannot be retrieved through the public lookup.
- Brighter mini-profile backgrounds. Existing designs, controller bindings, games, saves and third-party plugins are unchanged.

## Updates
Decky Direct Updater: **All > Game Base Social > Install another version > dev.67**. The canonical **Game-Base-Social.zip** asset remains supported. Experimental versions may not appear in stable-only checks.

Optional **Game-Hub-and-Direct-Updater-install-pack.zip** includes Game Hub and unmodified Direct Updater 0.2.6, its license and corresponding source. Extract it and install the two inner plugin ZIPs separately; the outer ZIP is not directly installable. No silent third-party installation.

## Validation and limits
Local TypeScript and production builds passed. Focused checks: 39 news/browser/Back tests, 28 overlay/startup/return tests, two report-sanitization tests, and the previously validated bio tests. These suites overlap; the counts are not additive. Installed dev.67 loaded locally.

The reported Windows tester's exact failure remains unconfirmed. A compatible in-game Steam/Decky overlay is required; no universal Guide interception is claimed. SteamOS/Bazzite remain experimental without handheld validation. If the native sidebar persists, export the Control Center compatibility report while the overlay is open and include your Steam, Decky, PlayHub, controller and launch details.

Only the current version tag is retained. Previous public releases are retired after the new download is verified, with rollback metadata backed up first.

grails125/screensaverenhancements.name: v2.0.6
grails125/screensaverenhancements.body:
[ZH-CN] 屏幕保护增强 v2.0.6

新增与改进：

1. Steam UI 空值兼容：修复部分 Steam 测试版反馈的面板样式类名缺失导致插件加载报错的问题。`toScopedSelector` 校验类名类型，支持多个空白字符分隔的类名，不再对空值或非字符串调用 `.split()`。
2. 安全布局降级：`PanelSection`、`PanelSectionRow` 或整个 `staticClasses` 不可用时，跳过对应 CSS 规则，退回默认布局，避免空选择器误改根容器间距；类名正常时保留原有取值和样式。
3. 标题显示保护：标题类名增加空值保护；样式映射缺失时仍显示本地化插件名称，不因读取 `Title` 再次崩溃。
4. 回归验证与功能保留：新增 8 项回归测试，覆盖缺失对象、缺失字段、异常类型、空白字符、复合类名、CSS 作用范围和标题显示。不改变已配置的应用规则、电源设置、D-Bus 抑制、Nested 检测或通知逻辑。

兼容范围：本次针对样式字段缺失进行安全降级，并非保证所有 Steam 测试版本均无兼容问题；其他 Decky 组件的发现失败仍需对应版本适配。

升级方式：正常情况下可在插件面板检查并安装更新。若插件无法加载或旧版内置更新卡住，从本发布页下载 `ScreenSaverEnhancements-v2.0.6.zip`，打开 **Decky 设置** → **开发者** → **从 ZIP 安装插件** 安装。安装后仅重载本插件，无需重启整个 Decky Loader。

兼容安装包：同时提供 `ScreenSaverEnhancements.zip`，与带版本号的 ZIP 字节完全相同，供旧版更新器使用。

[EN] ScreenSaver Enhancements v2.0.6

Added and improved:

1. Steam UI null safety: fix plugin loading failures caused by missing panel styling classes, as reported on some Steam beta versions. `toScopedSelector` validates class values and supports whitespace-separated classes without calling `.split()` on missing or non-string values.
2. Safe layout fallback: when `PanelSection`, `PanelSectionRow` or the entire `staticClasses` map is unavailable, omit the corresponding CSS rules and fall back to the default layout. Empty selectors no longer change root-container margins; available class names and styles are preserved.
3. Title rendering protection: guard the title class map so the localized plugin name still renders without failing on a missing `Title` mapping.
4. Regression coverage and preserved behavior: add eight regression tests for missing maps and fields, invalid types, whitespace, compound classes, CSS scope and title rendering. Existing application rules, power settings, D-Bus inhibition, Nested detection and notification behavior are unchanged.

Compatibility scope: this patch safely handles missing styling fields. It does not guarantee compatibility with every Steam beta build; unrelated Decky component-discovery failures still require version-specific support.

Upgrading: normally, check for and install updates from the plugin panel. If the plugin cannot load or an older built-in updater stalls, download `ScreenSaverEnhancements-v2.0.6.zip` from this release and install through **Decky Settings** → **Developer** → **Install Plugin from ZIP**. Only this plugin needs reloading, not the entire Decky Loader.

Compatibility package: `ScreenSaverEnhancements.zip` is also provided for older updaters and is byte-identical to the versioned ZIP.

grails125/screensaverenhancements.name: v2.0.5
grails125/screensaverenhancements.body:
[ZH-CN] 屏幕保护增强 v2.0.5

新增与改进：

1. D-Bus 启动兼容：Steam 或桌面服务占用标准接口时，仅降级对应能力，保留其他接口与手动应用监控，不抢占服务名称；占用解除后单独重试该接口。
2. 外部请求诊断：使用独立只读连接关联成功的 Inhibit/UnInhibit 调用与返回，记录 application、reason、cookie 和接口。Edge 等未加入手动列表的应用也可主动发出抑制请求；启动前或断线期间的请求可能不可见，界面会明确标注观测不完整。
3. 稳定恢复休眠：所有已知抑制来源结束后，实际恢复设置前等待 1.5 秒并重新确认；期间出现新来源则取消。恢复失败时有限重试，手动停止及时尝试恢复；通知只说明“插件已恢复原电源设置”，不再宣称系统所有抑制均已解除。
4. 诊断显示优化：默认突出监控状态、命中应用与电源接管状态；D-Bus 接口归属、外部观测、Nested 检测、技术统计及原电源设置分组折叠展示，长字段可换行，保留完整报告导出及中英乌三语支持。
5. Nested 检测降频：启动监控时先检查；无会话且进程事件订阅已确认时只等待启动事件，不做周期扫描。有会话时每 5 秒检测，查询失败每 2 秒重试；事件监听不可用时，无会话探测回退到每 10 秒一次。间隔不含查询耗时，播放/暂停识别可能延迟约 5 秒，实际恢复还需上述稳定窗口。
6. 事件与打包可靠性：兼容不同内核的进程事件订阅确认，检测订阅拒绝、确认超时及序号缺口并安全降级；监听失败后释放连接，安装包补齐独立的外部请求观测模块。已有应用规则保持不变，普通手动规则仍按进程存活判断。

升级方式：正常情况下可在插件面板检查并安装更新。若旧版内置更新卡住（包括原 v2.0.4 安装身份问题），从本发布页下载 `ScreenSaverEnhancements-v2.0.5.zip`，打开 **Decky 设置** → **开发者** → **从 ZIP 安装插件** 安装。安装后仅重载本插件，无需重启整个 Decky Loader。发布新版不会自动修复旧安装中正在运行的更新入口。

兼容安装包：同时提供 `ScreenSaverEnhancements.zip`，与带版本号的 ZIP 字节完全相同，供旧版更新器使用。

grails125/screensaverenhancements.name: v2.0.4
grails125/screensaverenhancements.body:
[ZH-CN] 屏幕保护增强 v2.0.4

新增与改进：

1. 关闭内屏：新增内屏供电控制，保留黑色覆盖；两种模式共用“按任意键关闭”设置，关闭该设置时可用快捷访问键唤醒并打开面板。关闭供电后唤醒稍有延迟。
2. 嵌套桌面媒体检测：自动识别 Nested Desktop 独立会话中的 MPRIS 播放状态，播放时抑制休眠，暂停、停止或退出后解除这一路抑制；保留已有手动应用规则。
3. 乌克兰语支持：新增乌克兰语本地化，补全关闭内屏等功能的翻译，保留中文显示与英文回退。
4. 操作与唤醒响应：优化亮屏请求响应，修复触摸“立即关闭”时仅滚动按钮而未执行的问题。
5. 电源与状态恢复：加强关屏、唤醒及电源配置恢复，隔离超时请求和旧插件实例，避免快速操作或旧查询覆盖新状态。
6. 更新与设置同步：安装更新后自动重载本插件即可刷新面板，无需重启整个 Decky Loader；设置顺序保存，重新打开面板时保留待保存修改。
7. 后端可靠性：增强 D-Bus 断线恢复、请求归属校验与监听清理；播放器分别限时查询，避免单个播放器超时误解除其他播放器的抑制。
8. 界面与安装包：精简说明并统一“自动休眠时间”标签；安装包采用带版本号的文件名，更新构建依赖并核验后端模块完整性。
9. 更新安装修复：向 Decky 安装器传入 manifest 中的真实插件名，不再使用目录 slug，避免文件已解包但旧实例未停止、新版未重载的问题；安装身份不受界面语言影响。

旧版升级：从本发布页下载 `ScreenSaverEnhancements-v2.0.4.zip`，打开 **Decky 设置** → **开发者** → **从 ZIP 安装插件**，选择该文件安装。旧版内置更新若卡住，请使用此路径。

grails125/screensaverenhancements.name: v2.0.3
grails125/screensaverenhancements.body:
[ZH-CN] 屏幕保护增强 v2.0.3

修复与改进：

1. Steam 菜单输入兼容：适配新版 Steam 返回的对象式 `Unregister`/`unregister` 注销句柄，同时保留旧版函数句柄兼容性。
2. 监听清理可靠性：关闭黑屏遮罩时仅调用有效注销句柄，不再向 Steam 的 catch-all 监听器列表写入 `null`，避免挂起恢复后短按 Steam 菜单或快捷访问菜单失效。

[EN] ScreenSaver Enhancements v2.0.3

Fixed and improved:

1. Steam menu input compatibility: supports the object-style `Unregister`/`unregister` release handles returned by current Steam versions while retaining legacy function-handle compatibility.
2. Reliable listener cleanup: invokes only valid release handles when closing the black overlay and no longer inserts `null` into Steam's catch-all listener list, preventing Steam or Quick Access Menu short presses from failing after suspend and resume.

grails125/screensaverenhancements.name: v2.0.2
grails125/screensaverenhancements.body:
[ZH-CN] 屏幕保护增强 v2.0.2

新增与改进：

1. 设置值校验：保存前校验公开设置的类型与范围，拒绝无效数据，避免异常配置影响插件运行；
2. 设置数据规范化：启动时自动规范化已保存的设置和应用规则，并将无效值恢复为安全默认值；
3. 损坏配置恢复：检测到无法解析的设置文件时，将原文件保留为带 `.corrupt` 后缀的备份，便于排查与恢复。

[EN] ScreenSaver Enhancements v2.0.2

Added and improved:

1. Settings validation: validates public setting types and ranges before saving and rejects invalid data that could affect plugin operation.
2. Settings normalization: normalizes persisted settings and application rules during startup and restores invalid values to safe defaults.
3. Corrupt settings recovery: preserves an unreadable settings file with a `.corrupt` suffix for troubleshooting and recovery.

icodyyang/wowdeck-input.name: v2.0.0｜语音输入与掌机兼容
icodyyang/wowdeck-input.body:
## WoWDeck Input 2.0

在 Steam Deck 游戏模式下玩《魔兽世界》：“无限”时，支持中文语音输入+外接键盘。**这是继公开版 v0.1.3 后的大版本更新，功能与已交付的 alpha.23 一致。**

### 主要更新

- **豆包语音输入**：每人扫码登录自己的账号；F7 / 映射背键按住说话、松开转写并填入，转写时再按一次取消。不需要先按 Ctrl＋空格，也不需要外接键盘。
- **声音波形**：录音时随声音变化，显示转写状态，可调整位置和透明度。
- **独立开关与菜单保护**：总开关下分别控制键盘和语音，保留 Steam / 快捷访问菜单优先。
- **可选魔兽双击清空**：安装 WoWDeckDraft 0.2.3 后，可双击同一听写键清空刚填入的未发送草稿。基础语音输入不需要游戏组件。
- **更多键盘兼容**：机身、USB、蓝牙、PS/2、I2C、SPI 与右 Ctrl，增加只读检测和故障恢复；GPD 使用者已反馈外接键盘问题解决。
- **可选五笔 86（试用）**：内置离线码表；保留全拼与小鹤，不改变系统拼音或原生触屏键盘。

### 选择哪个文件

- **`WoWDeck-Input-2.0.0.zip`：给 Decky 安装这个包，不要解压。**
- `WoWDeck-Input-2.0.0-source.zip`：完整源码、构建结果及打包脚本，供开发者使用。
- `WoWDeckDraft-2.0.0.zip`：可选《魔兽世界：无限》草稿清空组件，内部版本 0.2.3；已有该组件无需重装。
- `SHA256SUMS.json` / `RELEASE_AUDIT.json`：包校验值及文件清单。

GitHub 自动生成的 “Source code” 不是 Decky 安装包。

### 语音快速上手

1. 安装 ZIP 后打开 **总开关 → 语音输入 → 启用语音输入 → 语音设置**，扫码登录自己的账号。
2. 将对应游戏的背键设为键盘 **F7 → 普通按压**，不要配置为长按触发、切换保持或连发。
3. 选中游戏聊天输入框，按住说话，松开后填入草稿；不会自动发送。转写中再按一次可取消。

icodyyang/wowdeck-input.name: v0.1.3｜魔兽掌机输入法 · 公开测试版
icodyyang/wowdeck-input.body:
WoWDeck Input｜魔兽掌机输入法的首个公开测试版。

为 Steam Deck 游戏模式的外接键盘提供中文输入增强，使用 Steam 原生键盘和系统拼音引擎。

### 功能

- 默认全拼，可切换小鹤双拼。
- Ctrl＋空格唤醒，短按 Shift 切换中英文。
- 编号候选词，支持数字和空格选词。
- F8 调整候选框位置、大小和透明度，再按一次保存。
- 插件内录制唤醒/调整快捷键，并检查冲突。
- 自动检查中文引擎和 Steam 简体中文键盘，提供设置引导。
- 无外接键盘时保留 Steam＋X 完整屏幕键盘。

### 下载与安装

普通用户下载 **WoWDeck-Input-0.1.3.zip**，不要解压。

先安装 Decky Loader，然后在 Decky 设置中开启开发者模式，进入“开发者 → 从 ZIP 压缩文件安装插件 → 浏览文件”导入。

进入插件完成首次使用检查；需要时在游戏模式“Steam → 设置 → 键盘”启用简体中文。已有 Better Keyboard 的用户请先停用它。

**WoWDeck-Input-0.1.3-source.zip** 是源码包；GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 包也不是 Decky 安装包。校验值见 SHA256SUMS.json。

### 已知范围

已在 Steam Deck LCD 和《魔兽世界：无限》中验证主要输入功能。全新设备安装、OLED、Beta 与其他游戏仍需更多测试，详细情况见仓库 VALIDATION.md。

本项目基于 BetterKeyboard，保留 BSD 许可和来源说明，包含生成式 AI 辅助开发的新增代码。目前未上架 Decky 官方商城。

jaxonwright/decky-dont-dimmadeck.name: v1.0.1
jaxonwright/decky-dont-dimmadeck.body:
## Installing on a Steam Deck

1. Download `dont-dimmadeck-v1.0.1.zip` below, onto the Deck itself or onto a USB stick.
2. In game mode, open the Decky menu, then the gear icon, then **Developer mode**.
3. Turn on **Developer mode**, then open the **Developer** tab that appears.
4. Under **Install Plugin from Zip**, pick the file.

Or, over SSH from another machine:

```bash
scp dont-dimmadeck-v1.0.1.zip deck@steamdeck.local:/tmp/
ssh deck@steamdeck.local 'unzip -o /tmp/dont-dimmadeck-v1.0.1.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/'
```

Then restart Decky (Decky menu → gear → **Reload**) or reboot.

## If something goes wrong

The plugin records the timers it changes and restores them when an app
exits, including after an unclean shutdown. Failing that, Settings →
Display and Settings → Power let you set them back by hand.

niwia/gurren.name: v1.2.3
niwia/gurren.body:
### Release v1.2.3 (Stable)

This release addresses the download completion bug, fixes game label rendering layout problems in QAM, and introduces a dedicated full-screen Game Manager page.

#### Changes in v1.2.3
- **Full-Screen Game Manager**: Added a dedicated, full-screen manager page at `/gurren-manager` (accessible via the list icon in QAM) featuring integrated search, filter toggles, active updates, library refreshing, and global ASSella settings.
- **Simplified QAM**: QAM panel is now minimal and focuses exclusively on displaying checking/downloading statuses and updates requiring attention, with option fields relocated to the full-page manager.
- **Exit Code Polling Fix**: Fixed background process status reporting in `main.py`. The system now evaluates actual subprocess exit codes rather than log file presence, resolving the immediate completed download bugs.
- **Fixed Label Shrinking**: Game rows redesigned to use native `DialogButton` wrappers that resolve flexbox container collapsing on Steam Deck.

niwia/gurren.name: v1.2.2
niwia/gurren.body:
### Release v1.2.2 (Stable)

#### Changes in v1.2.2
- **UI Redesign**: Rewrote all QAM components to match the compact autoflatpaks style.
  - Action buttons are now icon-only compact `DialogButton` rows instead of tall full-width `ButtonItem`s.
  - Game list uses slim inline rows with small action buttons beside each game name.
  - Replaced nested `PanelSection` blocks with a single wrapper + lightweight `staticClasses.PanelSectionTitle` dividers.
  - Active download now shows name + progress % badge + cancel button + progress bar all in a single compact row.
  - StatusBar redesigned as an icon-prefixed pill with a spinner animation during checks.
  - All CSS unified into a single token file (`Gurren.css.ts`).
- **Version Indicators**: All version strings updated to v1.2.2 across the plugin footer, installer banners, and zip filenames.

niwia/gurren.name: v1.2.1
niwia/gurren.body:
### Release v1.2.1 (Stable)

This release moves the refactored modular architecture and sequential download queue to the stable channel.

#### Changes in v1.2.1
- **Version Indicators**: Display version numbers at the bottom of the QAM panel, in the zip archive filenames, and inside the setup installer.
- **Modular Frontend Refactor**: Restructured files into modular components (`QAM/`, `Components/`, `Utils/`).
- **Sequential Download Queue**: Added support for queuing multiple game updates in the UI (processing them one at a time sequentially).
- **Persistent QAM State**: State is now preserved when closing the QAM panel, fixing dismount progress loss.
- **On-the-go Settings**: Added UI controls for Goldberg, Steamless, Achievements, and Manifests, as well as a concurrent downloads limit slider.
- **Toasts**: Integrated native Steam Deck notifications for finished updates.

niwia/gurren.name: v1.2.0b
niwia/gurren.body:
### Release v1.2.0b (Beta)

This is the beta release of the refactored Gurren plugin and Lagann backend bundle.

#### Gurren Plugin (Frontend)
- Modular architecture refactor inspired by decky-autoflatpaks.
- Added a sequential queue management system for updates.
- Added native toast notifications on Steam Deck using toaster API.
- Added on-the-go config settings for Goldberg, Steamless, Achievements, and Manifest limits.
- Fixed layout collapse and state persistence when closing the QAM panel.

#### Lagann (Backend)
- Sync ASSella settings directly with config endpoints.
- Fully compatible headless backend updates.

niwia/gurren.name: v1.2.0
niwia/gurren.body:

#### Gurren Plugin (Frontend)
- Added CSS sliding/scrolling transitions for game names that exceed the width of list items.

#### Lagann (Backend)

- Capped logging session files and added filter levels/categories to mitigate log bloating.

kas5852/simpledeckytdp-intel.name: SimpleDeckyTDP-Intel 1.0.7+oxp3.1 (ONEXPLAYER 3)
kas5852/simpledeckytdp-intel.body:
## SimpleDeckyTDP-Intel 1.0.7+oxp3.1 for the ONEXPLAYER 3

A build of the `oxp3` branch of this fork of [aarron-lee/SimpleDeckyTDP](https://github.com/aarron-lee/SimpleDeckyTDP), built from commit `a8a01f3` on top of upstream `main` at `ab0128f` (1.0.7). It installs as its own Decky plugin, SimpleDeckyTDP-Intel.

The CPU Boost toggle becomes a three-way control, **Off / Smart / Full**, saved per game like the rest of the profile:

- **Off:** boost off, same as upstream.
- **Smart:** boost on, with the P-cores capped at 3.0 GHz, the E-cores at 2.0 GHz and the LP E-cores at 1.5 GHz, so the game's main thread gets fast cores without the E-cores taking the GPU's share of the power budget.
- **Full:** boost on with no caps, same as upstream.

At 30 W on Resident Evil 4, Smart raises the 1% low by about a third over Off; in GPU-bound games like Final Fantasy VII Rebirth it makes no difference. The governor and EPP sliders label `performance` as "Perf" so the word no longer breaks across two lines. See the README for the measurements and details.

### Install on the deck

```bash
curl -L -o /tmp/simpledeckytdp-intel.zip https://github.com/kas5852/SimpleDeckyTDP-Intel/releases/latest/download/simpledeckytdp-intel.zip
sudo rm -rf ~/homebrew/plugins/SimpleDeckyTDP && sudo unzip -o /tmp/simpledeckytdp-intel.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins
sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader
```

This removes the original SimpleDeckyTDP, because two TDP plugins would keep overriding each other. On its first start SimpleDeckyTDP-Intel copies your SimpleDeckyTDP profiles and settings; the original's settings file is left in place. Decky Loader is required.

### Updating

The plugin's built-in update (System Info, "Update to ...") follows this fork's releases, so it is safe to use.

### Notes

- Smart only appears on an Intel CPU with three core types (P, E and LP E-cores). Everywhere else the plugin behaves like upstream.
- The CPU controls need "Enable Manual CPU Controls" in the advanced options. Keep the default `powersave` governor with Smart.
- To go back to upstream, see the README.
- License: BSD 3-Clause, same as upstream. Not affiliated with or endorsed by upstream.
- Setup guide for the ONEXPLAYER 3: https://github.com/HHHHanasak1/onexplayer3-steamos-setup

**First public release of VNT Control, a Decky Loader plugin for managing vnt-cli virtual networking.**

### Supported Features

- Token-based LAN join (one-tap connect with optional device name and custom server)
- Background daemon — vnt-cli keeps running even when the QAM is closed
- View connected peers (`vnt-cli --list`)
- View self info (`vnt-cli --info`)
- One-tap disconnect

### What's Included

- `vnt-cli` **v1.2.16** for x86_64 Linux bundled in the package
- No external dependencies required on the Steam Deck

### How to Install

1. Download `vnt_control.zip` below
2. In Decky Loader, go to Settings → **Install from ZIP**
3. Restart Decky Loader

### Known Limitations

- This project is **not actively maintained**
- Only tested on **CachyOS**; SteamOS compatibility is not guaranteed
- No advanced settings exposed yet (encryption, compression, port mapping, etc.)

---

*Feel free to report issues, but please understand that fixes may not be timely.*

Compact switches and color swatches, working question-mark tooltips, right-aligned Settings Back/Close, visible pin/unpin state, a smaller Steam toolbar trophy, the trophy-refresh sheet icon with its activity dot contained inside the button, short pack/theme names, optional checkboxes and sidebar navigation, custom trophy artwork tints, color-blind palettes with tier letters, animation-speed controls, and a silent toast appearance/glow preview. [Detailed guide](https://github.com/lydia1204/SteamTrophies/blob/main/docs/CONTROLS_0.4.0-rc.3.md) · [Installation: Windows, Linux, experimental macOS and Decky](https://github.com/lydia1204/SteamTrophies#compatibility)

[All six OS/Node CI jobs and production packaging passed](https://github.com/lydia1204/SteamTrophies/actions/runs/34407428513). Local checks passed 85 tests, full release validation, 135 CSS layout cases and nine interactive isolated React scenarios. Fully quit Steam. Back up the complete SteamTrophies data directory and previous plugin. alexjm19/legion-go-s-control.name: v0.7.0 — server mode controls background services
alexjm19/legion-go-s-control.body:
## Legion Go S Control v0.7.0

### Server mode now controls background services
A handheld is a console first. Server mode now also manages a list of background services, so turning it off gives games the whole machine:

- **Server mode off (console mode):** normal sleep, and the configured services are **stopped** (RAM freed).
- **Server mode on:** no sleep, services running.
- **Pause services while gaming** (on by default): while a game is open (Steam or non-Steam shortcut), the services are **frozen** with the cgroup freezer (`systemctl freeze`): 0 % CPU instantly, resumed on exit. RAM is kept.
- The System tab shows each service's state (running / paused / stopped).

Configure the list in `~/homebrew/settings/legion-go-s-control/settings.json` → `services`:
```json
"services": { "units": ["hermes.service"], "users": ["hermes-ops"], "pause_in_game": true }
```
`units` are system units; `users` are service accounts whose whole user manager (`user@UID.service`, rootless containers included) is stopped/frozen. Entries that don't exist on your system are ignored, so with the defaults nothing changes unless you have them. The periodic re-apply never starts anything, and the plugin never leaves services frozen when it unloads.

**Tested on Bazzite only** (Legion Go S 83Q2, `bazzite-deck` F45, kernel `7.3.4-ogc8.1`). SteamOS is untested.

featherwolf/oxp3deck.name: OXP3 Deck 0.6.0
featherwolf/oxp3deck.body:
Safety and ease of use: a crash-proof panel, protected settings files, Fix all, daily update checks, a shorter **This game** group, and two opt-in extras. Bundles oxp3-tool 0.4.4. **Not yet tested on a device.**

## New

- **Crash-proof panel**: if one part of the panel hits an error, only that part shows "This section hit an error", with **Retry** and **Copy details**. The rest of Quick Access, TDP included, keeps working. Every red problem row now has **Copy**, and **Retry** where the failed step can be run again.
- **Fix all (N)**: when two or more programs fight over power control (for example power-profiles-daemon, tuned and intel_lpmd), one confirm turns them all off. Each one still has its own **Undo**, and any that fail are listed separately.
- **Daily update checks** (Settings → **Check for updates automatically**, on by default): once a day, when no game or job is running and the device is online, OXP3 Deck checks for updates to oxp3-tool, XeSS fast mode and OXP3 Deck itself. Closed groups say **Update available**. Nothing installs on its own:
  - when the bundled oxp3-tool is newer than the installed one, tap **Install**;
  - for a new OXP3 Deck version, tap **Copy install URL**.
- **Steadier fps after loads** (Power, opt-in, off by default): with no boost value set, boost follows sustained power, at +25 % on battery and +50 % on the charger. This only shortens the burst after loading screens; it does not save battery. The details show this device's power time windows.
- **XeSS logging turns itself off**: after one game run that writes a fresh XeSS log, **Save XeSS logs** is removed from the launch options and a note says so. Turn on **Keep logging** to leave it on. While logging is on, **This game** says it costs performance.

## Changed

- **This game in Quick Access is shorter**: it keeps automatic setup, XeSS version, frame generation, problem and rollback rows, and Last run. The expert launch options (driver, compat, DX12, logs, FSR→XeSS, frame-generation multiplier, Proton, tips) are under **More for this game**, which opens the Games tab. Power is now a few presses away while you play.
- **Per-game power profiles switch in order**: when you change games quickly, only the newest switch runs. A switch that fails now shows a problem row with **Retry**, instead of failing silently.

## Fixed

- **Settings files are never silently wiped**:
  - a damaged file is set aside as `<name>.corrupt-<time>`, keeping the last 3, and Status says so;
  - automatic setup and OptiScaler records stop saving until you tap **Start fresh**, so their undo information is not lost;
  - files from a newer OXP3 Deck open read-only, and keys this version does not know are kept;
  - a read error is not treated as damage;
  - a game that still has changes applied is never dropped from the automatic setup list.
- One game exit no longer runs the after-exit steps (OptiScaler apply, XeSS log turn-off, automatic setup pass) twice at the same time, which could undo a launch-option change.

## Under the hood

- Every release and every zip build now runs the Python tests, the JS tests and the TypeScript check, and the release checks that the committed zip matches a fresh build. CI runs on every push in both repos.

viber85/game-library.body:
# Game Library v0.6.10 — use native SteamOS "Space Required"

## The issue in 0.6.9

Steam Game Mode shows the actual **Space Required** figure (for example,
10.76 GB for Bright Memory: Infinite), but Game Library was often
showing a different Steam Store storage requirement.

Game Library previously called `appDetailsStore.GetAppDetails(appId)`
and subscribed to updates, **without ever invoking**
`appDetailsStore.RequestAppDetails(appId)`. If the native detail page
had not been opened, Steam's app detail cache could be empty. The Store
fallback then supplied a PC minimum/recommended requirement instead.

There was also a display mismatch: native bytes were divided by decimal
1,000,000,000 and values >= 10 GB were rounded to integers.

## Fix

- On focusing an uninstalled **Steam** game, read cached
  `lDiskSpaceRequiredBytes`. If unavailable, call native
  `appDetailsStore.RequestAppDetails(appId)` to load the same Steam
  AppDetails structure the official game details page uses.
- Use the returned `lDiskSpaceRequiredBytes` and the existing
  `SteamClient.Apps.RegisterForAppDetails` listener to update the card.
- Deduplicate concurrent native detail requests by AppID.
- Format native required space in binary units (1024³ bytes) with **two
  decimal places**, matching SteamOS's GB label more closely.
- Native value displays as **10.76 GB** (no tilde); tooltip explicitly
  identifies **Space Required · SteamOS native game details**.
- The public Steam Store minimum/recommended requirement is still a
  distinctly labeled **~GB estimate**, used only when native data
  cannot be obtained. Wait for native details before starting Store
  fallback, but allow fallback if native request stalls.
- No change to installed game folder sizes, Epic/GOG matching, tab data,
  navigation, artwork or Home/Library layout.

## Device verification

1. Update to v0.6.10, open Library > All Games, focus **Bright Memory:
   Infinite**, and allow Steam to load its app details.
2. Compare the disk number under the poster with the native Steam app
   page's **Space Required: 10.76 GB**. It should show the same value
   to two decimal places if the Steam native API returns it.
3. Focus another uninstalled Steam game and compare its poster value
   against the native app detail page.
4. A Store-only size still has a **~** prefix and may differ by GB:
   it is a minimum/recommended specification, not the native space
   required to install this depot/build.
5. Confirm installed Steam and installed Non-Steam sizes are unchanged.
6. Check keyboard/D-pad/analogue navigation through the Library.

## Limitations

Steam's private frontend stores and timing can vary between versions.
If native `RequestAppDetails` fails to yield
`lDiskSpaceRequiredBytes`, the badge keeps the approximate Store value.
This release does not download or calculate depot manifests to invent
a precise figure.

Node and TypeScript tests validate native request, deduplication, safe
fallback and exact two-decimal native formatting. Matching the specific
10.76 GB on your device still requires physical validation.

  (`send_read_acknowledge`), бейдж непрочитанного локально гасится в списке чатов.
- **Разделители дат** — между сообщениями разных дней показывается строка с датой
  (ДД.ММ.ГГГГ).
- **Имена отправителей** — для входящих сообщений в группах над текстом выводится имя
  отправителя (в личке скрыто).
- Собственные сообщения визуально отличаются от входящих (выравнивание и цвет).

### Changed
- `get_messages` принимает `offset_id` и возвращает обогащённые сообщения
  (id, out, sender, text, time, date, media_type, media_label, file_name, caption).

### Fixed
- Тихие блоки `except Exception: pass` заменены на логирование ошибок
  (`decky.logger.error`) — сбои больше не глотаются молча.

## [0.1.0]

Initial release: вход в аккаунт (телефон / код / 2FA), список чатов, отправка и приём
сообщений, уведомления о новых сообщениях прямо в игре (тосты Steam),
автоматическая установка Telethon.

crspytopgn/pitwall.name: Pitwall 0.1.0 (preview)
crspytopgn/pitwall.body:
**First public preview.** Pitwall makes sim racing on SteamOS and the Steam Machine easy: it sets up your sims and wheel, then helps you drive faster.

> Pitwall hasn't been tested on real hardware yet. Please [report what works and what doesn't](https://github.com/crspytopgn/pitwall/issues/new/choose); every report helps.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `Pitwall-0.1.0.zip` | The **Decky plugin**: Decky → cog → Developer mode → Install Plugin from ZIP File. [Guide](https://github.com/crspytopgn/pitwall/blob/main/docs/install.md) |
| `Pitwall-standalone-0.1.0.tar.gz` | **Standalone**, no Decky needed: extract, then run `./install.sh` in Desktop Mode. [Guide](https://github.com/crspytopgn/pitwall/blob/main/docs/standalone.md) |

New Steam Machine? Start with the [day-one guide](https://github.com/crspytopgn/pitwall/blob/main/docs/day-one.md).

## What's in it

- **Auto setup** for your device and wheel, and a **game guide** for 27 sims: whether each runs on SteamOS, setup steps, in-game force feedback settings and known issues, with live ratings from Valve, ProtonDB and Are We Anti-Cheat Yet
- **Telemetry** from BeamNG, Live for Speed, Forza, DiRT, F1 21–23, Assetto Corsa, ACC, AC EVO, AMS2, Project CARS 2, rFactor 2, Le Mans Ultimate, RaceRoom and the SCS truck sims, including a one-tap telemetry bridge for shared-memory sims
- **Wheel buttons**: see what every button does in Steam and in the game, live and on your phone; move around Steam's menus with your wheel; a layout per game from the actions each game has, with a diagram; BeamNG.drive's buttons set up for you on top of BeamNG's own wheel profile
- **Graphics tuning** for the Steam Machine: a graphics level per game, a steady frame cap, measured only while you're racing, and the game's own settings changed after each session for BeamNG.drive, Assetto Corsa, Unreal Engine games, F1 and DiRT Rally 2.0, Automobilista 2, Project CARS 2 and the truck sims (preset advice for the rest)
- **Wheel control and profiles** per game and per car: MOZA (all bases), Logitech, Fanatec, Thrustmaster; rev lights on MOZA and Logitech; clear messages when a MOZA base isn't usable, such as an R3 still in Xbox mode
- **Force feedback setup**: which effects your driver supports, a gentle test pull, and on SteamOS a one-tap install of the community driver your wheel needs, with a reinstall prompt after SteamOS updates
- **Force feedback tuning**: sourced presets and a "what feels wrong?" tuner with undo
- **Phone dashboard** over Wi-Fi with five layouts (shift lights, gear, delta, times, fuel, tyres, track map, voice callouts)
- **Coaching**, **fuel and tyre strategy**, **performance checks**, an optional **engineer debrief**, **update checks** for installed drivers and the bridge, and **one-tap diagnostics** for bug reports

Full list in the [changelog](https://github.com/crspytopgn/pitwall/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Pitwall builds on the Linux sim racing community's work; see the [credits](https://github.com/crspytopgn/pitwall/blob/main/CREDITS.md).

yoyossef/decky-xess-xmx-linux.name: v1.0.5
yoyossef/decky-xess-xmx-linux.body:
Ready to use — and **Proton Experimental works now**: the pinned 20261115 package's Proton launch hooks
automatically disable `VK_EXT_descriptor_heap`, the extension behind the black screen on recent
Experimental builds. A stable Proton (e.g. Proton 11) remains the conservative choice.

![DLSS 4 inputs running on XeSS XMX in Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter](https://github.com/yoyossef/decky-xess-xmx-linux/releases/download/v1.0.5/DLSS4_XeSS_XMX_Trails.png)

Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: OptiScaler routes the game's **DLSS 4** upscaler inputs onto
**XeSS on XMX**. The game thinks DLSS; the GPU does Intel matrix cores.

## What's new in 1.0.5

- **Tested upstream package: 20261115.** The headline upstream fix is the black image on
  newer Proton Experimental (vkd3d `VK_EXT_descriptor_heap` incompatibility) — the launch hooks
  now disable the offending extension automatically, so **Proton Experimental is no longer a
  no-go** for plugin-managed games. Also: HDR stutter fixed in frame-gen
  (e.g. CONTROL Resonant), Xe2 works on unpatched Mesa, and new opt-in knobs
  (`XESS=auto`, `XESS_LL`, per-game hook logging).
- **Package updates now retarget the Proton launch hooks by themselves.** Previously the hooks
  kept running the *previous* package's logic after a Download while still reporting green —
  stale Intel SDK libraries and missing extension merges with no signal. After a successful
  preparation, the hook lines and the driver-check units follow the new package automatically
  (only plugin-owned marker blocks are rewritten, journal-logged; an unwritable Proton is
  reported, never forced).
- **No more duplicate package folders.** The Download button reads
  "**20261115** (tested) installed" and stays disabled once the tested package is prepared;
  a fresh download only comes back when it is genuinely missing or replaced.
- **"Remove old package copies"** in the package section: lists exactly which stale prepared
  folders would be deleted and which stay — and *why* (selected package / used by an enabled
  game). Your current package and anything a running setup references can never be candidates,
  the confirm is bound to the preview, and everything is journal-logged.
- **DLSS inputs on XeSS XMX is validated**: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter runs its DLSS 4
  entries through OptiScaler onto XeSS on XMX (screenshot above).

## Requirements

- **Decky Loader** on a native Steam install — the Flatpak Steam is not supported.
- An **Intel GPU with XMX** on the `xe`/`i915` kernel driver: Xe3 (validated on the ONEXPLAYER
  3, Arc B390), Xe2 (user-validated on Arc B580), Xe-HPG (user-validated on Arc A310). Meteor
  Lake has no XMX units; other Intel GPUs are unverified, not assumed working.
- **Proton Experimental works**, thanks to the pinned 20261115 package: its Proton launch hooks
  automatically disable `VK_EXT_descriptor_heap`, the extension behind the black screen on recent
  Experimental builds. A stable Proton (e.g. Proton 11) remains the conservative choice.
- An internet connection for first-time setup: the plugin **downloads the upstream
  [xess-xmx-linux](https://github.com/HHHHanasak1/xess-xmx-linux) release validated against this
  plugin build** — the tag shown right on the **Download/Update package** button. The archive URL,
  size and SHA256 are resolved live from the GitHub release metadata (never frozen in the plugin)
  and the download is verified before it is unpacked into a new versioned folder in your home
  directory. The Intel compiler, XeSS SDK and FidelityFX dependencies are resolved from the
  official upstream helpers and release metadata at preparation time. Downloaded content is
  hashed, and helpers run in an isolated, networkless workspace. Newer upstream releases are
  **announced** on the Setup page as not-yet-validated, but never downloaded or forced; each
  plugin update may raise the validated release. A manual extracted folder is optional under
  Details and is badged as unvalidated; if it lacks dependencies, use Download package to
  prepare a complete copy. Nothing is applied to a game until you preview and confirm that
  game's setup.
- Games on their **DX12 renderer** — XeSS/FSR is selected in each game's own graphics settings.

## Installing the plugin

1. Grab the plugin zip from this repository's [releases](https://github.com/yoyossef/decky-xess-xmx-linux/releases)
   (or build it, below — `pnpm build && python3 scripts/package.py` writes
   `out/Decky XeSS XMX.zip`).
2. Either:
   - In Game Mode, open Decky's settings, turn on **Developer mode**, and use
     **Install Plugin from URL** with the zip's download link; or
   - unpack the zip into `~/homebrew/plugins/` (folder name `Decky XeSS XMX`) and restart
     Decky Loader.
3. The XeSS XMX driver package itself is fetched on first setup, from the upstream GitHub release
   with checksum verification (next section) — or point the plugin at a copy you downloaded
   yourself. Nothing is applied to any game until you preview and confirm it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yoyossef/decky-xess-xmx-linux/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.5

chino/decky-discord-status-relay.name: Discord Status Relay 2.0.0
chino/decky-discord-status-relay.body:
Decky plugin that shows your current game as your Discord status. Discord can run on the handheld or on another machine (your PC), so the handheld doesn't need Discord at all.

Fork of [steamdeck-discord-status](https://github.com/andrewburgess/steamdeck-discord-status) by Andrew Burgess (archived after 1.6.0).

**New since Discord Status 1.6.0**
- Relay to Discord on another machine: plain TCP, TLS or HTTP(S)/WebSocket, optional token and certificate pinning
- Receivers for the PC: one-line PowerShell installer for Windows, Python receiver for Linux/macOS/Windows
- Retries until Discord is back, then restores your status
- Games with their own rich presence take over from the generic "Playing X" status
- Rich presence from Windows games under Proton, through a bundled [rpc-bridge](https://github.com/EnderIce2/rpc-bridge) (MIT). On by default; restart Game Mode after toggling
- New name: Discord Status Relay

**Install**
Decky settings → Developer → Install plugin from URL, with the zip below. Then set **Target** to your PC and start a receiver there (see the [README](https://github.com/chino/decky-discord-status-relay#readme)).

Tested on a ROG Ally (Bazzite, Game Mode) relaying to Discord on Windows 11.

lnavarrocarter/deckhub.body:
## DeckHub 0.13.0 — actualizaciones automáticas / automatic updates

- DeckHub revisa GitHub Releases cada 6 horas, avisa en el menú rápido y en Ajustes, y se actualiza con un toque: Decky lo instala con su confirmación y comprueba la huella SHA-256 del zip.

# Veckord v1.1.0 Release Notes

## Overview

Veckord v1.1.0 introduces **Recent Voice Channels** tracking, **Audio Device & Volume Controls**, **Live Audio Level Metering**, a modular UI component architecture, and a **Display Streaming Feasibility Audit**.

---

## Key Features & Improvements in v1.1.0

### 1. Recent Voice Channels
- Automatically tracks joined voice channels with Most-Recently-Used (MRU) ordering.
- Displays recent channels directly underneath the active voice card for 1-click reconnect.
- Persisted across restarts in `~/.config/veckord/recents.json`.

### 2. Audio Device Selection & Volume Sliders
- Controller-native device selection (`Dropdown`) for input/output audio devices while connected.
- Dual input and output volume sliders (`SliderField`) with smooth controller navigation and debounced IPC updates.

### 3. Live Audio Level Metering
- Real-time input (microphone) and output level meters (`AudioLevelMeters.tsx`) with speaking indicators.

### 4. Modular Component Architecture
- Refactored frontend into focused sub-components (`VoiceCard.tsx`, `RecentChannels.tsx`, `AudioControls.tsx`, `AudioLevelMeters.tsx`, `ConnectionStatus.tsx`).

### 5. Display Streaming Feasibility Audit
- Conducted technical evaluation (`docs/display_streaming_findings.md`) assessing Wayland / PipeWire / `xdg-desktop-portal` behavior in Steam Gaming Mode.

---

## Release Assets

| Asset | Description |
|---|---|
| `install.py` | Standalone Python 3 installer script |
| `veckord.zip` | Production Decky Loader plugin package |
| `vencordBridge.zip` | Vencord bridge plugin TypeScript source package |
| `vencord-dist.zip` | Precompiled Vencord distribution with `VeckordBridge` |
| `checksums.sha256` | SHA-256 manifest for all release assets |

---

## Quick Start Command

```bash
wget https://github.com/mattytacos/veckord/releases/download/v1.1.0/install.py
python3 install.py --tag v1.1.0 check
python3 install.py --tag v1.1.0 install
```

timekillr/value-forge-decky.body:
Use Value Forge from a phone, tablet, or computer browser on the same local network. The plugin serves the complete web interface itself—free, with no account or public hosting.

- Shares the Android companion workspace: processes, Auto and exact-change searches, live scan progress, single/multiple Quick edits, named groups, group writes, individual edits, freeze, labels, moving, and removal.
- Pair each browser once using a fresh six-digit code. Pairing stays remembered in a secure browser cookie; access can be revoked in Decky.
- Disconnect/Reconnect appears only on Connection. Automatic connection attempts stop after ten seconds. Returning to an active tab refreshes values.
- LAN-only browser access, same-origin command checks, bundled assets, and no offline write queue.
- Existing Android pairings and certificates remain compatible. Android Companion stays at 0.3.2; no APK update is needed.

### Get started

1. Install **ValueForge.zip** using Decky's URL installer (`https://is.gd/valueforge` still points to the latest build), then restart Decky.
2. Enable **Phone & web companion** and open the **HTTPS web address shown in Decky** on another device on the same network.
3. The browser will warn about the local self-signed certificate. Inspect its certificate details and compare the full **SHA-256 fingerprint** against Decky before trusting it.
4. Choose **Pair a phone or browser** in Decky, then enter that new code in the web page. Bookmark that exact address and keep cookies enabled.

The machine must be awake and reachable. Guest Wi-Fi isolation/firewalls may block the connection. No router port forwarding is needed. A changed hostname/IP or cleared browser data requires a new browser pairing.

Validation: native scanner build, type checking, production Decky build, 56 backend/TLS integration tests, 26 Decky UI scenarios, 18 shared companion UI/connection scenarios, browser-transport checks, ZIP integrity and bundled-file checks. Browser layout was checked with demo data; real TLS tests used an opt-in disposable Linux target. SteamOS and browser certificate-trust setup still need on-device testing.

Based on Memory Deck by Camzie99 (Cameron Redmore) and contributors, using scanmem. GPL-3.0; complete source and attribution are included.

patrickshao/wake-pc.name: Wake PC Companion 1.1.0
patrickshao/wake-pc.body:
Wake PC Companion 1.1.0 moves its data out of a folder that any local Windows user could edit. **Windows users should update.** The Decky plugin is unchanged and stays at 1.0.0.

## Changes

- **Windows companion 1.1.0:** data now lives in each user's `%LOCALAPPDATA%\WakePcSleepBridge`, not `C:\ProgramData\WakePcSleepBridge`. Elevated setup no longer reads any configuration and always uses port 47653. The old folder is never read, and the app removes it at first launch.
- **Decky plugin 1.0.0:** no runtime change, so these are the original 1.0.0 files. You don't need to reinstall it.
- **Mac CLI:** no change.

Supported platforms: SteamOS/Decky, Mac CLI, and Windows x64.

## Upgrading from companion 1.0.0

Run the new Setup.exe over the existing install. **Upgrading needs one new pairing:** choose **Pair for Sleep** in **Setup & status** from the tray icon, then enter the code in Wake PC. Sleep PC won't work until you do; Wake isn't affected. You will also need to confirm your saved MAC and IP address again.

## Install

- **Decky:** install `wake-pc-v1.0.0.zip` using Decky's ZIP installer.
- **Windows x64:** run `wake-pc-sleep-bridge-v1.1.0-setup.exe` to enable paired status and sleep requests.
- **Mac:** download the source, run `python3 mac/install.py`, then `~/.local/bin/wake-pc setup` (Python 3.9+).

See the [setup guide](https://github.com/patrickshao/wake-pc#readme). The `latest` assets contain the same bytes as their versioned counterparts.

## Verification and limitations

**Windows installers are unsigned** hobby releases. SHA-256 sidecars are included: use `shasum -a 256 -c *.sha256` on macOS, `sha256sum --check *.sha256` on Linux, or compare Windows `Get-FileHash <download> -Algorithm SHA256` with its sidecar.

Pair only on a trusted LAN: pairing transfers the long-lived key over local HTTP. This is not intended for exposure to the internet.

Automated release checks passed on Linux, macOS, and Windows for this commit, including packaging and the native companion's self-tests.

Device testing was limited. On Windows 11 (10.0.26200), an in-place upgrade from a pre-release 1.0.0 build was completed using a local build of this same commit, followed by one confirmed Sleep and Wake from a Legion Go S running Decky. That test carried the existing pairing over by hand, so **the documented new-pairing path above, the finish-screen message, and this exact Setup.exe have not been run on real hardware.** The five-cycle test, display-scaling checks, crash recovery, sign-in startup, and uninstall were not repeated for this release. Exact SteamOS and Decky versions were not recorded.

Source: `d2592caf157cdc80091db0a40c9db6118042e524`. The Decky files were built from the `v1.0.0` release.

# 0.3.0-alpha.4
