zrprod9-cmyk/vela.name: Vela 0.10.0
zrprod9-cmyk/vela.body:
Vela 0.10.0 makes FSR 4 in Vulkan games really run on the NPU, updates OptiScaler to the current upstream, and adds ANF for Snapdragon 8 Gen 3.

### New
- **FSR 4 in Vulkan games now runs on the NPU.** In 0.9.0 the FSR 4 network did not get any work in games that draw with Vulkan (for example Unity games started with -force-vulkan) and the picture was about SGSR 2 quality. Now the work reaches the NPU: in Haste (Vulkan) FSR 4 runs at 43.2 fps on the NPU, SGSR 2 at 49.8 fps. The NPU did 14 160 frames in our run with no errors.
- **OptiScaler updated to the current upstream.** Changes you can notice: fixes in the DirectX 11 path (copying and clearing of images, compute-shader state), XeSS depth and motion vectors in Unreal games, OptiSharpen, DLSS sub-rectangle cropping in the DirectX 12, DirectX 11 and Vulkan backends, Vulkan frame-generation fixes. Our own changes are carried over. Speed is the same as before in our tests (Deep Rock Galactic, Bright Memory: Infinite, Manor Lords).
- **ANF on Snapdragon 8 Gen 3.** ANF (Adreno Neural Fusion, Qualcomm's upscaler, run by Vela on the NPU) can now be offered on Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 units too, after you run the NPU installer once (see How to update). The installer checks that every ANF graph gives the right result on your unit, and Vela shows ANF only if it does. **We could not test this on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 device. If you have one, please try it and tell us how it went.**

### Fixed
- **Crash in games with DLSS on Proton 11 ARM64.** A Wine bug made the game crash when it checked the DLSS library's signature (seen in Manor Lords with the updated OptiScaler). Vela now clears the stack in those checks so the Wine bug has nothing to hit. Manor Lords runs with FSR 4 and ANF (59 fps, the game's limit) and writes no crash dump.
- **Panel wording for ANF.** The panel now says ANF is Adreno Neural Fusion (Qualcomm) on the NPU.

Steam games, our Retroid Pocket 6, average fps, same scene in both versions:

| game | model | 0.9.0 | 0.10.0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deep Rock Galactic, DirectX 12 | FSR 4 | 38.8 | 38.8 |
| Deep Rock Galactic, DirectX 12 | ANF | 41.5 | 41.5 |
| Deep Rock Galactic, DirectX 12 | SGSR 2 | 43.9 | 43.8 |
| Haste, Vulkan | FSR 4 | not working, see the 0.9.0 notes | 43.2 (on the NPU) |
| Haste, Vulkan | SGSR 2 | 49.9 | 49.8 |
| Bright Memory: Infinite, DirectX 11 | FSR 3 | 42.8 | 41.2 (a game's second launch is about 4 fps faster, so this is not a loss) |
| Manor Lords, DirectX 12 | FSR 4 / ANF | 59.5 | 59.2 / 59.3 (the game's 60 fps limit) |

### Known issues
- ANF on Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 is untested on a real device (see above). On other chips it is not shown.
- Vela shows itself as an NVIDIA GPU to native Vulkan games so they offer DLSS. We tested this end to end in one game (Haste); if a game misbehaves, tell us.
- DirectX 12 through Engine.ini (#5) is covered by tests only; we have no Unreal game from a launcher on our device. Please report how it goes.
- FSR 3 and DittoSR in native Vulkan games don't start on our device; Vela uses SGSR 2 there.
- On an AYN Odin 3 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, #7) the NPU check fails, so FSR 4 runs on the GPU there; we are looking into it.
- On some Retroid Pocket 6 units the NPU gives wrong results even with the smaller graphs (#2); there the NPU stays off and FSR 4 runs on the GPU. The installer says so.
- Scenes without a depth buffer still use FSR 1.
- FSR 4 Fast: black rectangles in some games on 8 Elite. We don't see them on 8 Gen 2.

### How to update
In the Vela panel: Updates → **Check now** → **Update**. Or in Decky: gear → Developer → Install Plugin from ZIP File → `vela-0.10.0.zip`.

FSR 4 on the NPU in Vulkan games, the OptiScaler update and the fixes need only the plugin. To get ANF on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, run the NPU installer once: close the game, go to Desktop mode, open Konsole and run
`curl -fsSL https://github.com/zrprod9-cmyk/vela/releases/latest/download/install-vela-npu.sh | sudo sh`

zrprod9-cmyk/vela.body:
Faster NPU graphs, a fix for units whose NPU gives wrong FSR 4 output, and a fix for SGSR 2 colours.

### New
- **NPU package 17.** Faster FSR 4 on the NPU with the same picture bit for bit. NPU time per frame on our Retroid Pocket 6: 1280x720 output -5 %, 1280x800 -5 %, 1920x1080 Ultra Performance -10 %, 1152x648 -31 %, 960x540 -16 %.
- **Units whose NPU gives wrong FSR 4 output (#2).** When the NPU service starts it checks one graph with a known input. If the result is wrong, it switches to graphs planned for a smaller memory window, which give correct results on the units tested in #2. If those are wrong too, the NPU stays off and Vela runs FSR 4 on the GPU instead of showing a broken picture.
- The NPU power governor is on by default: it lowers the NPU clock when the game has time to spare. FSR4NPUD_POWER_GOV=0 turns it off.
- FSR 4: the GPU part does a little less work per frame (about 0.1 ms), same picture bit for bit.

zrprod9-cmyk/vela.body:
Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 support, a faster NPU part, and a fix for games started through the Rockstar Games Launcher.

wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.name: GSF Kedavra 1.8.0
wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.body:
# What's new in GSF Kedavra 1.8.0

- **Cleaner camera reversals.** The generator tracks changes in camera speed across real frames and uses their actual timestamps. In the 1280×800 Courtyard reversal test at ×3, blocks with large errors fell from 4.46% in Courtyard 3 to 3.44% in Courtyard 4. [Scene and measurements](https://github.com/wavessevaw/GFG-Extreme/tree/95398f2f795bbf08b8e8f1533af2e54d2c415e03/docs/courtyard4)
- **More definition in dark detail.** Kedavra Focus deepens softened stitches, fur and fine dark lettering in SDR. Use **Setup → Kedavra Focus**, with frame generation on or off. [Images and motion comparisons](https://github.com/wavessevaw/GFG-Extreme/tree/53c40ff8bb422b1671d8dcce1ec0a116beeeb381/docs/focus-dark-detail)
- **Steadier HUD and pacing.** The engine protects stationary HUD strokes on every SDR pair. At 90 Hz the scheduler checks the source cadence before advancing a ready real frame after a hitch. Automatic 30→60 ×2 continues to work at 60 Hz.

Install **GSF-Kedavra-1.8.0.zip** in Decky, reinstall Gamescope in Setup and restart the Deck. To roll back, install the [previous official package](https://github.com/wavessevaw/GSF_Kedavra/releases/tag/v1.7.0), reinstall its Gamescope and restart.

The comparisons use software Vulkan. Focus can accentuate existing interpolation errors. Steam Deck GPU time, latency and game-specific results for this build remain unmeasured.

wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.body:
# What's new in GSF Kedavra 1.7.0

- Auto targets 30 FPS ×2 at 60 or 59.94 Hz, including when a lower floor was saved for another display.
- At fixed 30→60, Silk can show a ready real frame up to one refresh earlier when the same pair would otherwise generate a second intermediate frame.

wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.name: GSF Kedavra 1.6.2
wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.body:
# GSF Kedavra 1.6.2

Restores centred HUD panels used by the existing GFG Benchmark interface. Touch coordinates follow the displayed panel. Includes the 1.6.1 shared-controller lease and native frame telemetry. Focus, shaders, interpolation and the Silk scheduler are unchanged.

Install this ZIP in Decky, reinstall Gamescope from Setup and reboot. If GFG is also installed, update both plugins and install the matching GFG runtime last. Standalone Kedavra yields engine control while GFG is active without losing preferences.

Rollback: remove the custom Gamescope runtime in Setup, reboot, then reinstall the prior plugin and its matching runtime. Do not pair an old standalone controller with a new GFG controller.

Automated checks do not establish real Steam Deck touch, power or frame-pacing performance. No physical Deck was available for this build.

wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.name: GSF Kedavra 1.6.1
wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.body:
# GSF Kedavra 1.6.1

- Adds compositor HUD touch input and native frame interval telemetry for the GFG Extreme 3.4.1 in-game Benchmark.
- Adds controller ownership handoff: standalone Kedavra pauses its HUD and controller commands while a compatible GFG Extreme session owns Gamescope.
- Preserves the 1.6.0 Focus shader, optical flow, frame warping and Silk scheduler.

**Install:** Decky Loader -> Install Plugin from ZIP. If also using GFG Extreme 3.4.1, update both plugins, then install/reinstall the Gamescope runtime from GFG Setup and reboot once. Do not overwrite GFG's runtime afterward using the standalone installer.

Software CI and virtual runtime checks do not constitute Steam Deck hardware validation.

wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.name: GSF Kedavra 1.6.0
wavessevaw/gsf_kedavra.body:
## What's New in 1.6.0

- **Kedavra Focus:** Adaptive edge sharpening with halo protection.
- **Simplified Controls:** One ON/OFF switch, fixed 100% strength.
- **Frame Generation:** Focus works on real and generated frames.
- **Upscaler Compatibility:** Independent of FSR, XeSS, DLSS and OptiScaler.
- **GPU Efficiency:** Single-pass processing without extra full-resolution buffers.

*Focus is SDR-only. HDR is bypassed.*

## Imp v1.1.1

### Branding & Workspace Cleanup
- Standardized user-facing titles, tray/MPRIS/SteamVR labels, Decky plugin metadata, documentation, and the GitHub Pages site around **Imp — Interactive Media Player** (preserving legacy compatibility matchers and archive names).

- Tracked `Cargo.lock` for deterministic locked builds and added GitHub Actions CI (`cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --locked`, `cargo-deny`, `cargo-audit`, UI/Decky builds) alongside weekly cooldown-gated dependency refresh PR automation targeting `develop`.

flightdan/fingerprintunlock-steamos.name: Fingerprint Unlock for SteamOS v0.1.10
flightdan/fingerprintunlock-steamos.body:
## 中文

- `install.sh` 和 Decky ZIP 安装同一套插件。游戏模式录入和解锁使用系统当前的 fprintd 驱动。单读卡器配置下按设备能力显示轻触或滑动提示。按压式设备会提示抬手再按，驱动报告总阶段数时显示完整进度。最多可添加六枚指纹。
- 重试超时与取消处理随通用插件安装。已验证的 FTE3600 BRISK 流程保留八张有效样本和第 4 张后的指尖边缘提示。FT9365 的物理抬指由已安装的驱动判定，补丁收录在安装器源码中。 [驱动与适用范围](https://github.com/FlightDan/FingerprintUnlock-SteamOS/blob/v0.1.10/native/ft9365-release.md)
- 下载 `fingerprint-unlock-installer-v0.1.10.tar.gz`，解包后运行 `sudo sh install.sh`，或以普通用户运行 `sh install-online.sh`。Decky 本地安装可使用 `boiler-fingerprint-unlock-v0.1.10.zip`。使用 `SHA256SUMS` 核对附件。

**实机验证** · ONEXPLAYER X2 Mini（FT9365）上的录入和解锁均由用户在设备上确认通过，使用含抬指修复的下游驱动与 Decky 插件。

## English

- `install.sh` and the Decky ZIP install the same plugin. Game Mode enrollment and unlock use the system's existing fprintd driver. With one configured reader, enrollment shows touch or swipe guidance. Press readers prompt the user to lift and touch again, and progress uses the total stage count when the driver reports it. The Add fingerprint action supports up to six saved fingerprints.
- The common plugin includes retry timeouts and cancellation. The validated FTE3600 BRISK flow retains eight accepted samples and a fingertip-edge prompt after sample four. Physical lift on FT9365 is handled by the installed driver. The installer source includes the driver patch. [Driver and compatibility](https://github.com/FlightDan/FingerprintUnlock-SteamOS/blob/v0.1.10/native/ft9365-release.md)
- Extract `fingerprint-unlock-installer-v0.1.10.tar.gz` and run `sudo sh install.sh`, or run `sh install-online.sh` as your regular user. For Decky's local install, use `boiler-fingerprint-unlock-v0.1.10.zip`. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

**Hardware validation** · The user confirmed successful enrollment and fingerprint unlock on an ONEXPLAYER X2 Mini (FT9365) using the downstream driver with the lift fix and the Decky plugin.

# VBAN Deck 0.2.2 - Steam Deck / Linux

This patch fixes receiver settings in the Decky Loader plugin and removes the preset destination IP.

## Fixed

- **IP address stays entered in Game Mode.** Background status updates no longer overwrite the destination IP, port, stream name, or advanced target while you edit them.
- **Fixed the Python exception when starting a stream.** The Decky backend now initializes settings using the correct Decky settings directory.
- **Clearer start errors.** Invalid settings and settings-save failures now display their actual error message.
- **No preset receiver IP.** Fresh installs start with a blank destination address. Enter your receiver PC's IP before starting. Existing saved settings are preserved. The source defaults have also been updated for Android and macOS.

## Downloads

- **Steam Deck Game Mode / Decky Loader:** `VBANDeck-0.2.2.zip`
- **Steam Deck Desktop Mode / Linux:** `VBANDeck-0.2.2.flatpak`

Install the ZIP through Decky Loader's plugin installer, or install the Flatpak through your desktop's software installer. Set your receiver address and use the same UDP port and stream name in VBAN Deck and your VBAN receiver.

The Decky fixes were tested on Steam Deck before release. Audio remains 48 kHz stereo, signed 16-bit PCM over VBAN.

samutw/fushi-lens.name: Fushi Lens 0.1.0 (ec6d925291)
samutw/fushi-lens.body:
Fushi Lens 0.1.0 for Steam Deck (Decky Loader), built from
[hajisensai/Fushi@ec6d925291](https://github.com/hajisensai/Fushi/tree/ec6d925291/tools/decky-fushi-lens)
(`develop`, 2026-11-07). Community build, not an official Fushi release.

Reads the text on screen in Game Mode with your Fushi app (3.3.0 or newer, on a PC or
`fushi_server` on the same network), so you can look words up and mine them to Anki.

**Install:** Decky settings → General → Developer Mode on → Developer →
*Install Plugin from URL* with this zip's link, or *Install Plugin from ZIP File*.
Then pair in the Fushi Lens panel. Full guide, including how to install Decky Loader:
[README](https://github.com/samutw/fushi-lens#readme).

**Changes since the Nov 4 test build:** the plugin checks page input, keeps the pairing
token file readable only by you, and builds frame URLs more safely. A LICENSE file is now
included in the zip.

Check the file with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.

db452/deckywhatsapp.name: Decky WhatsApp 1.1.0
db452/deckywhatsapp.body:
Decky WhatsApp 1.1.0

This release includes the Decky plugin and separate PC bridge packages for Windows and supported Linux systems.

Downloads:
- Decky plugin: decky-whatsapp-decky-plugin-v1.1.0.zip. Install this ZIP through Decky Loader on the Steam Deck.
- Windows PC companion: decky-whatsapp-pc-windows-v1.1.0.zip. Extract to a permanent folder and run install-decky-whatsapp-windows.ps1.
- Linux PC companion: decky-whatsapp-pc-linux-v1.1.0.zip. For Ubuntu/Debian x86_64; see the included Linux guide.
- SHA256SUMS-v1.1.0.txt verifies the three ZIP downloads.

Highlights:
- Adds the Linux PC companion package for Ubuntu/Debian x86_64.
- Improves bridge and SSH tunnel startup, reconnect handling, and bounded recovery from stale forwarded-port conflicts.
- Improves message synchronization and chronological conversation history.
- Improves Decky startup and controller behavior; the production plugin starts off until manually enabled.

Requirements:
- Windows companion: Node.js 22 or newer, Git for Windows, and Windows OpenSSH.
- Linux companion: Ubuntu/Debian x86_64 and Node.js 22 or newer. Node.js 24 LTS is recommended.
- Decky plugin: Steam Deck with Decky Loader installed.

Verification recorded for this release includes the automated test suite, both typechecks, production/MOCK builds, Windows and Ubuntu VM checks, and user-reported Deck manual checks. The release ZIPs were checked for their expected contents and SHA-256 hashes.

ivshalenko/codex-steamdeck.name: Deck AI 1.0.0-rc.26 — desktop shortcut
ivshalenko/codex-steamdeck.body:
Creates the missing **Deck AI desktop shortcut** during application installation and updates. The existing application-menu entry and Steam library integration remain available.

- Use the user's actual XDG desktop, including a localized folder such as **Рабочий стол**.
- Create an executable launcher with the Deck AI icon. Repeated installation keeps one shortcut.
- Preserve pre-existing personal or edited desktop files. Respect disabled or external desktop configuration.
- Track unchanged managed shortcuts for updater rollback and uninstall.

### Update

Open **Deck AI → Settings → Check now → Update with one button**. Then return to Desktop Mode and open **Deck AI** on the desktop. There is no need to download the full Codex bundle again.

Alternatively, use the **[installer page](https://ivshalenko.github.io/codex-steamdeck/install/?lang=ru&v=26)**, extract the ZIP and run **Install Deck AI**.

### Validation

322 Python tests, 43 frontend checks and production packaging passed locally and in GitHub Actions. On a physical Steam Deck, a fresh installation under a home path containing spaces created a 0755 launcher in the localized desktop folder. GIO accepted the entry, the launcher reported rc.26, a native KDE launch opened the app window, and reinstalling created no duplicate. Both installed components passed health and file-integrity checks with user state and the EN/RU hardware-keyboard configuration preserved.

This remains an independently distributed **preview release**, not an official Decky-store listing.

chesterfritz/decky-sony-headphones.name: sony-headphones-decky-v0.1.0
chesterfritz/decky-sony-headphones.body:
## Sony Headphones for Decky — v0.1.0

First release. It lets you control Sony headphones from the Steam Deck's Quick Access menu, in Game Mode.

### Features
- Battery level (main, left/right and case, depending on the model) and the current Bluetooth codec
- Noise control: Off, Noise cancelling or Ambient sound, with the ambient level and Focus on Voice
- Speak-to-Chat, DSEE, equalizer presets and headphone volume
- Connection priority: Sound quality or Stable connection
- Controls appear only when your headphones report they support them
- The control channel is released when you close the panel, so Sony's phone app can reconnect

### Install
1. Download **`sony-headphones-decky-v0.1.0.zip`** below.
2. In Game Mode, open Quick Access → **Decky** → **Settings** → **Developer**. Turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Choose **Install Plugin from ZIP** and select the downloaded file.
4. Connect your headphones in **Settings → Bluetooth**, then open Quick Access → **Sony Headphones**. The first time, keep the panel open for a few seconds while it connects.

You don't need to build anything or use a terminal. The `sony-headphonesd` daemon is included in the zip and starts automatically.

### Notes
- Tested on a **WH-1000XM5** (firmware 2.5.1) with **SteamOS 3.9.5**. Other models supported by Sony | Sound Connect may work, but haven't been tested yet. Reports are welcome in Issues.
- If you already run `sony-headphones.service` yourself, the plugin uses it instead of its bundled copy.
- To use the daemon in Desktop Mode, or for troubleshooting, see the [README](https://github.com/ChesterFritz/decky-sony-headphones#readme).

### Checksum
e4cb8427937184f78e76b770fa4fd1c1268be261a8ed42bfc2a29b11ae2455fc  sony-headphones-decky-v0.1.0.zip

### Credits
Built on [sony-headphones-linux](https://github.com/VyomJain6904/sony-headphones-linux) by Vyom Jain. Bundles [libmdr](https://github.com/mos9527/SonyHeadphonesClient) and [fmt](https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt). Everything is MIT licensed, and the licences are included in the zip under `licenses/`.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony or Valve.

- Added multi-hook interception for `ControllerKeyboardSetKeyState`, `ControllerKeyboardSendText`, `ControllerKeyboardSubmit` and `ControllerKeyboardSendKey`.

kowalski-coder/alt_shift.name: Alt_Shift v0.0.4
kowalski-coder/alt_shift.body:

- ⚡ **Zero-Reboot Setup**: no console reboot required after installing the plugin.

- **Dynamic KDE Plasma layout discovery**: `detect_kde_layout_indices` dynamically maps language indices via D-Bus.
- **KDE Plasma daemon reload**: on-the-fly reconfiguration of `kded5`/`kded6`.
- **Multilingual documentation**: added English and Russian READMEs.

danielcamilo1/decky-launch-options-manag.name: v0.0.3
danielcamilo1/decky-launch-options-manag.body:
Your own launch options are now first-class: editable, switchable, and reusable.

- **"Found on this game" replaces "Already set, kept as-is".** Every setting a
  game already has that isn't in the catalogue — `WINEDEBUG=-all`, a wrapper you
  wrote yourself, a variable nobody has heard of — now gets its own checkbox and
  its own value box, at the top of the list. Before, it was text you could read
  but not touch.
- **Turn one off and it goes.** Edit its value and the new one is written. It
  still keeps its exact position in the command, so wrapper nesting survives.
- **Save any of them to your own options.** One press names it and adds it to
  *My options*, where it is a tick away on every other game. The game you took
  it from is not rewritten by a single character — the option simply changes
  which list it belongs to.
- Unrecognised wrapper commands keep their arguments together: an unknown
  `weirdwrap --flag` is one option, not two loose tokens.
- *Turn everything off* now spares anything found on the game, and says so — it
  reads *Turn off catalogue options* when there is something to spare. Wiping
  hand-written settings in one press is the one thing this plugin should never do.


## Installing

Install in Decky Loader with **Settings → Developer mode → Install Plugin from URL**, using the `.zip` link below, or download it and copy it to the Deck.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/danielcamilo1/decky-launch-options-manager/compare/v0.0.2...v0.0.3

danielcamilo1/decky-launch-options-manag.name: v0.0.2
danielcamilo1/decky-launch-options-manag.body:
Non-Steam games you added to Steam now actually work.

- **Non-Steam games are no longer hidden.** They report no size on disk and no
  install flag, so the "Installed only" filter — on by default — filtered every
  one of them out. A shortcut points at a file already on the machine, so it now
  always counts as installed.
- **Non-Steam entries Steam does not file as games are listed too.** The library
  sweep now covers the desktop and local collections as well, deduplicated, so a
  launcher or emulator you added shows up alongside everything else.
- **Applying no longer looks like it reverted.** Steam takes a shortcut's write
  into `shortcuts.vdf` without always pushing it back through its own details
  store, so re-reading after *Apply* could show the old string. The screen now
  keeps the string it just wrote.
- **The game's screen says whether Proton is in play.** A non-Steam game runs
  natively unless you force a compatibility tool on it, and until you do, every
  `PROTON_*`,…

danielcamilo1/decky-launch-options-manag.name: v0.0.1
danielcamilo1/decky-launch-options-manag.body:
First release. Steam launch options as checkboxes, from the Quick Access menu.

- Lists the whole library — Steam titles and non-Steam shortcuts alike — with
  search and a recently-played shortlist.
- Reads what a game already has: the existing launch string is parsed and shown
  as ticked boxes rather than something to retype.
- Every row carries the literal text it contributes (`PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND=1
  %command%`, `%command% -dx11`), so what is being written is never a guess.
- Every value is editable per game — cap the frame rate at 45 on one title and
  60 on another — with a one-press reset to the catalogue default.
- A short curated catalogue: `SteamDeck=0`, `PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND=1`,
  `PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE=1`, the esync/fsync and audio-crackle fixes,
  `WINEDLLOVERRIDES`, `gamemoderun`, `gamescope`, `mangohud`, and DXVK/VKD3D
  tuning, each with a plain-language description.
- Your own options — environment variable, wrapper command or game argument —
  added from the…

gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.name: Screen Recorder v0.10.3
gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.body:
이번 업데이트는 KMS의 HDR 녹화 방식과 품질을 개선합니다.

## 새 기능

- **HDR 밝기 설정:** 캡처 방식이 KMS이고 화면이 HDR을 지원하면 패널에 두 가지 설정이 나옵니다. Steam Deck OLED 내부 화면과 외부 HDR 모니터 모두에 적용됩니다.
  - **HDR 최대 밝기:** 게임의 HDR 최대 밝기 설정과 같게 맞추면 됩니다. 연결된 화면이 지원하는 밝기까지 고를 수 있고, 다른 화면을 연결해 최대값이 바뀌면 그 값으로 다시 맞춰집니다.
  - **HDR 하이라이트 보존:** 켜면 전체가 조금 어두워지는 대신 햇빛이나 반사광 같은 밝은 부분이 덜 뭉개집니다. 기본은 꺼져 있고, 이때는 대부분의 장면이 게임 화면과 비슷한 밝기로 녹화됩니다.

## 개선

- **HDR 게임 녹화의 밝은 부분:** 일정 밝기 이상을 모두 같은 흰색으로 잘라 내던 방식 대신, 밝은 부분을 부드럽게 줄여 해, 불빛, 반사광의 단계가 남습니다.
- **HDR 게임 녹화의 색:** 밝은 주황이 노랗게, 밝은 하늘색이 흰색 쪽으로 바뀌던 문제를 고쳐 밝아도 원래 색을 유지합니다.
- **HDR 게임 녹화의 밝기:** 일반 장면이 이전보다 밝게 녹화되어 게임 화면에 더 가깝습니다.
- **다른 기기의 내부 HDR 화면:** gamescope 설정에서 화면의 HDR 방식을 읽어 맞게 변환하고, HDR 밝기 설정도 쓸 수 있습니다. Steam Deck OLED 외의 기기에서는 확인하지 못했습니다.
- **HDR 게임 녹화의 밴딩:** 화면을 10비트로 받아 변환해, 하늘이나 어두운 그라데이션에 생기던 계단 무늬가 줄었습니다.
  - 기기에서 10비트 녹화를 시작하지 못하면 8비트로 녹화하면서 디밴딩으로 계단 무늬를 줄입니다.
  - 이때 패널에 안내와 **10비트 다시 시도** 버튼이 나오며, 누르면 플러그인을 다시 시작하지 않아도 다음 HDR 녹화에서 10비트를 다시 시도합니다.

gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.name: Screen Recorder v0.10.2
gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.body:
## 개선

- **녹화 중 설정 설명:** 녹화하는 동안 캡처 방식, 화질, 프레임 레이트 같은 드롭다운 설정의 설명 줄도 다른 설정처럼 어둡게 표시됩니다.
- **최근 녹화:** 누르면 그 녹화를 바로 재생합니다. 저장 위치에 녹화가 있으면 플러그인을 다시 시작한 뒤에도 가장 최근 녹화가 항상 보입니다.
- **창을 닫은 뒤 위치 유지:** 드롭다운이나 창을 닫으면 패널이 맨 위로 튀지 않고 보던 위치 그대로 열린 항목으로 포커스가 바로 돌아옵니다.

## 수정

- **중복 입력에 의한 오동작 차단:**
  - 드롭다운이나 창을 B 버튼으로 닫을 때 Decky 플러그인 목록으로 돌아가던 문제
  - 드롭다운이나 창을 A 버튼으로 열자마자 첫 항목이 눌려 메뉴가 바로 닫히거나 재생이 멈추던 문제

gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.name: Screen Recorder v0.10.1
gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.body:
이번 업데이트는 UI 사용성을 개선합니다.

## 개선

- **녹화 중 아이콘 표시:** 녹화하는 동안 Decky 플러그인 목록의 Screen Recorder 아이콘이 빨간색으로 바뀝니다.
- **녹화 중 상단 고정:** 녹화하는 동안 녹화 카드와 **중지하고 저장** 버튼이 패널 맨 위에 고정되어, 설정을 내려 봐도 경과 시간을 보고 바로 녹화를 끝낼 수 있습니다.
- **패널 스크롤:** 패널을 위아래로 움직일 때 부드럽게 스크롤하고, 녹화 버튼으로 돌아오면 녹화 카드가 보이도록 맨 위로 올라갑니다.
- **재생 화면:** 전체 화면으로 바꾸거나 L1/R1로 이전/다음 녹화로 넘길 때 화면이 깜빡이지 않습니다. 포커스 테두리가 영상과 어긋나던 문제도 고쳤습니다.

gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.name: Screen Recorder v0.10.0
gomburger/decky-screen-recorder.body:
## 새로운 기능

- **녹화 목록:** 저장 위치 아래 **녹화 목록** 버튼으로 저장된 녹화를 썸네일과 재생 시간이 있는 앨범 형식으로 볼 수 있습니다. 썸네일은 목록을 열 때 만들어 두고 다음부터는 바로 보여 줍니다.
  - **재생:** 목록에서 녹화를 고르면 Steam 화면 위에서 바로 재생합니다. A로 재생하거나 멈추고, 좌우로 5초씩 이동하며, L1/R1로 이전/다음 녹화로 넘어갑니다. Y를 누르면 전체 화면으로 볼 수 있습니다.
  - **삭제:** 목록이나 재생 화면에서 X 또는 **삭제** 버튼으로 녹화를 지울 수 있습니다. 지우기 전에 확인을 묻습니다.

jmac1990cn/decky-nutstore.name: Decky Nutstore v1.2.0
jmac1990cn/decky-nutstore.body:
## Decky Nutstore v1.2.0 正式版

基于坚果云（Nutstore）WebDAV 的 Steam Deck 存档同步插件，国内无需 VPN 即可稳定使用。

### 同步路径入口
- **手动添加**：直接选择文件 / 文件夹 / 文件夹（排除子文件夹）。
- **打开游戏文件夹**：仿 protontricks 列出 compatdata 下各游戏的 Proton 前缀（含非 Steam 游戏名解析）。点选游戏后可：
  - **自选文件夹**：逐级浏览并挑选具体存档目录/文件后确认加入同步。
  - **存档探测**：仿游戏管家按游戏名列出可能的存档文件夹；只在该游戏的 pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/ 内查找，过滤 Windows 系统目录与 Public 用户，嵌套父目录去重只保留最匹配项，空文件夹折叠显示。路径完整展示，可继续下钻。

### 功能
- 游戏启动/退出自动同步（启动下载、退出上传）、游戏关闭后自动备份。
- 包含/排除规则高级过滤、可选云端子目录、文件数预估。
- 插件面板内查看同步日志，支持手柄方向键导航与聚焦高亮。

安装：从本 release 下载 decky-nutstore.zip，在 Decky 中导入安装。

palharesf/decky-hltb-sync.name: HLTB Sync for Deck 0.3.17 — Public beta
palharesf/decky-hltb-sync.body:
# HLTB Sync for Deck 0.3.17 — Public beta

Track Steam Deck sessions and sync playtime to your HLTB account after closing
a game. Runs entirely on the Deck after installation, with Steam's browser for
login and a persistent local session queue. This is a beta, not a stable release.

## New in 0.3.17

- Added **Account + > GitHub** for stars, issues and contributions.
- Added portfolio, Ko-fi and Steam wishlist links to the README.
- Verified on the Deck: the repository opens, B returns to Steam, and HLTB
  remains Connected with sessions and mappings preserved.
- Session counting and synchronization behavior are unchanged from 0.3.16.

## Included

- Automatic high-confidence matching against existing HLTB records and catalog
  identities; direct emulator shortcuts can provide platform hints.
- Session deltas for existing records, Steam lifetime once for new Steam records,
  and explicit one-time history import.
- Suspension exclusion, offline persistence and recovery after login loss.
- Preservation of notes, ratings, lists and completion fields; no automatic
  completion. Durable write intents and reconciliation of uncertain responses.
- Browser return after login, compact Decky UI and direct recovery dialogs with
  horizontal controller navigation. Explicit recovered-time sync or confirmed
  discard, with discarded segments excluded from later updates.

## Validation

All 124 automated tests (87 Python, 37 JavaScript), typecheck and build passed.
The previous beta's hardware tests covered Steam games, Vexx/PS2 via a direct shortcut, automatic
association/sync, suspension, offline recovery, login return, reboot recovery
and checkpoint discard. The final Vexx session added 31m44s in one verified
operation; a fresh HLTB read confirmed the result, with other fields unchanged
and discarded time excluded. See [validation evidence](https://github.com/palharesf/decky-hltb-sync/blob/v0.3.17/docs/validation.md).

## Known limitations

- Forcibly killing the backend made Decky unresponsive in testing. A device
  restart was required; the persisted checkpoint survived.
- Sending recovered checkpoint time is tested locally only; the discard branch
  passed on hardware. Unrecorded time after an interruption cannot be recovered
  automatically.
- HLTB endpoints and Steam internals are unofficial and may change. Explicit
  logout/relogin passed; natural session expiration was not separately tested.
- Ambiguous matches may require manual review. Remapping and multiple shortcuts
  sharing one HLTB submission are not implemented.
- Steam and the direct Vexx/PS2 shortcut were tested. Broad Epic/GOG and emulator
  compatibility is unverified. ES-DE sessions do not identify individual games.
- Other applications can overwrite the HLTB total later. Multi-device convergence
  and exactly-once delivery are not guaranteed; uncertain writes require
  reconciliation, not blind retries.
- Full Playnite feature parity is not claimed; metadata editing stays on HLTB.

## Install

Install the attached **hltb-sync-for-deck-0.3.17.zip** through Decky's
**Settings > Developer > Install Plugin from URL** or **Install Plugin from ZIP
File**. Close games first. Do not install the automatically generated source
archives. A matching SHA256 checksum is attached.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/palharesf/decky-hltb-sync/blob/v0.3.17/docs/installation.md).
Existing settings and sessions are retained during an update. Catalog submission
and approval have not taken place; this is a manually installed GitHub beta.

Inspired by Lacro59's [HowLongToBeat for Playnite](https://github.com/Lacro59/playnite-howlongtobeat-plugin).
Our implementation is MIT licensed; the original Decky template license and
community acknowledgments are preserved in the repository and package.

tmghd272/decky-non-steam-matcher.name: Non-Steam Matcher — Initial Release
tmghd272/decky-non-steam-matcher.body:
## Initial Release

Decky Loader plugin that scans your non-Steam shortcuts and matches them to proper official names — PC games, ROMs/emulators, and common desktop software — using Steam's own store search, Steam's full app catalog (catches delisted titles), and SteamGridDB as a fallback. No local hardcoded name database.

### Features
- Scans all non-Steam shortcuts in `shortcuts.vdf`
- Matches against three sources in priority order: Steam Store → Steam catalog (incl. delisted games) → SteamGridDB
- Review proposed renames before applying — nothing changes automatically
- Always backs up `shortcuts.vdf` before writing

### Optional, for better match coverage
- Free [[Steam Web API key](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey)](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey)
- Free [[SteamGridDB API key](https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api)](https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api)

### Known limitations
- Very ambiguous shortcut names may not resolve — intentional, the plugin won't guess when unsure
- First scan is slower (one-time catalog download, cached after)

---

### Installing (Developer Mode → Install from ZIP)

1. Download the zip from this release
2. Quick Access menu → gear icon → **General** → enable **Developer Mode**
3. **Developer** tab → **Install Plugin from ZIP** → select the zip
4. Reload plugins if it doesn't appear right away
5. Open the plugin, optionally add API keys (Test Key before saving), hit **Scan**

tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.name: v0.7.0
tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.body:
Adds a switch between the controller's XInput and DInput modes, to find out whether the rumble loss depends on the mode. The panel shows the current mode and a button for the other one; the pad stays hidden from Steam while it reconnects.

In DInput mode buttons and sticks work, but games cannot rumble on SteamOS: the DInput device has no force feedback in the kernel and InputPlumber has no other rumble path for it.

Findings from the first capture taken while rumble was lost (Claw A8, controller firmware 3.13): the rumble packet still reaches the controller and is acknowledged, 4 KB of MCU memory and the EC registers are identical to the working state, and neither a USB port reset, rewriting the intensity, re-sending the same mode nor cycling the EC standby flag brings rumble back. A real mode switch (XInput to DInput and back) does, as does the MCU reset. The fault is runtime state inside the controller firmware; what triggers it is still unknown.

tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.name: v0.6.0
tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.body:
Reduces the plugin to a single **Fix rumble** button. It records the controller state while rumble is still broken, resets the controller MCU, records the state again and ends with a short pulse. The records (USB traffic of a rumble pulse, MCU profile RAM, EC RAM, filtered logs) go to `~/claw-rumble-captures/<timestamp>/` and are what is needed to find the actual cause, which is still unknown.

While the controller reconnects after the reset, the physical pad is kept hidden with two temporary udev rules, so Steam does not list it as an extra Xbox 360 controller.

Everything else is removed: wake-up handling, the activity trace, the manual recovery ladder, intensity and gamepad mode settings, the USB quirk toggle and the diagnostics report.

The MCU profile read now takes the replies from usbmon; with hid-msi bound they do not arrive on hidraw. Tested on a Claw A8 (SteamOS 3.9.5, kernel 7.2.7-valve2, controller firmware 3.13), including a real MCU reset. Whether Steam still shows an…

tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.name: v0.5.1
tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.body: Adds an optional short buzz after every wake-up, so a missing buzz dates the rumble loss to that sleep, and keeps the activity timeline in the plugin log across restarts. Includes everything from v0.5.0 (udev override removed, profile memory captured around an MCU reset). The profile read is still untested on real hardware.

tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.name: v0.5.0
tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.body: Removes the udev override (verified active on the test device, it changed nothing). The kernel's unexpected-ACK messages after every wake-up match the HueSync plugin's raw RGB commands; whether those break rumble is unproven. 'Fix rumble now' now records what the MCU reset changes in the controller's profile memory. The profile read has not been run on real hardware yet.

tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.name: v0.4.1
tinghaishijie/claw-rumble-fix.body: Adds 'Who writes to the controller': every write to the controller's settings is attributed to a process, and the diagnostics report gets a timeline of writes, udev events and kernel messages. The udev override now covers any rule file that writes hid-msi settings and reports when it is not active. The prevention switch did not stop the flash commits on the test device; this release is meant to find out why.

qiming-liu/decky-game-cheats-manager.name: DeckyGCM v1.0.5
qiming-liu/decky-game-cheats-manager.body:
## What's new in 1.0.5

Compared with 1.0.4, this release makes Cheat Engine work on ARM devices and with 32-bit games, explains why trainers and table entries fail, and moves updates to GitHub.

### Cheat Engine on ARM devices and 32-bit games

- On ARM devices, 64-bit Cheat Engine starts paused and gets a small compatibility fix before it runs, so it no longer crashes or misbehaves under ARM Wine.
- After attaching to a 32-bit game, 64-bit Cheat Engine hands over to 32-bit Cheat Engine with the same table. Under Proton, the 64-bit one cannot see a 32-bit game's modules, so every "Game.exe+offset" address and module scan failed.
- Cheat Engine and table paths are passed on by the launcher, which fixes garbled Chinese paths and a hang when switching on ARM devices.
- Cheat Engine attaches to the game's real process instead of a launcher or sign-in window: it looks first for the process you last picked by hand for that game, then for the program the table names, and waits for it to start.

### Cheat Tables

- Syncing with Cheat Engine leaves it time to breathe, so its dialogs no longer stop responding to clicks, touch and keys with large tables.
- Errors from a table's own Lua scripts, which only showed in Cheat Engine's window behind the game, now show in the Quick Access panel with the full message.
- When an entry cannot be switched on, the panel says why: not attached, the game has ended, a script error, a value that cannot be written, or Cheat Engine's own reason (code pattern not found, code differs, injection failed, …). Failed entries can be retried.
- Opening a table checks the game's files for each entry's code pattern and marks the entries it cannot find, a hint that the table may not fit this game version.
- Local tables that run code are confirmed once per file name, in the Quick Access panel where the game cannot hide the dialog. Downloaded tables need no confirmation.
- Each game start clears Cheat Engine commands and state left from the last session, so a new Cheat Engine no longer attaches to an old process.
- Dropdowns no longer close while the panel refreshes, the process name shows when a table's script attached by itself, and a Cheat Engine download started from a table shows its progress there.

### Trainers

- When a trainer fails, the plugin says what happened instead of nothing: whether its window opened, the text of any error box it showed, and how it exited. This shows in the Quick Access panel while the game runs and on the game page.
- A trainer that has to start before the game gets the time it needs: the game waits until the trainer's window is up.
- A message box a trainer opens later no longer hides behind the trainer and makes it look frozen. It is brought to the front, and the trainer comes back once it is answered.
- The game page points out setups trainers often fail on: a .NET game running on Wine Mono, a 32-bit game that may need `PROTON_USE_WOW64=1`, and Proton versions whose Wine Mono breaks .NET trainers.
- New downloads are stored per game: one folder per game, named after the game and its app ID, with one folder per trainer inside. Trainers already installed stay where they are.
- Pressing download again right after a download finished no longer downloads a second copy.
- When another tool rewrites the trainer launch option, the game page says so and offers to take it back or clear it, leaving other launch options alone.

### Bug reports

- A new setting turns on Proton's log for trainer launches, and the exported log then includes the end of the newest Proton logs. It is off by default, and turning it off only removes a `PROTON_LOG` the plugin added itself.

### Interface and updates

- Updates and downloads now come from GitHub, checked once a day. The About page, the feedback link and the project links point to the GitHub repository, and the About page opens the README in your language.
- The Chinese interface uses more formal wording.

--------

## 1.0.5 更新说明

相比 1.0.4，本版让 Cheat Engine 能在 ARM 设备和 32 位游戏上使用，会说明修改器和表条目失败的原因，并把更新改到 GitHub。

### Cheat Engine：ARM 设备与 32 位游戏

- 在 ARM 设备上，64 位 Cheat Engine 会先暂停启动，注入一个兼容组件后再运行，不再在 ARM 版 Wine 下崩溃或行为异常。
- 附加到 32 位游戏后，64 位 Cheat Engine 会改为启动 32 位 Cheat Engine 并打开同一张表。在 Proton 下，64 位 Cheat Engine 读不到 32 位游戏的模块，导致「游戏.exe+偏移」类地址和按模块搜索特征码的条目全部失效。
- Cheat Engine 和表的路径改由启动器传递，解决中文路径乱码，以及在 ARM 设备上切换时卡死的问题。
- Cheat Engine 会附加到游戏的真实进程，而不是启动器或登录窗口：优先查找你上次为该游戏手动选择的进程，其次是表中指定的程序，并等待它启动。

### Cheat Table

- 与 Cheat Engine 的同步会留出空闲时间，表较大时 Cheat Engine 的对话框不再对点击、触摸和按键无响应。
- 表自带 Lua 脚本的报错原本只显示在被游戏遮住的 Cheat Engine 窗口里，现在会显示在快捷访问菜单中，可查看完整报错。
- 条目无法开启时，面板会说明原因：未附加、游戏进程已结束、脚本出错、无法写入数值，或 Cheat Engine 给出的原因（找不到特征码、代码不一致、注入失败等）。失败的条目可以重试。
- 打开表时会在游戏文件中查找条目的特征码，找不到的条目会被标出，提示该表可能不适配当前游戏版本。
- 可执行代码的本地表按文件名确认一次，确认窗口在快捷访问菜单中打开，不会被游戏挡住。下载的表不需要确认。
- 每次启动游戏时会清除上一局遗留的 Cheat Engine 指令和状态，新开的 Cheat Engine 不再附加到旧进程。
- 面板刷新时下拉菜单不再自动关闭；表的脚本自行附加进程时也能显示进程名；从表发起的 Cheat Engine 下载会在原处显示进度。

### 修改器

- 修改器失败时会说明原因，不再毫无反应：是否打开了窗口、弹出的错误框内容，以及退出情况。游戏运行时显示在快捷访问菜单中，也显示在游戏页上。
- 需要先于游戏启动的修改器会得到足够时间：游戏会等修改器窗口出现后再启动。
- 修改器之后弹出的对话框不再藏在修改器窗口后面、让修改器看起来像卡死了。对话框会被提到前面，回答后修改器恢复正常。
- 游戏页会提示修改器常出问题的情况：在 Wine Mono 上运行的 .NET 游戏、可能需要 `PROTON_USE_WOW64=1` 的 32 位游戏，以及 Wine Mono 会让 .NET 修改器失效的 Proton 版本。
- 新下载的修改器按游戏存放：每个游戏一个文件夹（以游戏名和 App ID 命名），每个修改器在其中占一个子文件夹。已安装的修改器位置不变。
- 下载刚完成时再次点击下载，不会再下载第二份。
- 修改器启动选项被其他工具改写时，游戏页会提示，并可一键接管或清除，其他启动选项保持不变。

### 问题反馈

- 新增设置，可为修改器启动开启 Proton 日志，开启后导出的日志会附上最新 Proton 日志的末尾部分。默认关闭，关闭时插件只会移除它自己添加的 `PROTON_LOG`。

### 界面与更新

- 更新和下载改为来自 GitHub，每天检查一次。“关于”页、反馈链接和项目链接都指向 GitHub 仓库，“关于”页会按界面语言打开对应的 README。
- 中文界面用词改为更正式的表述。

## Skip Launcher v0.2.3

Decky Loader plugin that starts games straight into the game, skipping their Windows launcher window, and moves that window's settings into the plugin so a controller can reach them.

- A supported game, see the [README](https://github.com/evertonfxavier/skip-launcher#supported-games)

qiming-liu/deckydsh.name: DeckyDSH v1.0.1
qiming-liu/deckydsh.body:
## What's new in 1.0.1

Compared with 1.0.0, this release makes setup quicker on a handheld and turns DeckyDSH into a voice-only chat.

### Setup

- The API key comes first, and you no longer have to type it: scan the QR code with a phone on the same Wi-Fi and paste the key on the page that opens. It goes straight to your device, never through a server. Typing it still works.
- Speech recognition is now a setup step, so the chat is ready to talk as soon as setup ends.
- Setup can be opened again from Settings, and once everything is done you can jump to any step from the list on the left.

### Chat

- Voice is now the only input; the text box and the **Show text input** setting are gone.
- While you talk, a red bar shows a live waveform of your voice. **X** sends what you said straight away, **Y** or ✕ throws it away.
- What you said appears in the chat at once. dsh is started in the background when the panel opens, so the model is shown before you speak and sending doesn't wait.
- If there is no chat, a new one opens by itself.
- Messages like "Didn't catch that" pop up briefly above the talk button instead of landing in the chat.
- Deleting and renaming chats work again; their confirmations now appear inside the panel.

### Settings

- Settings are simpler: the API key, speech recognition and runtime rows are replaced by one **First-time setup** button.
- Uninstalling the plugin now deletes the downloaded runtime and speech model, but keeps your API key. Updating or reinstalling keeps everything.

--------

## 1.0.1 更新说明

相比 1.0.0，本版让在掌机上设置更省事，并改成只用语音对话。

### 安装

- API Key 改成第一步，而且不用再手打：用连着同一个 Wi-Fi 的手机扫二维码，在打开的页面里粘贴 Key，就会直接发到掌机上，不经过任何服务器。也还能直接输入。
- 语音识别成了设置的一步，设置一完成就能直接说话。
- 可以从设置里重新打开初次设置；全部设置好后，可以点左边的步骤列表随时跳到任意一步。

### 对话

- 现在只用语音输入，去掉了文字输入框和 **显示文字输入框** 设置。
- 说话时会出现一条红色横条，上面是实时的声音波形。按 **X** 直接发送，按 **Y** 或点 ✕ 丢掉这段录音。
- 你说的话会马上出现在对话里。打开侧边栏时 dsh 就会在后台启动，说话前就能看到模型名，发送也不用等。
- 没有对话时会自动新开一个。
- 「没听清」这类提示改成在说话按钮上方短暂弹出，不再写进对话。
- 删除和重命名对话恢复正常，确认框现在直接显示在面板里。

### 设置

- 设置页更简洁：API Key、语音识别和运行时几项合并成一个 **初次设置** 按钮。
- 卸载插件时会删掉下载的运行时和语音模型，但保留你的 API Key；更新或重新安装则全部保留。

This is the first release of DeckyDSH: the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent in the Steam Quick Access menu, used by voice with the controller.

### Setup

- A first-time setup page downloads the official dsh runtime into the plugin's data folder, checks your DeepSeek API key and asks how commands are approved. No sudo and no Desktop Mode, and your own `~/.dsh` is left alone.

Security and reliability update from a full audit (24 findings fixed, regression tests added).

mrkingjaydee/custom-loader-shuffle.name: Custom Loader Shuffle v1.0.0
mrkingjaydee/custom-loader-shuffle.body:
**Custom Loader Shuffle v1.0.0**

The first public release of Custom Loader Shuffle, a Decky companion plugin for CSS Loader's Custom Loader theme.

Automatically change your custom GIF loading animations every time you launch a game.

**Features**
- Sequential and random shuffle modes.
- One GIF per game launch.
- No consecutive repeats in random mode.
- Automatic detection of added and removed GIFs.
- Enable or disable automatic shuffling.
- Manual GIF switching.
- Persistent settings across restarts.
- Controller-friendly interface.
- Filesystem security and game-launch safeguards.

**Requirements**
1. Decky Loader
2. CSS Loader
3. Custom Loader theme

Tested with CSS Loader v2.1.2 and Custom Loader v1.3.2.

**Installation**
1. Download the installable plugin ZIP below.
2. Enable Developer Mode in Decky settings.
3. Install the ZIP using the developer installation option.
4. Ensure the Custom Loader theme from CSS Loader is installed and enabled.
5. Add your preferred GIFs to /home/deck/homebrew/themes/Custom Loader/images/Add Your GIFs Here/.
6. Enable automatic shuffle and enjoy!

**Notes**
- GIFs change between game launches, not during loading.
- Sequential order may reset after a restart.
- No GIFs are bundled with this plugin.
- Compatibility with other CSS Loader versions has not yet been verified.

Developed and maintained by **MrKingJayDee**.

Free and open source under the MIT License.

lumen-tools/deck-surround-rooms.name: Version 2.3.0
lumen-tools/deck-surround-rooms.body:
Versioned release

## What's new

- **Mixer only changes the game, not Steam:** Raising the mixer used to make Steam's interface sounds louder too. The mixer now changes only the audio of the apps. With a per-game profile, only the running game is changed. It is recognised by its Steam app ID, also when it runs under Proton.
- **New Master slider:** Moves all channel sliders together, so a quiet game can be made louder with one slider. The balance between the channels stays the same.
- Levels above 100 % are still held below clipping by the limiter.
- Volumes are reset when the mixer no longer applies, for example when surround is switched off or the game ends.

Update as usual. Your settings are kept.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lumen-tools/Deck-Surround-Rooms/compare/2.2.1...2.3.0

lumen-tools/deck-surround-rooms.name: Version 2.2.1
lumen-tools/deck-surround-rooms.body:
Versioned release

## What's new

- **Audio is 3 dB louder:** The headroom of the surround mix was reduced from 6 dB to 3 dB. 6 dB made surround too quiet on less sensitive headphones, even at full volume.
- Stereo games still stay below the limiter, even at full level.
- Loud surround mixes (explosions, gunfire, bass on all channels) are still held at -1 dBFS by the limiter, so nothing clips.

Update as usual. Your settings are kept, and the audio service restarts on its own.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lumen-tools/Deck-Surround-Rooms/compare/2.2.0...2.2.1

lumen-tools/deck-surround-rooms.name: Version 2.2.0
lumen-tools/deck-surround-rooms.body:
## What's new

- **No more clipping in surround:** In loud moments (explosions, gunfire, bass on several channels), the binaural mix could go far above 0 dBFS and clip hard, which sounded like crackling or distortion. The surround mix now leaves 6 dB of headroom and ends with a limiter (Fast Lookahead Limiter from the swh LADSPA plugins, GPL-2.0) that holds the output at -1 dBFS.
- Surround is about 6 dB quieter than before. Turn the volume up a little if needed.
- The limiter adds 5 ms of latency and uses very little CPU. Audio below the limit is not changed.
- The headphone EQ without surround is unchanged.

Update as usual. Your settings are kept, and the audio service restarts on its own.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lumen-tools/Deck-Surround-Rooms/compare/2.1.0...2.2.0

naustudentx18/deckforge-input-studio.name: DeckForge Input Studio v0.2.0
naustudentx18/deckforge-input-studio.body:
# DeckForge Input Studio v0.2.0

First release that actually **runs on a Steam Deck**. v0.1.0 built and passed its
tests but could not have worked on hardware — every blocker below was found by
probing the machine, and each one is fatal on its own.

## Upgrading from v0.1.0

Replace the plugin folder. **Back up `~/.config/deckforge/` first** if you made
profiles with 0.1.0 — the template format changed and old vault entries are not
guaranteed to load.

The downloaded zip is now **12 MB**, not 359 KB. That is the vendored Python
dependencies the plugin needs; the old zip shipped none of them and could never
have started on a Deck.

---

## Why 0.1.0 could not run

| Blocker | Evidence | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Decky's interpreter is a **frozen CPython 3.14** that cannot see pip packages | probe plugin: `fastapi`, `uvicorn`, `pyudev`, `mido`, `pydantic` all `ModuleNotFoundError` | vendored cp314/x86_64 wheels in `py_modules/lib` (glibc floor 2.17, Deck has 2.43) |
| Decky adds only `<plugin>/py_modules` to `sys.path` | `decky_loader/plugin/sandboxed_plugin.py:91` | import top-level `deckforge.*`, never `py_modules.deckforge.*` |
| The `root` flag sets `HOME=/root` | probe: `home=/root` | flag removed — nothing needed it, and it broke every Steam path |
| The frozen stdlib **lacks `logging.config`** | uvicorn died at import | `deckforge/compat.py` loads the real 3.14 module |

## Steam integration was writing to nowhere

- Templates went to `userdata/<id>/config/controller_configs/templates/` and
  `userdata/<id>/241100/remote/` — **neither exists** on SteamOS 20261023.100.
  Steam reads `controller_base/templates/`.
- The VDF emitter hand-rolled a `controller_mappings` body that is not Steam's
  schema. Steam's format is group-based; analog output is a **group setting**
  (`output_joystick`), not an `xinput_axis` binding — which appears in none of
  the 77 shipped templates. The compiler now **patches Valve's own skeleton**, so
  Steam always receives a structurally valid file, and controls it cannot express
  are reported rather than dropped.
- Game assignment embedded the whole config. Steam stores only
  `{"template": "<file>.vdf"}` and loads it by name.

## New: smart auto-profiler

One press identifies connected hardware and builds a matching profile.

It does not trust the mainstream databases, because they are wrong here:

- SDL classifies `20bc:5500` — the id a CRKD-labelled unit actually reported — as
  a **PS3 controller**.
- SDL's `gamecontrollerdb.txt` contains **zero** rhythm-guitar entries.

Identity is therefore layered: capability fingerprint (measured from evdev) →
vendored identity table (613 controllers) → name heuristics.

Three false positives were found and gated, each against a real device's evdev map:

- A laptop keyboard read as a guitar — media keys emit `BTN_C`/`BTN_Z`/`BTN_THUMB`,
  the same codes as a solo-fret strip.
- A mouse read as a macropad — `REL_*` axes now mark a pointing device.
- A **wireless receiver with the guitar switched off** read as a guitar at 95% and
  produced a silently wrong profile (strum on dpad buttons instead of the measured
  hat axis, nothing reported as skipped). Now refused with *"is the controller
  switched on?"*.

Steam's own virtual pads (`0x28DE`, virtual bus) are reserved and never remapped.

## New: six one-click profiles

Clone Hero, YARG, Fortnite Festival, Rock Band 4, Guitar Hero III, and KeyJam.
Each carries the **Mode Dial position it requires**, because for some games the
bindings are meaningless without it — Festival mode 1 maps CTRL to Select, which
opens a menu and cannot be rebound in-game. Rock Band 4 is flagged as needing the
Xbox-licensed model, since the multi-platform guitar is not seen by RB4 as a guitar.

## New: mobile-first PWA

- Manifest, service worker, icons. The shell is cached; **the API never is** —
  every value is live hardware state, and a stale device list is worse than an
  honest failure.
- Phone layout: bottom bar plus a "More" sheet, binding editor as a bottom sheet,
  safe-area insets, 44 px targets, 16 px inputs (iOS zooms anything smaller).
- Desktop keeps the 1280×800 Deck framing.

## UI rebuilt on a real design system

The old UI had **110 distinct hard-coded hex colours** across ~2,000 lines of
inline styles and no tokens, so two panels could both be "surface" and be four
different colours. Now: `tokens.css` (palette, spacing, radii, fluid type,
elevation, motion honouring `prefers-reduced-motion`), `base.css` primitives, and
mobile-first rules throughout. Emoji used as icons (13 of them) replaced with a
hand-written SVG set, per UI/UX Pro Max guidance.

## Fixed

- API client derived its port from nothing; now derives it from the page origin,
  so the studio works when served on any port.
- Blueprints were pinned to fixed pixel sizes (420×740 guitar) and overflowed the
  panel on both Deck and phone. They now size from their `viewBox` and fit at
  every width — measured for all nine.
- `firewalld` blocked `:8765` on the LAN while allowing the tailnet, so phone
  pairing failed only over Wi-Fi. Port opened.

## Known limits

- **Whammy cannot be an analog axis** in Steam Input. Analog output is group-level;
  there is no axis binding string.
- **`BTN_MODE` (guide) and `BTN_BASE`** have no writable slot — Steam owns them.
  Reported as unsupported, never silently dropped.
- The `20bc:5500` id is the **ShanWan bridge chip's**, not CRKD's (`0351`/`3651`).
  It is accepted for detection, but which Mode Dial position was active during
  capture was never recorded, so it is not evidence of a dial position.
- Verified with 128 backend tests, a clean `tsc`, and end-to-end runs against a
  live Steam install. **Not yet verified on physical hardware** — the Deck was
  offline while this was built.

## Install

```bash
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NaustudentX18/deckforge-input-studio/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or install the attached zip via Decky Loader → Developer → Install from zip.
Then plug the guitar in, set the Platform Slider to **PC** and the Mode Dial to
**1**, and press ⚡ Auto-Profile. Wired or the 2.4 GHz dongle both work.

Full details: [`LAUNCH.md`](https://github.com/NaustudentX18/deckforge-input-studio/blob/main/LAUNCH.md) ·
[`HANDOVER.md`](https://github.com/NaustudentX18/deckforge-input-studio/blob/main/HANDOVER.md)

venglov/hexdeck.name: HexDeck 0.3.0
venglov/hexdeck.body:
## What's new

### A short Quick Access panel
The panel now just shows you what's going on and lets you change a few things mid-game:
- A **status card** says what dictation is doing, what to press, the last text, and gives the one button that fixes whatever is in the way.
- Then Dictation, Model (downloaded ones only), Language, Insert text by, Press Enter after, Try it and Paste again.
- It's about 630 px tall with 7 focus stops, down from 2,082 px and 27 with the model list open.

### Full-screen settings page
Everything else lives on its own page (route `/hexdeck`, L1/R1 switches tabs):
- **Models:** "I speak" picks the language, and Hex's picks for it come first as cards with Hex's badges (*Recommended*, *Fastest*, *Fewest wrong words*, *Reads your vocabulary*). After them come the other models that understand that language; the rest are folded away. Each model shows Hex's one-line description and *wait · languages · size*. A uses or downloads, X deletes (after you confirm), Y opens details with every language the model understands. The language goes to models that take one.
- **Controls:** back-grip binding presets, recorded bindings, a live "held right now" readout, trigger, minimum hold, and Hex's keyboard shortcut.
- **Text:** paste or type, Enter (now after a paste too), Paste again, and Hex's vocabulary.
- **Audio and feedback:** Hex's microphone and game-audio settings (shown when the running Hex lists their choices), sounds, notifications, and the recording pill.
- **Help:** status, Restart Hex, game display, versions, memory, logs.

natiiia/betterdeckui.name: BetterDeckUI 1.0.0 正式版
natiiia/betterdeckui.body:
BetterDeckUI 首个正式版本，已完成初步验收，并安装到两台设备验证。

## 下载与安装

下载本页附件 **BetterDeckUI-1.0.0.zip**，通过 Decky 的本地压缩包安装入口安装。页面自动提供的源码压缩包不作为插件安装包。

更新现有 BetterDeckUI 会保留原有设置。

## 本版功能

- 主页已安装游戏筛选、三项标签隐藏及返回控制。
- 个人游戏、家庭库、已安装、收藏、非 STEAM 五类精简游戏库标签。
- 自适应单屏详情与延伸至半透明操作栏底部的背景。
- 最后运行日期、游戏时间、成就三行整合栏，整块可进入原生成就页。
- 独立游戏信息页，整合 SteamOS 兼容性入口及原生详情弹窗。
- 手柄初始焦点、左右顺序、跨行及上下导航调整。
- 原生云状态快捷按钮与居中图标。
- 启动提示期间暂时隐藏操作行，单屏详情隐藏底栏细分隔线。
- 活动、社区和顶部搜索的显示控制。
- 主页路由刷新及下载任务状态订阅，移除固定间隔轮询。

共 13 项中文开关。首次安装默认开启主页已安装筛选及新情报速递、好友、推荐隐藏，其余功能需要按需开启。

## 实机截图

截图来自 2026 年 10 月 21 日的实机验证，展示启用相关功能后的效果；游戏原生介绍和图片内容随游戏而不同。

### 原生兼容性详情弹窗

![原生兼容性详情弹窗](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Natiiia/BetterDeckUI/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/%E5%85%BC%E5%AE%B9%E6%80%A7%E8%AF%A6%E6%83%85.png)

## 验证与文件校验

ken5998/armada-ports.name: Armada Ports 0.4.0
ken5998/armada-ports.body:
## What's new

- **FH1 ReImagined and inFAMOUS Reborn are in the app.** Install, update and play both from Game Mode, no more trips to Desktop Mode to update them.
- **FH1 ReImagined** asks for Title Update 4 after the disc image (found for you like the disc, or build without it). Update keeps the disc and update the last build used, and follows the repository's main, so new patches (the native renderer, for instance) arrive without waiting for a launcher release. DLC and car packs still install from its launcher.
- **inFAMOUS Reborn** has no launcher: the app runs its build itself and offers **Update** whenever main has new patches, showing the commit it would update to. An install built by hand from a clone of the repository is found as it is, and that clone is kept so an update only recompiles what changed.

## Getting it on the RP6

Quick Access menu, Decky, Armada Ports, **Check for updates**, then **Update Armada Ports to 0.4.0**. Open the app again: the two new covers are after Skate 3 Recomp. If you already built them, they show up as installed.

First time: in Desktop Mode put `ArmadaPorts-v0.4.0.zip` and `install.sh` in one folder and run `bash install.sh` there.

ken5998/armada-ports.name: Armada Ports 0.3.0
ken5998/armada-ports.body:
## What's new

- **Armada Ports is now an app.** It sits in your Steam library like a game and is made for the controller: the ports as a row of covers with their SteamGridDB artwork, a page for each one with what it is, how it runs on the RP6, what it needs, how long the build takes and what the newest release changed, and the buttons to install, update, play, add to Steam or uninstall it.
- **Play from the app.** The game starts in the app's place and you come back to its page when you quit. A game that is also in your library keeps the Turnip driver and performance profile you gave it in Armada Control.
- **Disc images found for you.** Install lists the images in your home folder, Downloads, Games and on the SD card; a folder browser covers the rest. Everything works with the touchscreen too.
- **Two new ports to install:** FH2 Recompiled and Skate 3 Recomp.
- **The Quick Access panel is now small.** It opens the app, shows running builds and new releases, and updates Armada Ports.…

ken5998/armada-ports.name: Armada Ports 0.2.2
ken5998/armada-ports.body:
## What's new

- **Check for updates** no longer runs into GitHub's limit of 60 requests an hour. The plugin keeps GitHub's last answer for each port and only asks whether it changed, which GitHub does not count; once the limit is reached anyway, the panel goes on with the last known releases instead of an error.

## Putting it on the handheld

From 0.2.x: open Armada Ports, press **Check for updates**, then **Update Armada Ports to 0.2.2** at the bottom of the panel. If 0.2.1 still shows the rate-limit error, wait for it to clear (at most an hour) or install from Desktop Mode: `bash install.sh` next to `ArmadaPorts-v0.2.2.zip`.

ken5998/armada-ports.name: Armada Ports 0.2.1
ken5998/armada-ports.body:
## What's new

- **Midtown Madness 3**: a build that stopped half way (a reboot, a crash, Stop) now shows as unfinished, with **Finish the build** to pick it up from the game files already copied. Before, the old game binary made the panel take it for a finished install, with no way to resume from the plugin.
- While a build runs, the plugin asks the system not to sleep or shut down, so a build of an hour is not cut off by the screen going to sleep. A reboot started by Steam's own update may still go ahead: turn off automatic restarts for Steam updates while you build.

## Putting it on the handheld

From 0.2.0: open Armada Ports, press **Check for updates**, then **Update Armada Ports to 0.2.1** at the bottom of the panel. A fresh install: `bash install.sh` next to `ArmadaPorts-v0.2.1.zip` in Desktop Mode.

ken5998/armada-ports.name: Armada Ports 0.2.0
ken5998/armada-ports.body:
## What's new

- **Midtown Madness 3**, **Saints Reborn** and **Rusty MCLA** now install, update and go into Steam from the panel, like Pinyon Shift and FIFA Street. Installs made with their launchers are found as they are, so the panel shows which version you have and offers the update when a newer one is out (Midtown Madness 3 0.1.x shows the update to 0.2.0, the Vulkan rework).
- Saints Reborn is followed like FIFA Street: new scripts on its main branch count as an update too.
- Rusty MCLA keeps the resolution, frame cap, render scale and fill settings you chose in its launcher when the plugin updates it.
- Road Trip Adventure, ReSkate and Azimuth Turnip are still listed with their newest release only.

## Putting it on the handheld

From 0.1.x: open Armada Ports, press **Check for updates**, then **Update Armada Ports to 0.2.0** at the bottom of the panel. A fresh install: `bash install.sh` next to `ArmadaPorts-v0.2.0.zip` in Desktop Mode.

avalono98/epicdeck.name: EpicDeck v0.9.2
avalono98/epicdeck.body:
### 新增

- **手机扫码登录**：点「手机扫码登录」后，Steam Deck 会在局域网里起一个一次性
  本机页面，手机扫二维码 → 登录 Epic → 把授权码粘贴回同一页面提交，全程不用跨设备
  手抄 32 位授权码。
- **换账号（登出 / 切换分离）**：
  - 「登出」—— 只清本地登录态，下次登录沿用同一账号，免重输密码；
  - 「切换账号」—— 登出并清除 Steam 浏览器里的 Epic cookie，下次强制输入新账号。

### 修复

- **登录崩溃**：`legendary auth` 在换 token 前会强制联网检查 `api.legendary.gl`
  （很多网络下不可达），且该路径没有异常兜底，导致登录中途报 ReadTimeout 退出。
  现在改为直连 Epic OAuth 换 token，不再依赖那个域名，并显式指定 CA 证书
  （修复 systemd 环境下 `SSL_CERT_FILE` 失效导致的证书验证失败）。
- **浏览器登录「看似失败」**：登录其实已成功，只是 Steam 浏览器还全屏盖在授权
  页上。现在补上成功/失败的日志，界面提示「按返回键关闭浏览器」。
- **设置页导航**：
  - 移动方式改为「上下切换行、左右切换按钮」，流式表单里不再因相邻行控件 x 不
    对齐而上下卡住；
  - 修进入设置页焦点不落在顶部第一个控件、以及向下移动到视口外控件失效的问题
    （手动滚动 Steam 滚动面板代替无效的 `scrollIntoView`）。

avalono98/epicdeck.name: EpicDeck v0.9.1
avalono98/epicdeck.body:
### 新增

- **下载认领**：重载插件后端后，仍在运行的下载会被自动接回来 —— 进度继续走、
  可以暂停和取消，不会再「闪退后什么都不剩」。安装输出改为写入
  `runtime/logs/install-<app>.log`，后端重启不再阻塞下载进程，断点记录
  （`.resume`）也不会停止更新。
- **「安装中」阶段**：下载到 100% 后不再直接跳「已完成」。此时 legendary 还在
  组装文件、插件还要写 Steam 快捷方式，界面显示「安装中」，真正可用后才完成。
- **安装完成通知**：安装结束后弹出与「开始下载」同款的通知（标题 + 游戏名）。
- **需第三方启动器的游戏也会显示**：Epic 上有一部分已购游戏（It Takes Two、
  质量效应传奇版、模拟人生 4、纪念碑谷等）只能通过 EA App / Origin 激活，
  legendary 无法安装。它们现在会出现在库里并标记「需外部启动器」，
  详情页说明原因而不是给一个必然失败的下载按钮。

### 修复

- **下载进度不显示速度和剩余时间**：legendary 的一次上报分散在多行
  （百分比与 ETA 在 `Progress:` 行、字节数在另一行、速度又在另一行），
  逐行解析逐行推送时后一行会把前一行的值覆盖成空，界面最终拿到
  `percent=-1 / speed="" / eta=""`。现在跨行累积、每批只推一次。
- **刷新看不到新买的游戏**：`legendary list` 只读登录时写入的
  `entitlements.json`，登录之后买的游戏永远进不来。点「刷新」现在会先让
  legendary 重新拉取已购清单（约 20 秒），失败时自动还原旧文件，不会得到空库。
- **认领的下载显示成一串十六进制**：下载列表的标题原本只来自前端库数据，
  后端重启后前端库为空时就退化成 app_name。现在标题由后端一并下发。
- **添加到 Steam 的顺序**：改为「先写快捷方式 → 再下载封面」。之前封面是网络
  下载且排在前面，中途重载后端会留下一个装好却没有库条目的游戏。
- 扫描外部下载时，包装命令行（`bash -c 'exec -a "legendary install…

avalono98/epicdeck.name: EpicDeck v0.9.0
avalono98/epicdeck.body:
### 新增

- **下载页进度条**：显示「已下载 / 总量」字节数与百分比（解析 Legendary 的
  `Downloaded:` / `Download size:` 输出，实测 25~30 MB/s 国内 CDN）。
- **下载暂停 / 继续（软暂停）**：Legendary 无原生 pause 命令，用「停止进程但
  保留已下载 chunk + `.resume` 状态，继续时重新 install 自动断点续传」实现
  （真机验证：中断后 131.78 MiB 被 `Reusable` 复用，只续下剩余部分）。
- **下载设置**：并发数（限速，自动/8/4/2/1 档）、首选 CDN 节点、明文 HTTP
  开关；设置页新增「清理下载缓存」删除残留断点状态与临时文件。
- 取消下载时清空该游戏的半成品目录与 `.resume`，重下从零开始。
- **小黄鸭插帧（Decky LSFG-VK）**：详情页和设置页加插帧开关，开启后启动脚本用 `~/lsfg`
  在最外层包一层，跟随用户的 LSFG 配置（不硬编码环境变量）；未装插件时不显示开关。
- **ProtonDB 兼容性徽章**：详情页显示该游戏的 ProtonDB 等级（白金/黄金/白银/青铜/不可用）
  与报告数。标题先经 Steam 商店检索换成 appid，再查 ProtonDB；本地化标题（「猫咪斗恶龙
  Cat Quest」）、续作（`Cat Quest` vs `Cat Quest 2`、`Hades` vs `Hades II`）、版本词
  （`Ultimate Edition`）都已处理。结果缓存 7 天，接口失败只是不显示徽章，不报错。
- **新版本提醒**：设置页每天查一次 GitHub Releases，有新版本时出现「有新版本 x.y.z」按钮，
  点了在 Steam 内置浏览器打开下载页。断网时静默失败，不打断使用；本地测试版
  （`0.8.8-beta.N`）不会被提示去「升级」到它所基于的 `0.8.8`。
- **Epic 云存档（手动）**：安装了且 Legendary 标明支持云存档的游戏，详情页出现
  「下载云端存档 / 上传本地存档 / 双向同步」三个按钮。**不做启动自动同步**——…

avalono98/epicdeck.name: EpicDeck v0.8.8
avalono98/epicdeck.body:
### 优化

- **启动链脱离插件目录**：启动脚本里的两阶段启动 shim 原来指向插件目录
  `plugins/EpicDeck/py_modules/launchshim.py`，而 Decky 卸载只删 plugins 目录，
  导致卸载后现有快捷方式静默退化成单段启动（不计游玩时长、拿不到退出码）。
  现在 shim 会按字节同步到 `data/EpicDeck/bin/`（内容相同则不重写，写失败回退
  插件内副本），并带 fsync + 长度校验 + per-pid 临时文件，避免断电留下空文件。
- **设置页新增「数据位置」区块**：列出游戏目录、存档/compatdata、插件数据、
  插件设置、诊断日志、Epic 登录记录六个路径，每行说明卸载后是否保留，按 A 复制。

### 修复

- 复制路径回退路径不再泄漏临时 textarea、也不再抢走手柄焦点；脏配置（install_dir
  被手改成非字符串）不再让整个设置面板报错；`~` 形式的安装路径正确展开。
- 统一了运行目录的解析逻辑（`py_modules/paths.runtime_dir()`），修复了 legendary
  安装器在缺失 `DECKY_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_DIR` 时与其余代码落到不同目录的隐患。

deegan/cursedeck.name: CurseDeck v0.4.4
deegan/cursedeck.body: Fixed an error in CurseDeck 0.4.3 that stopped addon updates before they could reach Wago on Steam Deck. **Update** and **Update all** now work with Decky Loader’s bundled Python. Verified on a Steam Deck by updating Baganator to 868 and Syndicator to 293 from Wago and checking both ZIPs against their CurseForge checksums.

deegan/cursedeck.name: CurseDeck v0.4.3
deegan/cursedeck.body: Update and Update all now include addons that disable third-party CurseForge downloads. CurseDeck can fetch Baganator and Syndicator from their author’s Wago releases and verify the ZIP against the CurseForge file for your WoW edition. If a download fails verification, the installed files and recorded version stay in place.

deegan/cursedeck.name: CurseDeck v0.4.2
deegan/cursedeck.body:
Update and Update all can now install addons with third-party CurseForge downloads disabled when the author publishes the same ZIP on GitHub or the ZIP is already in your Steam Deck’s Downloads folder.

deegan/cursedeck.name: CurseDeck v0.4.1
deegan/cursedeck.body:

- My addons now shows just its title, the AddOns folder path, and the buttons before your addon list, so your addons are visible without scrolling.

deegan/cursedeck.name: CurseDeck v0.4.0
deegan/cursedeck.body:
A simpler Setup page.

- Setup is now four steps in order: find World of Warcraft, pick your version, add your CurseForge API key, and sync your addons.

revivedx/omni-revi-transfer.name: Omni-Revi-Transfer v1.0.1
revivedx/omni-revi-transfer.body:
Omni-Revi-Transfer v1.0.1: a hotfix found while testing on a desktop PC running Bazzite (Decky Loader), in addition to the Steam Deck.

## What's fixed in 1.0.1
- **Desktop dropdowns**: on a PC, choosing an option in a dropdown no longer closes the open panel or shows the old value (opening a dropdown hides the Quick Access Menu for a moment there). Open panels are remembered and every panel uses the same settings, so a stale panel can't save old values over another's.
- **Re-encoded videos keep the game's real frame timing** instead of being rounded to a fixed 1/60 s grid, so they look as smooth as the recording.
- **Safety net for video export**: if `ffmpeg` would use more than 1.5 GB of memory, or the computer would have under 1 GB free, the export is stopped with a clear message instead of risking the whole machine.

Full history: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Revivedx/omni-revi-transfer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install or update (recommended: Desktop Mode installer)
1. In **Desktop Mode**, download `Omni-Revi-Transfer-Installer.desktop` below.
2. Right-click it → **Properties → Permissions** → tick **Is executable**, then double-click it.
3. Choose **Update** (or **Install**). Your settings and keys are kept.

Prefer to do it by hand? Download `omni-revi-transfer-v1.0.1.zip` and use Decky's Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*. Decky Loader must already be installed.

## Files
- `Omni-Revi-Transfer-Installer.desktop` + `omni-revi-transfer-installer.sh`: the installer (the launcher fetches the script when it isn't next to it).
- `omni-revi-transfer-v1.0.1.zip`: the plugin, for the manual route or for the installer to use offline.

## What's new for the Legion Go 1

- **Full Fan Speed toggle** — uses the firmware's own full-speed override (ACPI `\\_.SB.GZFD.WMAE`, feature `0x04020000`), the same mechanism Lenovo's Legion Space app and Handheld Daemon use. xiaochaom/umeyc-plugin-updater.name: UmeYc-Plugin-Updater v0.1.10
xiaochaom/umeyc-plugin-updater.body:
Release v0.1.10: GitHub sign-in and batched anonymous checks

## 中文

- 可选 GitHub 登录：在 Deck 上发起授权，用手机扫码并输入设备码。登录后用账号额度检查更新，用户无需配置 OAuth 应用；不登录也能继续使用。
- 监听上限提高到 200 个。匿名手动和每日检查在额度用完时保存进度，恢复后自动续查剩余插件，首页显示待查数量和续查时间。
- GitHub OAuth 应用未启用设备授权时，弹窗会明确提示原因。

请下载 `UmeYc-Plugin-Updater.zip` 安装，不要使用 GitHub 生成的源码 ZIP。

## English

- Optional GitHub device sign-in: start on the Deck, scan the QR code on your phone, and enter the device code. Signed-in checks use your account quota; anonymous checks remain available, and no OAuth app setup is required for users.
- Watch up to 200 plugins. Anonymous manual and daily checks save progress when the quota runs out and resume when it resets. The home screen shows pending checks and the resume time.
- The sign-in dialog explains when Device Flow is disabled for the GitHub OAuth app.

Install `UmeYc-Plugin-Updater.zip`, not the GitHub-generated source ZIP.

xiaochaom/umeyc-plugin-updater.name: UmeYc-Plugin-Updater v0.1.9
xiaochaom/umeyc-plugin-updater.body:
Release v0.1.9: Show manual check results and support GitHub Fake-IP

## 中文

- 首页「手动检查」现在会显示检查中、成功数、失败数和可更新数。失败时显示原因，例如 GitHub 连接超时或 HTTPS 握手失败。
- 兼容 DeckyClash 等 TUN 代理的 Fake-IP：GitHub 官方 Release 域名无需额外配置，仍校验 HTTPS 证书。其他 ZIP 来源仍需解析到公网地址。

请下载 `UmeYc-Plugin-Updater.zip` 安装，不要使用 GitHub 生成的源码 ZIP。

## English

- Manual checks now show progress, success and failure counts, available updates, and failure reasons such as connection timeouts or HTTPS handshake errors.

schrofingerbib/metadeck.name: MetaDeck Plus 4.2.0-plus.1
schrofingerbib/metadeck.body:
First release of **MetaDeck Plus**, a fork of [MetaDeck](https://github.com/EmuDeck/MetaDeck) 4.2.0. Several features are ported from [Decky Metadata](https://github.com/beallio/Decky-Metadata) by beallio (GPL-3.0-or-later); see NOTICE.

## What's new compared to MetaDeck
- **"Change Metadata..." editor** (game context menu):
  - Edit the metadata fields and the title.
  - Search LizardByte, RAWG and IGN.
  - Find a Steam Match, with a notice for apps no longer on the store.
  - Choose the EmuDeck compatibility report and the RetroAchievements game, and see your progress.
- **Steam Match features** for non-Steam games: the matched game's Community tab, Activity, controller layouts and Deck compatibility.
- **Game trailers** on game pages:
  - Sources: the Steam trailer, else an IGN trailer found by title and console.
  - Options: fade-in delay, audio, hide logo. X mutes the trailer, Y enlarges it.
- **Software mode:** Flathub metadata (automatic for Flatpaks) and manual edits for apps.
- **Fixes:** stability and cache, RetroAchievements subsets, PCSX2 serials of `.chd` games, Game Info staying after editing, among others.

## Install
1. In Decky's settings, **disable MetaDeck** (and **Decky Metadata**, if installed): they patch the same Steam pages.
2. Install `MetaDeck-Plus.zip`. In Decky's Developer settings, use "Install Plugin from URL" with this release's zip link, or "Install Plugin from ZIP File".
3. Restart Steam.

On its first start, MetaDeck Plus copies MetaDeck's settings and cache. MetaDeck keeps its own copy.

- The limit stays saved and comes back as soon as you switch Smooth Frames on again.

lumen-tools/decky-smooth-frames.name: Version 1.2.1
